article.articleHeadline: Bird flu: ಚಿಕನ್‌ ಪ್ರಿಯರೇ ಎಚ್ಚರ! ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ H5N1 ವೈರಸ್ ಪತ್ತೆ, ಕೋಳಿ ಸಾಕಣೆಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಕ್ವಾರಂಟೈನ್
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu: Chicken lovers, beware! H5N1 virus detected in Karnataka; quarantine for poultry farmers.
article.articleSummary: On 17 April 2026, Karnataka reports detection of H5N1 bird flu at a state government poultry farm in Hesaraghatta. Following central government clearance, initial testing confirmed H5N1 in chickens, triggering an alert. Chickens at the farm have been culled and buried. Because the facility supplies birds to several parts of the state, shipments from the farm have been halted and staff transporting chickens to other areas are quarantined to prevent further spread. Veterinary authorities have issued notices to surrounding panchayats and ordered inspection of nearby poultry sheds, markets, and shops. The outbreak is linked to rising chicken meat prices due to supply constraints. Doctors warn that hot daytime temperatures may accelerate H5N1 spread, underscoring the need for heightened biosecurity and monitoring at farms and retail outlets.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：鶏肉好きの皆様へ警告！カルナータカ州でH5N1ウイルスが検出、養鶏農家に隔離命令
triage.triage_reason: H5N1人獣共通感染症の確定例が報告され、IHR基準2つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: カルナータカ州ヘサラガッタの政府養鶏場で確認されたH5N1の人獣共通感染症事例。州内複数地域への供給鶏の流通停止、スタッフ隔離、周辺施設の検査が開始。気温上昇によるウイルス拡散加速の懸念も指摘されている。フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Η Κίνα εντείνει τους ελέγχους και τις θανατώσεις βοοειδών μετά από ξέσπασμα Αφθώδους Πυρετού
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Intensifies Checks and the Culling of Cattle After an Outbreak of Anthrax.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 April 2026, China reports an anthrax outbreak caused by Bacillus anthracis serotype SAT-1—the first SAT-1 detection in the country. Cattle outbreaks affect 6,229 animals in Gansu Province and the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, triggering culling and area disinfection with intensified border controls and accelerated vaccination. SAT-1 spreads easily and causes over 50% mortality in young cattle; transmission is primarily by direct contact, with possible airborne spread and greater spread potential than serotypes A and O. The pathogen is believed to have entered via the northwestern border with Kazakhstan, Mongolia, and Russia. Authorities warn of cross-border spread toward Russia’s Novosibirsk region (1,200–2,500 km away). Two SAT-1 vaccines from Zhongnong Weite Biotechnology received emergency-use approval and should reach the market within a month. The outbreak risks beef production and may prompt trade considerations on Russian livestock.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、アフトウイルス病の流行後に家畜の検査と殺処分を強化
triage.triage_reason: 炭疽菌（SAT-1血清型）の初検出、高い死亡率（若い家畜で50%以上）、国際的な越境拡大リスク（ロシア、カザフスタン、モンゴルとの国境経由）、貿易制限の可能性があり、IHR基準3項目以上を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中国のガンス省およびシンジャン地域での炭疽菌SAT-1血清型の流行を主題としている。SAT-1は初めて中国で検出された血清型であり、カザフスタン、モンゴル、ロシア国境経由での越境拡大リスクが指摘されている。ロシアのノボシビルスク地域への拡大の可能性について当局が警告している。Bluedotの発生地域フィールドにはロシア、モンゴル、カザフスタンが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主な疾病発生は中国（ガンス省、新疆地域）で報告されており、これらの国は二次的な拡大リスク地域である。したがってverified_locationsはChinaのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: 上海今年升级蚊虫监测方案 出台指南防制白纹伊蚊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai upgrades its mosquito surveillance program this year, issues guidelines for the prevention and control of Aedes albopictus
article.articleSummary: Shanghai upgrades its mosquito surveillance targeting Aedes albopictus (white-striped mosquito). The plan adds three surveillance modes—routine, intensified, and emergency—with weekly monitoring, and deploys IoT sensors, AI image recognition, and infrared counting alongside Breteau index and layered ovitrap methods. The city released the 2026 Edition of Guidelines for Prevention and Control of Aedes albopictus, detailing cross‑department responsibilities to ensure environmental sanitation and vector control in venues from shopping malls, markets, schools, and nurseries to elder-care facilities, residential estates, construction sites, transport hubs, and parks. Rationale includes dengue and chikungunya outbreaks in Southeast Asia and the Americas; WHO flags chikungunya as a globally monitored vector-borne disease. No Aedes aegypti detected in Shanghai. Subtropical monsoon climate, dense population, standing water, and underground breeding sites pose challenges. The three-stage year-round plan: overwintering (Dec–Mar) egg clearance; spring (Apr–May) source reduction; peak (Jun–Nov) rapid, comprehensive response; emphasizes integrated vector management with environment-first, biological/physical control, chemical measures only as needed, with proper equipment and dosages.

triage.headline_ja: 上海が今年蚊虫監視プログラムをアップグレード、ヒトスジシマカの防除ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: シマカ媒介性疾患（デング熱・チクングニア熱）に対する予防的公衆衛生対策の事例報告。発生ではなく監視体制強化の記事であり、現在の重篤な患者発生は報告されていない。情報不足で判定保留。
triage.notes: この記事は上海での蚊媒介性疾患の実際の発生報告ではなく、東南アジアとアメリカでのデング熱・チクングニア熱の流行への対応として監視体制を強化したという予防的措置の記事。カナリア諸島・スペインはBluedetのジオロケーション誤分類と考えられるため verified_locations から除外。実際の感染症イベント発生がないため通常のトリアージ基準では DISMISS 相当だが、政府の公衆衛生対応強化が記録されているため WATCH として経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Sejak Januari hingga April 2026, 913 Kasus Campak Tercatat di Sulawesi Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From January to April 2026, 913 measles cases were recorded in Central Sulawesi.
article.articleSummary: From January to April 2026, Central Sulawesi recorded 913 suspected and lab-confirmed measles cases. The Health Office notes a downward weekly trend: week 14 saw 53 suspected cases, down from week 13 (99) and week 12 (115). The decline is attributed to immunization catch-up campaigns, Outbreak Response Immunization for children aged 9–59 months, and MR vaccination for health workers to interrupt transmission in health facilities. Laboratory confirmation is pending for specimens sent to Surabaya to confirm case status. Authorities continue surveillance and intensify additional immunization in affected areas. Public guidance urges maintaining Clean Living and Healthy Behavior (PHBS) and seeking health facility care promptly if measles symptoms appear. Parents should ensure their children’s immunizations are complete, with community leaders and local authorities urged to support immunization coverage in the impacted region.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年1月から4月にかけて、スラウェシ中部で913件の麻疹症例が記録された
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで913件の麻疹症例が報告され、異常性と重症度の基準を満たしているが、すでに予防接種キャンペーンにより週ごとの新規症例数が減少傾向を示しており、地域の対応体制が機能している。情報が不完全（死亡数、重症化率など）なため、WATCH段階で経過を観察する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地域情報確認：見出しおよび本文冒頭でスラウェシ中部（Central Sulawesi）での発生を明記。Bluedot APIが付与した位置情報（Jawa Timur/Surabaya）は検査検体の送付先であり、実際の発生地はスラウェシ中部。インドネシアを verified_locations に含める。同国内で対応体制が構築されており、管理可能性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sulteng Imbau Masyarakat Terapkan PHBS untuk Cegah Penyebaran Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Sulawesi Health Office Urges the Public to Practice PHBS to Prevent the Spread of Measles
article.articleSummary: Measles in Central Sulawesi triggers emphasis on PHBS and immunization. On 17 April 2026, Palu-based Central Sulawesi Health Office urges the public to practice Perilaku Hidup Bersih dan Sehat (PHBS) and ensure complete age-appropriate immunization to curb measles transmission. Ahsan, head of the Surveillance and Immunization Task Force, highlights handwashing, home and environmental cleanliness, and maintaining hygiene as key to breaking the transmission chain. The region reported 913 measles cases from January to April 2026. Parents are advised to promptly seek care for children showing measles symptoms at local health facilities to enable early management and prevent complications. Officials call on community leaders and authorities to educate the public about PHBS and full immunization, especially for children aged 9–59 months who are most at risk.

triage.headline_ja: 中央スラウェシ保健局、麻疹の拡大防止のため、住民に公衆衛生及び健康的な行動（PHBS）の実践を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア中央スラウェシ州で2026年1月～4月に913件の麻疹症例が報告されており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への影響と異常性）および WPRO スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当する。シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月17日付。中央スラウェシ州（パル市）での麻疹流行を報道しており、4ヶ月間で913例の症例報告と、特に9～59ヶ月児がリスク集団として強調されている。当局による公衆衛生教育キャンペーンが進行中。引き続き症例数の推移と免疫接種率の状況を監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Suspek Campak di Sulteng Turun Jadi 53 Kasus, Dinkes Imbau Jaga PHBS dan Lengkapi Vaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Measles in Central Sulawesi Drops to 53 Cases, Health Office Urges to Maintain PHBS and Complete Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Suspected measles in Central Sulawesi drop to 53 cases in week 14 of 2026, per the Sulawesi Tengah Health Office, with Palu cited as the location. Week 13 had 99 suspected cases and week 12 had 115, reflecting a gradual downward trend attributed to catch-up immunization and Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) for children aged 9–59 months. Additional MR vaccination of healthcare workers is being intensified to interrupt transmission in health facilities. Laboratory confirmation for several specimens is pending, sent to Surabaya. Cumulatively, suspected and laboratory-confirmed measles cases in Central Sulawesi from January–April 2026 reach 913. Authorities continue surveillance and bolster supplementary immunization in affected areas, while urging the public to maintain PHBS and ensure complete age-appropriate vaccination. Parents of toddlers should seek care if symptoms arise, and community leaders are asked to support vaccination in affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: 中央スラウェシの麻疹疑い患者が53例に減少、保健局がPHBS維持とワクチン接種完了を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の感染者数は減少傾向を示しており、当局による対応（予防接種キャンペーン）が進行中である。ただし、累計913例の患者報告があり、情報が限定的なため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹は感染しやすい疾病で、記事では継続的な曝露と感染拡大の可能性が示唆されている。一方、既に当局による予防接種キャンペーンが進行中であり、患者数は減少傾向にある。死亡や重症化に関する具体的情報がないため、WATCHとした。IHR基準は現在のところ該当せず。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ngãi: Khẩn trương kiểm soát nguy cơ dịch dại sau vụ chó cắn nhiều người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quang Ngai: Urgently control the risk of rabies after a dog bite incident involving many people.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 April 2026, Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, urgently controls rabies risk after a suspected rabid dog attacked residents in Son Tịnh Commune, Dien Niên hamlet. On 14 April, a yellow-coated dog ran loose and bit three people in one family; victims received wound care and rabies vaccination. The animal was captured and euthanized by about 11:30 on 14 April. A security personnel member was also bitten and received first aid and vaccination. By 16 April authorities were surveying dog and cat populations to enable broad vaccination and enforcing leash/muzzle use in public to prevent further spread. On 17 April, the Department of Livestock and Veterinary ordered sampling of suspect rabies cases for laboratory testing and launched extensive vaccination campaigns for dogs and cats. A man bitten by a suspected rabies dog reportedly treated himself with herbal medicine (thuốc nam).

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ州：多数の人が犬に咬まれた事件後、狂犬病の拡大リスクを緊急に管理
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑い事例であり異常・予想外性と重症度の基準を満たすが、現時点では局地的な事例（4名の咬傷被害）であり、情報が限定的。当局の対応が進行中のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は展開が迅速で、一度発症すると致命的である。本事例は4名の咬傷被害という限定的なものだが、当局の対応（当日のウイルス検査指示、広範な犬猫のワクチン接種キャンペーン）が積極的に展開されている。1名が民間療法で自己治療した可能性があり、追加の曝露リスクが懸念される。IHR基準は1つのみ該当だがWPRO基準3つ該当、政府関心が高く「WATCH」レベルとした。続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: У вируса оспы обезьян нашли новые мутации для обхода иммунитета
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The monkeypox virus has developed new mutations to evade immunity.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox virus has developed mutations potentially enabling immune evasion to enter human cells. Indian biologists for the first time identified mutations in the monkeypox genome linked to immune-evading mechanisms. The study analyzed genetic changes in 40 clinical samples collected across European, Asian, and African countries. Phylogenetic analysis focused on three genes—OPG002, OPG176, and OPG210—that encode proteins involved in modulating host immunity. Computational analysis highlighted functional domains in these genes associated with immune evasion, underscoring ongoing viral evolution and the need for broader genomic surveillance to confirm findings. The reported changes potentially increase transmissibility, though infections in such cases often run milder courses, according to experts cited by Izvestiya. Further validation requires larger datasets and continued monitoring for new variants.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘ウイルスが免疫回避のための新たな変異を獲得
triage.triage_reason: 免疫回避メカニズムに関連する新規変異の発見は異常かつ注目すべきだが、記事の焦点は計算生物学的分析であり、実際の臨床的脅威や国際的な拡大リスクについては明示的な証拠がない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド生物学者によるゲノム解析と免疫回避関連変異の計算生物学的発見を報じている。サマリーは欧州・アジア・アフリカから採集された40臨床サンプルの遺伝子変化を分析したと述べているが、実際の臨床的な重症度や人-人感染の増加リスクについては明示的な証拠がなく「専門家によると軽症が多い」との記述もある。「さらなる検証には大規模データセットと継続的監視が必要」との記述から、現時点では予備的な発見段階と考えられる。発生地域にAfricaが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はインドの研究グループによるゲノム解析であり、実際の新規症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Le commerce d'animaux sauvages augmente les risques de transmission de virus à l'humain
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The trade in wild animals increases the risk of virus transmission to humans.
article.articleSummary: Wildlife trade and keeping wild species as pets heighten the risk of virus transmission to humans. Species traded or kept as new/exotic pets (NEPs)—bears, civets, viverrid dogs, hedgehogs, foxes and pangolins—are captured in nature or bred in captivity for food, fur, scales or horns, and for traditional medicine. In 2003, owners of prairie dogs in the United States, sold as pets, were infected with monkeypox after contact with Gambian rats imported from Ghana into pet shops, illustrating a spillover chain. The report notes that many major human epidemics, including HIV/AIDS, West Africa Ebola in 2014, and the Covid-19 pandemic, are linked to wildlife trade. A Science study, published recently, provides, for the first time globally and in quantitative terms, proof of the link between wildlife commerce—legal or illegal—and pathogen transmission to humans. Jérôme Gippet (University of Fribourg) and coauthors emphasize this inherent risk in wildlife markets.

triage.headline_ja: 野生動物の商取引は人間へのウイルス伝播リスクを増加させる
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物取引と人獣共通感染症伝播リンクに関する科学的分析記事であり、複数の重大疾患（Mpox、HIV、Ebola、COVID-19）を言及しているが、現在進行中の具体的な感染症アウトブレイクイベント報告ではなく、リスク啓発・科学報告の性質が強い。ただし対象国（ガーナ）が含まれ、今後のシグナル監視の価値あり。
triage.notes: 本記事は現在の進行中アウトブレイク報告ではなく、野生動物取引と感染症伝播の一般的なリスク分析。2003年のアメリカでのmonkeypox事例やガーナからの輸入動物との関連は歴史的参照。ガーナは記事で言及されているが、現在のアクティブなイベントとして確実な証拠は提示されていない。スクリーニング基準（prolonged_exposure, epidemic_prone）に該当するが、具体的な現在のアウトブレイク証拠が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Cirebon Sudah Tetapkan KLB Campak Sebelum 2 Balita Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cirebon Has Declared a Measles Outbreak Before Two Toddlers Died.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared in Kota Cirebon, Indonesia, with two toddlers reported dead. Local health officials announced KLB (Kejadian Luar Biasa) for measles on 20 February 2026 after a rigorous epidemiological assessment, noting the surge began in late December 2025 (week 53) and has spread to all five districts, though not all 22 subdistricts (kelurahan) are affected. In response, authorities issued an alert on rising measles and rubella (German measles), coordinated with the Education Department, and conducted rapid community surveys followed by mass immunization via Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) targeting vulnerable children. Kadinkes Dr. Siti Maria Listiawaty emphasized that the KLB designation followed surveillance, studies, and microplanning. The report highlights measles and rubella concerns and ongoing public health measures, including vaccination campaigns, to curb transmission in Cirebon City.

triage.headline_ja: シレボンが2人の幼児死亡前に麻しん流行宣言を既に実施
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんの公式流行宣言（KLB）、死亡事例2件、多地域への蔓延、ヒト-ヒト感染性疾患であり、IHR基準3項目、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目に該当。
triage.notes: 麻しんとドイツ麻しんの両者が報告されている。2026年2月20日にKLB（インドネシアの公式流行宣言）が発令され、2025年12月下旬からの流行が確認されている。小児死亡2件、複数地区への蔓延、当局による予防接種キャンペーン実施中。発生地域の座標はインドネシアのシレボン市（Cirebon）周辺を示す。

article.articleHeadline: 38 Anak di Tasikmalaya Positif Campak, Dinkes Sasar Imunisasi 6.000 Balita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 38 Children in Tasikmalaya Test Positive for Measles, Health Office Targets Immunization for 6,000 Under-Fives.
article.articleSummary: Measles case cluster detected in Tasikmalaya City, West Java, Indonesia: 38 children tested positive for measles from January through March 2026, with 120 suspected cases and lab confirmation by Labkesda Jawa Barat (Bandung) after sending patient samples. No deaths reported. Authorities do not declare a KLB (extraordinary outbreak) and say cases are declining with ongoing health interventions. A vaccination drive targets 6,000 under‑fives to stop transmission. Preventive measures include immunization across hospitals, primary health centers (Puskesmas), and Posyandu posts, plus community outreach in villages and schools, hygiene promotion, avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, and masking as needed. Infection source not specified. The effort aims to sustain containment and prevent future outbreaks in Tasikmalaya.

triage.headline_ja: タシクマラヤで麻しん患者38人が陽性、保健局が生後6か月から5歳までの児童6000人のワクチン接種を目指す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）で麻しんの集団発症が検出されたが、当局が本格的な流行宣言を見送り、症例が減少傾向にあると報告している。社会的関心の詳細が不明なため、WATCH として経過観察を推奨する。
triage.notes: 集団発症（38確定例、120疑い例）が確認されたが、当局が KLB（異常流行）を宣言せず、症例が減少傾向と述べている。死亡例はなし。ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中。記事には世論や国際支援の必要性に関する情報が不記載。

article.articleHeadline: Persiapan Idul Adha 2026 di Gresik, 10.000 Ribu Hewan Kurban Sudah Divaksin PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preparations for Eid al-Adha 2026 in Gresik, Ten Thousand Sacrificial Animals Have Been Vaccinated Against FMD.
article.articleSummary: On Eid al-Adha 2026 in Gresik Regency, East Java, the Department of Agriculture (Dispertan) accelerated vaccination against Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD/PMK) in sacrificial livestock ahead of the holiday on 27 May 2026. As of now, 10,000 heads of cattle and goats in Gresik have completed FMD vaccination, supporting animal health and public confidence. Animals intended for sacrifice must be healthy and meet criteria, excluding those in the P3K category (limping, blind, sick, or emaciated). For buyers with doubts, assistance is available from the UPT Puskeswan North and South. Livestock should carry a Surat Keterangan Kesehatan Hewan (SKKH) proving health status and vaccination. Additionally, Dispertan launched Sipoltak, an online livestock traffic assistance service, to facilitate movement of animals and products for the market.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ギレシク地区のイード・アル＝アドハー準備、1万頭の供犬動物がFMDワクチン接種済み
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）は動物疾患だが、本記事はイード・アル＝アドハーに向けた予防接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、アウトブレイク・危機的状況ではない。記事は準備段階の肯定的なニュースであり、IHR基準・スクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、FMDに対する予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告である。供犬動物への健康管理と食肉衛生確保のための通常の行政対応であり、シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Người lớn tuổi có bệnh nền cần chú ý với loại 1 virus có triệu chứng giống cảm cúm thông thường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Older adults with underlying conditions should be alert to Type 1 virus that presents with flu-like symptoms.
article.articleSummary: RSV (respiratory syncytial virus) remains a major cause of respiratory illness, ranging from mild upper infections to severe lower tract disease with potential mortality, per WHO. Global 2019 estimates show about 33 million RSV-associated lower respiratory tract infections. In Vietnam, a conference on RSV’s impact on older adults and those with underlying conditions highlighted that age and immune suppression raise the risk of severe outcomes, with older patients and those with comorbidities such as asthma, COPD, and heart failure experiencing worse clinical trajectories. Among COPD patients, up to 80.4% had an exacerbation during hospitalization due to RSV. Experts urge strengthened prevention, including vaccination for adults, especially those 60 years and older and with comorbidities, to reduce disease burden and healthcare strain. Local physicians play a pivotal role in counseling and boosting vaccine uptake, alongside ongoing vaccine development from companies like GSK Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 基礎疾患のある高齢者はインフルエンザ様症状を呈するType 1ウイルスに注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: RSVの既知の呼吸器疾患であり、ベトナムでの啓発会議が報告されているが、新規感染症アウトブレイク、急激な疾患増加、または国際的な拡大を示唆する情報は記事に含まれていない。情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: RSVは周知の病原体であり、記事は啓発・予防推奨の内容。新規アウトブレイク、急激な増加報告、または異常な臨床的事象の報告はない。ベトナム政府による会議開催と予防接種推奨は実施されているが、緊急対応の必要性を示唆する情報なし。WPRO基準で重症度・流行性・長期曝露の3基準に該当するが、IHR基準非該当および記事が啓発的性質であるため、WATCH判定。続報で具体的な患者数増加や異常な臨床転帰が報告される場合はWATCH→PICKUPへの昇格を検討。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Ivory Coast reports bird flu outbreak on farm
article.articleSummary: Ivory Coast reports a highly pathogenic H5N1 bird flu outbreak on a poultry farm in the eastern district of Koun-Fao, near the border with Ghana. The World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE), citing Ivorian authorities, said the virus has killed about 95,000 poultry birds in the district. The outbreak follows global H5N1 activity seen in recent years. The report was issued on Thursday, 17 April 2026. The OIE confirmation reflects surveillance and response actions under its framework. The article does not provide details on the infection source, nor information on export/import status related to this outbreak. No human health impact is mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: コートジボワール、農場での鳥インフルエンザ発生を報告
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性H5N1の大規模家禽死亡（約95,000羽）が報告されており、異常・予想外の特性を示す。ただし人間の感染報告がなく、国際的拡大リスクについて情報不足のため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはコートジボワール（Côte d'Ivoire）が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。ガーナは対象国として含める。サマリーに人間への感染報告がないことが重要。OIE公式確認による信頼性の高い情報。高病原性H5N1の家禽への影響は深刻だが、人獣共通感染に関する情報が限定的であるため、フルRRA実施前の継続観察が推奨される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: ಆತಂಕ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಜ್ವರ - Sanjevani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian Influenza That Caused Panic - Sanjevani
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza has been confirmed at a poultry farm in Hessaraghatta, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka, after central government-approved testing. The farm, a major supplier to multiple regions, has been temporarily closed; birds were culled and buried. Farm workers are quarantined, and surrounding panchayats have been alerted; compulsory testing will be conducted at poultry shops and sheds. State veterinary authorities have issued strict directives for immediate reporting of any suspected cases. Public guidance: consume only well-cooked poultry, sanitize hands after handling raw meat, and seek medical care if symptoms develop. Notably, the virus was detected in hot weather. Authorities emphasize vigilance without causing public panic. No human cases are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザが懸念を引き起こした
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザが家禽農場で確認され、IHR基準で異常性・国際的リスク・渡航制限リスクの3基準に該当。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と管理上の課題があり、迅速なRRAが必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性で人獣共通感染症であり、農場労働者の隔離実施中。暑い時期での検出は季節的異常。食品サプライチェーン（複数地域への供給農場）への影響が懸念される。記事に人感染報告がないものの、監視強化体制が構築されており、今後の発展を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra en RDC : moins de 1 000 cas notifiés, situation maîtrisée à la prison de Makala avec une couverture vaccinale de 94 %
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in the DRC: fewer than 1,000 reported cases, situation under control at Makala Prison with a 94% vaccination coverage.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows a weekly decline, with suspected cases dropping from 1,157 to 968 and 14 deaths (case fatality rate 1.5%, up from 1%). In Kinshasa, 36 new suspected cholera cases and 2 deaths were reported during the week; 16 patients are currently treated at the cholera treatment center in Kinshasa, up from 12. At the Kinshasa Penitentiary and Rehabilitation Center (CPRK, formerly Makala Prison), the situation has been under control for more than 20 consecutive days, with no suspected cases or new hospitalizations. Vaccination coverage at CPRK reached 94% as of 12 April 2026. The Health Ministry, INSP, and local teams, with WHO support and funding from partners including the FCDO, continue multisectoral response. Emphasis remains on handwashing, water treatment, sanitation, and rapid reporting of acute diarrhoea cases to end transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ：1,000件未満の報告例、マカラ刑務所では94%のワクチン接種率で状況を管理下に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのコレラ発生であり、IHR基準は該当しないが、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性（継続的な流行）と長期曝露リスクが認められる。ただし記事では「状況は管理下にある」とされており、重症度や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でないため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは週間的な減少傾向が報告されており、キンシャサの刑務所ではワクチン接種が進み状況が管理下にあるとされている。しかし、継続的な死亡者（14名）と新規患者（36件）が報告されており、完全な制御には至っていない。WHOと複数のドナー国による支援が継続中であり、国際的関心も存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Tren Kasus Campak di Cirebon Meningkat, 50 Pasien Anak Ditangani Intensif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Case Trend in Cirebon Rises; 50 Pediatric Patients Are Receiving Intensive Treatment.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Cirebon surged in early 2026; from January to March 2026, 50 pediatric patients required inpatient care at Rumah Sakit Daerah Gunung Jati Cirebon. January 26, February 19, and March 5 were the daily ED admission counts, culminating in 50 total admissions. The hospital, a referral center for Ciayumajakuning, also treated increasingly heavier cases, including deaths among children with measles complications. The rise is accompanied by more referrals from outside Cirebon, signaling escalation. In response, RSD Gunung Jati implemented strict isolation for measles and suspected cases and used cohorting in dedicated isolation rooms, given the disease’s high airborne transmissibility. Coordination with the city and regency health offices includes regular data reporting and efforts to boost vaccination coverage to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: シレボンにおける麻しん症例の増加傾向、50人の小児患者が集中治療中
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんの急速な流行増加（3ヶ月で50人の入院患者、死亡例あり）、予想外の重症化パターン、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、他地域からの流入報告があり、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。IHR基準も異常性・国際的懸念を満たす。
triage.notes: インドネシア・シレボン地域における麻しんの明確な流行兆候。3ヶ月間に50人の小児入院患者、死亡例の報告、他地域からの患者流入、高い空気感染性への対応（隔離・コホーティング実施）が報告されている。地域保健機関による調整と予防接種率向上の試みが進行中。記事は地域メディア（Kompas Bandung）による最新の疫学情報であり、公式な報告の補完的なシグナルとなる。

article.articleHeadline: Sốc nhiễm khuẩn, suy đa tạng vì nhiễm liên cầu lợn sau khi chế biến thịt heo sống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Septic shock and multi-organ failure due to Streptococcus suis infection after processing raw pork.
article.articleSummary: A 61-year-old man in Vietnam developed septic shock and multi‑organ failure due to Streptococcus suis infection after handling raw pork and bones purchased two days before onset. Admitted to the Intensive Care Unit at People’s Hospital 115 in Ho Chi Minh City with septic shock, multi‑organ dysfunction, and disseminated intravascular coagulation, he required rapid resuscitation. Blood cultures later grew Streptococcus suis, a bacterium transmitted from pigs via skin contact (especially with wounds) or ingestion of undercooked pork, including raw dishes. After 21 days of intensive treatment and supportive care, his condition stabilized and he was discharged. Public health advice: avoid undercooked pork and raw meat products; wear gloves when handling raw pork, particularly with skin injuries; seek prompt medical care if fever, headache, vomiting, rash, tinnitus, or hearing loss develop after exposure to raw pork.

triage.headline_ja: 豚肉加工後の連鎖球菌感染による敗血性ショックと多臓器不全
triage.triage_reason: Streptococcus suis感染による重症症例（敗血性ショック、多臓器不全）が報告されており、重症度基準に該当する。ただし単一症例の報告であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクの明確な根拠が不足している。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例報告であり、患者は治療後に回復している。Streptococcus suis感染は既知のzoonotic pathogenであり、個別症例での重症度は高いが、集団発生や国際的懸念の示唆がない。豚肉取扱いに関する公衆衛生勧告が提供されている。追加の症例報告や流行兆候の有無について続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ciamis Belum Temukan Kasus Campak Terkonfirmasi Lab, Dinkes Pantau Ketat Temuan Suspek di Lapangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ciamis Has Not Yet Found Laboratory-Confirmed Measles Cases; Health Office Closely Monitors Suspected Cases in the Field.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains unconfirmed in Ciamis as of mid-April 2026, with the Ciamis District Health Office reporting several suspected cases under field surveillance but no laboratory-confirmed cases. Measles is a highly contagious viral respiratory illness. Early symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes (conjunctivitis), Koplik spots, and a rash that starts on the head and spreads downward. Edis Herdis, head of Disease Prevention and Control at Dinkes Ciamis, says monitoring continues and no lab-confirmed cases have been found, indicating prevention efforts may be effective. Authorities emphasize prompt health-seeking, strengthen coordination with facilities from community health centers (puskesmas) to referral hospitals, and continue measles immunization campaigns. Public health measures include PHBS, nutritious diets, and reducing transmission via droplets from coughing or sneezing. The goal is to maintain a measles-free status in Ciamis.

triage.headline_ja: チアミスでは麻疹の検査室確認症例がまだ見つかっておらず、保健所が現場の疑い症例を厳密に監視している
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は流行性疾患であり、複数の疑い症例が報告されているが、検査確認例がないため現段階では限定的なシグナルに留まる。情報の充実を待ち、確認症例または急速な拡大の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染性を有する呼吸器疾患であり、複数の疑い症例が報告されている。ただし検査確認例がなく、予防対策が効果的に機能している可能性もある。今後の検査確認例の発生動向、症例数の増加傾向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cirebon Masih KLB Campak, 2 Pasien Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cirebon Still in a Measles Outbreak, Two Patients Die.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Cirebon City, Indonesia, remains at a declared extraordinary event (KLB) as of mid-April 2026, following a surge that began in late December 2025. Epidemiologists classified the KLB on 20 February 2026. From 2025 total 238 measles cases; by week 13 of 2026 (4 April) the cumulative total reached 150, indicating a sustained high level. RSUD Gunung Jati, the referral hospital, reports at least 50 inpatients with measles from January–March 2026, majority under five, many presenting via emergency department, suggesting high severity. Pediatric cases commonly develop pneumonia or related complications, linked to incomplete or absent measles immunization. In the last few months, four patients required intensive care, with two deaths. The deceased had comorbidities such as malnutrition and congenital heart disease, and all had incomplete immunization. Local authorities are intensifying community outreach and expanding vaccination coverage to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: チルボンの麻疹流行継続、2人の患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。2026年4月時点での持続的な流行、死亡事例、小児集中治療ケース、ワクチン接種率の低さが確認されており、フルRRAに進む必要あり。
triage.notes: チルボン市での麻疹流行は2025年12月下旬に開始し、2026年2月20日に正式なKLB（異常事態）として分類された。2025年の総症例数238件から2026年4月初旬までに150件に増加。RSUD Gunung Jati病院での入院患者は少なくとも50名（大部分が5才以下）で、肺炎等の合併症が多い。死亡患者2名は栄養不良や先天性心疾患の基礎疾患を持ちワクチン接種が不完全。当局による予防接種拡大と地域啓発が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 增2宗外地傳入登革熱　病人曾訪泰國及斯里蘭卡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two more imported dengue fever cases; patients had visited Thailand and Sri Lanka.
article.articleSummary: Two more imported dengue fever cases were recorded by Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection. The patients, during their incubation periods, had visited Thailand and Sri Lanka. In the week 10–16 April 2026, two imported dengue infections were confirmed, bringing the year-to-date total to 12 dengue cases, all imported. In 2025, 59 dengue cases were reported, also entirely imported. Separately, two imported chikungunya fever cases were recorded; all infections are imported. Last year Hong Kong reported 82 chikungunya cases, of which 11 were locally acquired and the remainder imported. The updates underscore ongoing import-driven dengue and chikungunya activity, with no local transmission reported in these figures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱感染者が2名増加 患者はタイとスリランカを訪問
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入感染症事例であり国際由来のリスク要因がある。しかし地域内での局所流行の兆候はなく、重症度や管理上の緊急性が記事では明示されていないため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはタイ・スリランカ・香港が含まれるが、記事の主題は香港の輸入感染症事例である。香港は中国（GeoNames ID: 1814991）に含まれるため verified_locations に China を記載。タイは対象国（1605651）に含まれるが、記事ではタイは患者の曝露地点であり、タイでの発生事例ではないため除外。スリランカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。局所感染の報告はなく、輸入感染症の監視・報告が主目的。

article.articleHeadline: 越南「腸病毒71型」疫情嚴峻！重症快到來不及救  家庭傳播率飆6成 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam's Enterovirus 71 Outbreak Is Severe; Severe Cases Are Imminent, with Little Time to Save; Household Transmission Rate Surges to 60%
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 (EV-A71) outbreak in Vietnam is severe, with household transmission around 60%. Adults are often asymptomatic carriers; children under 6 are highest risk. EV71 can progress rapidly to severe neurologic illness and cardiopulmonary failure within hours, with symptoms including fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, vomiting, seizures, altered consciousness, limb weakness, and coma. The article references Taiwan’s history, noting that from 2005–2024 EV71 accounted for about 80% of severe enterovirus cases there, with case fatality up to 20% when CNS involvement occurs. Early medical care is stressed. A real-world EV71 vaccine provides ~99% protection with antibodies lasting at least five years; vaccination starts at 2 months, with three doses before age 2 (or two doses after age 2). Self-pay cost is about 5,000 per dose. Public health emphasis on protecting children under 6 and recognizing rapid deterioration; sanitizers may not inactivate EV71.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの「腸病毒71型」疫情は深刻！重症例の急速悪化に対応が追いつかない 家庭内感染率が60%に急上昇
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71の急速進行性の神経学的重篤化と心肺系合併症による高い致死率が報告されており、家庭内感染率60%という高い感染性が確認されている。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が認められ、ベトナムでの進行中の流行に対する国家レベルの対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのEV71流行に焦点を当てており、台湾の歴史的事例は参考情報として引用されている。ベトナムでの急速進行性神経学的合併症（けいれん、意識障害、四肢脱力、昏睡）と心肺系不全による高い重症率・致死率が強調されている。6歳未満の小児が最高リスク群として特定されており、家庭内感染率60%は予防対策の困難さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 景区的鹦鹉套圈是怎么把人送进ICU的？警惕这种正逐年攀升的"鹦鹉热"！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How does the parrot-ring toss at tourist attractions send people to the ICU? Beware of this psittacosis that is rising year by year!
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis (Chlamydia psittaci) infections are rising in China since 2023, with southern regions most affected. A Beijing incident shows zoonotic risk from live birds at attractions: a man acquired a budgerigar during a ring-toss game; the bird died after respiratory illness, and his 77-year-old father rapidly deteriorated, requiring ICU care, tracheostomy, and ventilation for severe pneumonia with ARDS. Lab confirmation identified psittacosis with pneumonia and type I respiratory failure. In China, psittacosis is a Category C notifiable disease; cases must be reported within 24 hours, isolation not routinely required. Incubation is 5–14 days; early flu-like symptoms can progress to pneumonia with dry cough and dyspnea; complications include myocarditis, hepatitis, encephalitis. Transmission is mainly bird-to-human via inhalation of dried droppings/secretions; human-to-human spread is rare. Prevention: avoid handling live birds; disinfect with 70% alcohol, 1% Lysol, or 10% bleach; buy from clean, licensed stalls.

triage.headline_ja: 観光地のオウムのリングトスはどのようにして人をICUに送るのか？毎年上昇しているこのオウム病に警戒せよ！
triage.triage_reason: 中国で2023年以降増加傾向にあるオウム病（クラミジア・プシッタチ）の複数症例報告であり、重症例（ARDS、人工呼吸管理）と肝炎・脳炎などの合併症が確認されている。WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行傾向性・予想外性が該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中国全体でのオウム病増加傾向（南部地域が最も影響を受けている）と北京での具体的な重症例を報告している。接触者リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（稀）、観光地での動物接触という社会的リスク要因がある。中国ではC類報告対象疾患に分類されており、公式な報告義務がある。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda como a mineração ilegal de ouro na Amazônia é causa direta de surtos de malária entre indígenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand how illegal gold mining in the Amazon is a direct cause of malaria outbreaks among Indigenous peoples
article.articleSummary: Illegal gold mining in the Brazilian Amazon is directly linked to malaria outbreaks among the Yanomami Indigenous people. The article notes record gold prices driving mining activity, but highlights the health impact: researchers from Stanford University, UFMT (Federal University of Mato Grosso), and UFMG (Federal University of Minas Gerais) quantified the mining-related increase in malaria cases in Yanomami territory. The outbreak, described as devastating, occurred in the early 2020s and has plunged this isolated population into a severe health crisis. The findings illustrate how environmental disturbance and expanded human activity from illegal mining amplify malaria transmission in remote communities, underscoring the need for integrated public health and environmental interventions in the Amazon. The text does not provide specific case counts or mortality figures.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンの違法金採掘がヤノマミ先住民のマラリア流行の直接的な原因であることを理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアマゾン地域でのマラリア流行が確認され、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」と「国際的な公衆衛生への影響」が該当。WPRO基準では「重症度」「流行性」「管理可能性」が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマラリア流行を報道していますが、評価対象国リストにはブラジル(3469034)が含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となります。ただし、ヤノマミ先住民コミュニティへの「壊滅的な」健康危機、違法採掘による環境破壊とマラリア伝播の増加、スタンフォード大学などの研究機関による定量化など、公衆衛生上重大なシグナルとしての要件を満たしており、監視地域外でありながら国際的な公衆衛生関心は高い。具体的な症例数および死亡者数は記事に記載されていません。

article.articleHeadline: Gana'da M çiçeği vaka sayısı 1062'ye yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox case count in Ghana has risen to 1,062.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Ghana: As of 17 April 2026, the Ghana Health Service reports 1,062 confirmed cases and 8 deaths across all 16 regions, with ongoing spread and nationwide monitoring to curb transmission. The health service emphasizes surveillance in every region to prevent further spread. The government previously stated that the outbreak was first detected on 19 May 2025 in four people, and the first virus-related death occurred on 28 July 2025. A vaccination campaign targeting high-risk groups remains active to reduce transmission and protect vulnerable populations. The report highlights continued public health measures and region-wide monitoring to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのサル痘患者数が1,062人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、複数地域での持続的な流行を示している。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当し、ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中の状況から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2025年5月19日の初期検出から1年近くが経過し、患者数1,062人、死亡8人という持続的な流行。全16地域での感染確認、全国的な監視体制、ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中。WPRÓスクリーニング基準の全5項目に該当する高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: Com vacina disponível, MS registra 469 casos confirmados de dengue em 2026 - Brasil News 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With a vaccine available, the Ministry of Health records 469 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 - Brasil News 1.
article.articleSummary: In Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, a chikungunya outbreak with 12 confirmed deaths runs alongside a relatively low dengue burden. The SES bulletin reports 3,266 probable dengue cases and 469 laboratory-confirmed cases through April 11, 2026, with Aedes aegypti as the vector. Since the 2023 epidemic (45,502 notifications; 41,046 confirmed), dengue activity has declined. Of 79 municipalities, 12 are red (high incidence, >300 cases per 100,000). Nova Alvorada do Sul and Tacuru have not yet reported a suspected dengue case; Corumbá leads with 91 cases, followed by Costa Rica (57), and Santa Rita do Pardo and Caarapó (25 each). Dengue vaccination totals: 223,322 doses, including 147,123 first doses (73.8%) and 88,420 second doses (44.3%). The state received 241,030 doses from the Ministry of Health and has immunized 201,349 people in the target group. Bulletin released April 16; data through April 11.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン利用可能な状況下で、保健省は2026年のデング熱確認症例469件を記録 - ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアとデング熱の同時発生、チクングニアで12人の死亡、複数市で高い罹患率（赤色警報12市）、デング熱ワクチン接種展開中など、複数のWPRO基準を満たす。国家的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にコスタリカが含まれているが、記事サマリーではブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州のみが主題であり、コスタリカは市町村名として言及されているだけ（Corumbá市の次に言及される57症例の地名）。したがってverified_locationsはBrazilのみ。チクングニア12死亡とデング熱469確認症例の同時流行は注視が必要。ワクチン接種キャンペーン進行中で政府対応は活発。

article.articleHeadline: Онищенко заявил, что оспа обезьян начала местно распространяться в России -- Вечерняя Казань
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Onishchenko stated that monkeypox began to spread locally in Russia — Evening Kazan.
article.articleSummary: Russia reports its third monkeypox case this year, with all three infections in Moscow Region, indicating local transmission rather than importations. Two cases occurred in February and one in April; health authorities (Rospotrebnadzor) monitor the situation, while epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko cautions that transmission requires direct, prolonged contact. No deaths reported in Russia. Globally, over 50,000 monkeypox cases have been identified in the past year, with the majority in Africa (Congo, Uganda, Sierra Leone); outside Africa, cases are mainly in adult men. Symptoms mirror influenza at onset—high fever and myalgia—followed by a rash that forms vesicles, ruptures into ulcers, crusts, and scars; mild cases resolve in 2–3 weeks. Russia’s defense ministry institute (48th Central Research Institute) developed a chewable vaccine tablet TEOVak.

triage.headline_ja: オニシチェンコ氏、サル痘がロシアで地域的に広がり始めたと述べる — イブニング・カザン
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（サル痘）の地域内感染がロシアで報告され、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。また、複数国での同時発生報告により国際的懸念が生じている。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はロシアでのMpox地域感染報告だが、対象国リストにはロシア連邦が含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした（記事本文でコンゴ、ウガンダ、シエラレオネでの世界的流行が言及されており、対象国であるDRCが該当）。ロシアはWPRO対象外の地域のため検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒7年沒大流行　醫憂重症變多：染71型致死率2成 | ETtoday健康雲 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No major enterovirus outbreak in seven years; doctors fear more severe cases as Enterovirus 71 infections have a 20% fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 (EV71) infection remains a Taiwan concern despite a seven-year lull in large outbreaks. A pair of two-year-old twins highlights the danger: the younger died within two hours of hospital arrival after rapid deterioration; the elder survived with earlier intervention. EV71 can trigger rapid progression to encephalitis and cardiopulmonary failure, with case fatality up to about 20%. About 53% of adult EV infections are asymptomatic, facilitating hidden transmission; fecal-oral shedding can last up to three months, reducing the impact of seven-day school closures. Global context: Japan and Vietnam report rising EV activity, with Vietnam accounting for over half of EV71 circulation and more than 80% of severe cases. Taiwan pediatric experts stress heightened risk in children under six, especially under two. Vaccination is key: three-dose schedule before age two, and two doses for children older than two, aimed at reducing severe disease and death.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒7年沒大流行　醫憂重症變多：染71型致死率2成
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71の高い致死率（20%）、小児への危険性の増加、複数国での発生報告、および公衆衛生上の懸念がIHR基準2項目以上、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はタイワンでのEV71再出現とその危険性を主題としているが、GeoNames対象国リストにはTaiwan（GID不在）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsはVietnamのみ。記事はベトナムのEV71流行（EV71循環の50%以上、重症例の80%以上）を明示的に述べており、対象国内での重要な発生地として計上。日本も言及されているが、検出される特定の症例情報がないため判断は困難。

article.articleHeadline: RSD Gunung Jati Cirebon catat 50 kasus suspek campak selama Januari hingga April 2026 - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSD Gunung Jati Cirebon records 50 suspected measles cases during January through April 2026 - ANTARA News Megapolitan.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases surge at RSD Gunung Jati Cirebon in West Java: about 50 suspected measles patients admitted January–April 2026, predominantly via the emergency department and mostly in severe condition. The district hospital serves as the main measles referral center for Cirebon and surrounding areas. Monthly IGD admissions: January 26, February 19, March 5, totaling around 50 so far; actual community cases likely higher than reflected in hospital admissions. The facility is reinforcing measles management and isolation capacity to curb in-hospital transmission. The pediatric specialist Dr. Suci Saptyuni Permadi notes most admitted children already exhibit severe disease with complications such as bronchopneumonia, otitis media, sepsis, encephalitis, and myocarditis; four patients required intensive care unit transfer. Two toddlers died due to severe complications; immunization is stressed as the primary preventive measure, with the recommended schedule from nine months to under 15 years.

triage.headline_ja: RSD Gunung Jati Cirebon が2026年1月から4月に50例の麻疹疑い症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 西ジャワで約50例の麻疹疑い症例が短期間に集約されており、重症化・死亡事例を含み、IHR基準2つ以上（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外）に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行性、管理可能性の観点から注目すべきシグナル。
triage.notes: West Java（Jawa Barat）の Cirebon 地区の RSD Gunung Jati 病院での集約報告。2026年1月〜4月に約50例の麻疹疑い症例、重症度高く死亡2例を含む。院内感染制御と隔離体制の強化が進行中。ワクチン接種率低下や感染制御不十分の可能性が懸念される。インドネシア国内での追加監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 深圳发现一例罕见传染病，43岁男子确诊人畜共患病"Q热"，医生：主要通过牛羊、猫狗等动物传播_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shenzhen detects a case of a rare infectious disease; a 43-year-old man diagnosed with zoonotic Q fever, doctors say it is mainly transmitted through cattle and sheep, as well as cats and dogs.
article.articleSummary: Q fever, a zoonotic infection caused by Coxiella burnetii, has been confirmed as a single case in a 43-year-old man in Shenzhen, China. In Longhua District's People's Hospital, Mr. Yang experienced a one-week fever unresponsive to antibiotics; imaging showed no focal infection, and rheumatologic, immune, and tumor markers were normal. With elevated inflammatory markers and poor response to antibiotics, an atypical pathogen was suspected; blood metagenomic sequencing identified Coxiella burnetii. Q fever, though rare, is zoonotic and mainly transmitted from cattle and sheep and also cats and dogs; human-to-human transmission is rare. High-risk groups include veterinarians, slaughterhouse workers, leather workers, and lab personnel; peak seasons are spring and summer. Doctors advise regular pet health checks and limiting exposure to potential pathogen sources; tick bites from outdoor activity should be treated promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 深圳で希少感染症を検出、43歳男性が人畜共患病「Q熱」と診断、医師：主に牛羊、猫犬などの動物を通じて伝播
triage.triage_reason: Q熱の単一症例報告であり、異常・予想外で重症度はあるが、現時点では明確な国際的拡大リスクまたは著しい公衆衛生への影響が確認されていない。情報は限定的であり、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: Q熱は稀な人獣共通感染症であり、深圳での単一症例報告。記事は医学的観点から興味深いが、現在のところ大規模流行や国際的拡大の兆候はない。患者の臨床経過（抗生物質不応性の発熱）は報告されているが、予後については記載されていない。春夏季の高リスク傾向が指摘されており、季節的な監視が適切である。

article.articleHeadline: Dynamics and ecology of a multistage expansion of Oropouche virus in Brazil - Nature Ecology & Evolution
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus (OROV) expanded in Brazil in 2023–2024 via a two-stage spread: initial rapid rise in Amazonian states Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, Pará, Rondônia, and Roraima, plus parts of Mato Grosso and Maranhão (centered around Manaus), followed by widespread circulation across additional states. Using georeferenced genomes (~500) from 2022–2024 and separate phylogeographic reconstructions for segments L, M, S, the study reveals a maximal wavefront >3,000 km from origin. tMRCA estimates differ by segment (L 2017–2020; M 2016–2019; S 2015–2018) due to reassortment. In 2024, ~46%, 45%, 43% of inferred dispersal events occurred within Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais and Bahia, signaling new areas with no prior sustained circulation. A multiscale expansion includes short-range dispersal and rapid long-distance jumps, likely human-mediated via air travel, with notable isolation-by-distance signals.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるオロポーシェウイルスの多段階拡大の動態と生態 - Nature Ecology & Evolution
triage.triage_reason: オロポーシェウイルスのブラジルでの大規模な地理的拡大（3000km以上）と複数州での新規流行は異常・予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に該当する。しかし記事は科学論文（ゲノム解析研究）であり、現在の公衆衛生緊急性や臨床的重症度の詳細が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はNature誌の学術論文であり、2023-2024年のオロポーシェウイルスの拡大を遡及的にゲノム解析したもの。記事サマリーは疫学的な拡大パターン、地理的スプレッド、ジャンプの可能性を述べているが、現在の患者数、死亡例、臨床重症度、政府対応などの公衆衛生対応に関する具体的情報が不足している。人間・動物・環境への影響が指摘されているが、定量的な被害程度は明記されていない。追加のサーベイランス情報や流行状況の更新を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: सिद्धार्थनगर के 14 गांवों में HIV संक्रमित मिलने से बढ़ी चिंता, विभाग ने शुरू किया अभियान - siddharthnagar hiv 14 villages affected health dept campaign
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern grows after HIV-positive cases detected in 14 villages of Siddharthnagar; the department has launched a campaign.
article.articleSummary: On April 17, 2026, HIV infections were detected across 14 villages in Lotan block, Siddharthnagar district, Uttar Pradesh, prompting a targeted public-health response. About 18 people—spouses and some underage children—have tested positive. In response, the district health department launched screening camps and an awareness drive in the affected villages, linking diagnosed individuals to treatment and providing medications along with counseling to help them maintain normal lives. Lotan CHC in-charge Amit Chaudhary confirmed all identified individuals are being connected to care. Officials emphasize there is no need to panic; early testing and regular treatment enable a normal life. Privacy for patients is protected, and ASHA workers and auxiliary nurse midwives have been instructed to conduct door-to-door outreach. Residents are advised to visit the nearest health center for testing if they have concerns.

triage.headline_ja: シッダールタナガル地区の14村でHIV感染者が検出され懸念が増加。保健部門がキャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: インドの限定地域（ウッタルプラデーシュ州シッダールタナガル地区）での比較的小規模なHIV集団検査結果の報告。重症度や国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクは現時点では低いが、地域公衆衛生への影響と対応状況について続報を要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月の架空のシナリオ設定と思われるが、内容に基づき評価。HIV検査結果自体は異常（14村での同時集団検査による複数陽性例）であり、現地保健当局による適切な対応（スクリーニングキャンプ、啓発活動、治療連携）が報告されている。死亡率や重症度に関する情報は記事に含まれていない。インド国内の限定的な地域情報であり、国際的拡大やIHR通知の要件は現時点では満たされない。引き続き同地域での感染動向と対応成果の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kota Cirebon Diserang Campak Jerman, Status KLB Bikin Pemkkot Lakukan Ini |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cirebon City Struck by Rubella (German Measles); Outbreak Status Prompts City Government to Take These Steps
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak (KLB) declared in Cirebon City on 20 February 2026 after confirmed spread across five districts; 22 kelurahan surveyed with varying involvement in cases, rubella (German measles) mentioned in context. To curb transmission, the Health Office launched Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) for ages 9 months–13 years across schools, posyandu, and puskesmas, regardless of prior immunization, accompanied by rapid community surveys. ORI was extended by one week due to shortfall, then followed by a catch-up campaign (CUC) until targets were met. 2025 data show 238 suspected measles cases, 44 laboratory-confirmed. By week 13 of 2026 (as of 4 April), 150 suspected and 9 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak trend is waning, but the KLB remains until two incubation periods without new cases (14 days per period; 28 days total); status may end only after 28 days with no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: シレボン市でドイツ麻疹に襲われ、KLB（流行警報）ステータスが市政府にこれらの措置を実施させている
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹とルベラの同時発生、複数地区での確認、ORI（アウトブレイク対応予防接種）実施による公式な流行対応が行われており、IHR基準（異常性・公衆衛生影響）及びWPRO基準（異常性・流行性・管理対応の必要性）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア語で、シレボン市での麻疹・ルベラの流行（KLB）を報告。2026年2月20日に公式に宣言されており、複数地区への拡大、実験室確認例の存在、政府による積極的な対応（ORI、CUC実施）が記述されている。流行は沈静化傾向だが、28日間新規患者なしまで継続と規定されている。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒71型奪命快　醫：鄰近國家仍有勿輕忽 | 生活 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus 71 kills quickly; doctors warn: neighboring countries still have cases—do not ignore.
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 (EV71) poses ongoing risk for Taiwan, yet domestic surveillance shows no EV71 activity and the outbreak is not underway. This year, Taiwan’s surveillance reports circulating enteroviruses as Coxsackie A6, A16, and A4; EV71 has not been detected, with last year only three mild EV71-positive samples. The last major EV71 outbreak in Taiwan was in 1998, causing 78 deaths and 405 severe cases; 2019 saw no sustained circulation, and COVID-19 measures reduced transmission. Neighboring Vietnam reports large EV71-associated HFMD activity, with 107,000 HFMD cases last year and EV71 positivity >40%; this year 25,000 cases with EV71 positivity >56%. EV71 can cause encephalitis and cardiopulmonary failure, with fatality up to 20%, and many infections in adults asymptomatic. Children under 6, especially under 2, are high risk. Authorities advocate early vaccination before age 6 and proactive protection rather than passive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒71型奪命快　醫：鄰近國家仍有勿輕忽
triage.triage_reason: 台湾では現在EV71活動なし、但しベトナムで大規模なHFMD活動と高いEV71陽性率が報告されており、地域的リスク懸念がある。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾はBluedetが発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではEV71活動が現在認められておらず、主要な関心はベトナムの大規模HFMD活動（25,000症例、EV71陽性>56%）に向けられている。台湾は警戒・啓発段階と判断される。ベトナムのEV71流行は重症度が高く（致死率最大20%、小児<2才で特に重症化リスク）、かつ継続的曝露リスクがあるため、PICKUP基準を満たす可能性があるが、ベトナムは現在対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に記載。情報が限定的（ベトナムの管理体制の詳細不明、台湾での封じ込め状況の詳細不明）なため、より詳細な情報を待つ必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bengaluru Bird Flu Alert: H5N1 Virus Outbreak At Hesaraghatta Poultry Farm, Staff Quarantined
article.articleSummary: As of 17 April 2026, Bengaluru authorities issued a bird flu alert after H5N1 was detected at a state-run poultry farm in Hesaraghatta, Karnataka. Virus confirmed in the first round of testing, prompting immediate containment measures. All chickens at the affected farm were culled and buried in a designated pit to prevent further spread. Staff involved in transporting poultry have been placed under quarantine. Government veterinary officers issued inspection notices to nearby panchayats to check surrounding farms, sheds, and shops for early signs of infection. The outbreak has been traced to the Hesaraghatta facility, which is a major supplier of chickens to the state. Officials noted intense summer heat may have contributed to the outbreak, and authorities remain on high alert for additional cases.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール鳥インフルエンザ警報：ヘサラガッタ養鶏場でH5N1ウイルスが発生、職員が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: H5N1ウイルスの確認された人獣共通感染症であり、IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクが明確。インド国内での既知の発生地での確認であり、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行性が懸念される。シグナル拾い上げが適切。
triage.notes: H5N1ウイルスはWHO監視対象の高病原性鳥インフルエンザ。養鶏場での確認であり、人への感染リスクも存在。既に殺処分と隔離措置が実施されているが、主要供給元の施設での発生であるため、地域流通への影響が懸念される。夏季の高温環境が拡大を助長する可能性もあり、今後の動向監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Gana'da Mpox Vakaları Artıyor - Son Dakika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases on the rise in Ghana - Breaking News
article.articleSummary: As of 17 April 2026, mpox (monkeypox) in Ghana has reached 1,062 cases with 8 deaths. The Ghana Health Service (GHS) reports the virus is circulating in all 16 regions, with ongoing surveillance to curb further spread. The country previously noted first detections on 19 May 2025 in four people and the first mpox-related death on 28 July 2025. A vaccination campaign targeting high-risk groups is continuing to reduce transmission. The report highlights sustained region-wide monitoring and immunization efforts in response to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナでMpox患者数が増加中 - 速報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、異常性）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさで該当。ガーナ国内での継続的なMpox流行は関心の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年4月17日現在、ガーナで1,062例の確定患者と8例の死亡が報告されており、全16地域で流行していると明記。2025年5月初検出、7月初死亡例以降の継続的な流行状況。ワクチン接種キャンペーンも実施中。Mpox（特にClade I/II）の複数クレード検出と、アフリカ域内での継続的流行という点で国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Nguyên xử lý buôn bán lợn bệnh trước nguy cơ dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai Nguyen cracks down on the sale of diseased pigs amid the risk of African swine fever
article.articleSummary: Thai Nguyen province, Vietnam, intensified control and enforcement against the sale of diseased pigs amid the risk of African swine fever (ASF). On 17 April 2026 at 16:26, local authorities announced strengthened measures to crack down on the trade of sick swine to prevent ASF introduction or spread. The initiative signals a precautionary public-health response focused on livestock supply chains, aiming to curb potential transmission through markets and transactions involving diseased animals. The report does not indicate confirmed ASF outbreaks or case counts within the province. By prioritizing surveillance and enforcement over response to known cases, Thai Nguyen seeks to reduce infection risk at the source and protect livestock health and pork safety within the region.

triage.headline_ja: タイ グエン省、アフリカ豚熱病のリスク軽減に向けて病気の豚の売却を取り締まり
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのアフリカ豚熱病（ASF）リスクに対する予防的対応が報告されているが、確認された発生やケース数の報告がないため。情報不足の状態で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は確認されたASF症例ではなく、ベトナム・タイグエン省当局による予防的な取り締まり措置と監視強化に焦点を当てている。ASFは家畜に高い感染性を持つため流行リスク基準に該当するが、現時点では確認発生がなく、社会政治的関心度が限定的。続報でアウトブレイク確認時はPICKUPへ昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 深圳男患罕见"Q热" 家中爱犬成染病关键 - 国际 - 国际拼盘
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shenzhen man contracts a rare Q fever; his pet dog at home becomes the key to transmission.
article.articleSummary: On 17 April 2026, a 43-year-old man in Shenzhen's Longhua District developed a week-long fever unresponsive to antimicrobial therapy. Imaging showed no clear infectious foci; inflammatory markers were elevated, raising suspicion of an atypical pathogen. Metagenomic blood pathogen sequencing confirmed Coxiella burnetii, the bacterium causing Q fever. The case linked to domestic animal exposure: the patient frequently buys beef at street markets and keeps dogs at home. Q fever is a rare zoonosis transmitted primarily from mammals to humans, with human-to-human transmission being extremely rare; ticks are a secondary vector. Shenzhen’s infectious-disease specialists advise regular veterinary checks for pets and minimizing exposure to potential pathogens, and to promptly manage tick bites during outdoor activities. The report highlights a pet-associated transmission route as the key factor in this Shenzhen Q fever case.

triage.headline_ja: 深圳の男性が稀なQ熱に感染、自宅のペット犬が感染の鍵に
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは限定的。ただしQ熱は異常な疾患であり、ペット由来の動物感染症として注視の価値がある。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告。Q熱は一般的に稀な人獣共通感染症で、ヒト-ヒト感染はほぼ無い。ペット犬が感染源とされており、動物保健との関連がある。情報不足のため、公衆衛生インパクトと政府の対応状況については不明。現段階ではシグナルピックアップの基準に達していないため、WATCH判定で経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Podcast JR 15 Min #1401 | Doença de Chagas: a ameaça silenciosa que ainda mata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JR 15 Minute Podcast #1401 | Chagas disease: the silent threat that still kills.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health announced an investment of 12 million reais to bolster Chagas disease control in 155 priority municipalities across 17 states. The funding aims to expand surveillance, diagnosis, and vector-control measures, addressing a disease that still affects millions and caused about 4,000 deaths in 2024. Chagas remains a neglected public health challenge, especially in vulnerable regions. The program's impact and pathways to confronting Chagas are analyzed in the JR 15 Minute podcast with infectious disease specialist Hemerson Luz, discussing how enhanced surveillance networks, early case detection, and broader access to care could shape outcomes. The article highlights ongoing challenges and the relevance of sustained public health investment in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: Podcast JR 15 Min #1401 | シャーガス病：依然として人命を奪う静かな脅威
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのシャーガス病対策への公的投資発表で、公衆衛生施策としての関心はあるが、新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく進行中の慢性疾患の既知リスクを扱うポドキャスト。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクは低い。
triage.notes: シャーガス病は慢性的な風土病であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。記事は政府の制御事業と既知の疾患負荷に関するポドキャスト報道。IHR基準では「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当するが、「異常性」「国際的拡大」「制限リスク」には該当しない。社会的・政治的関心（政府投資発表）により情報価値は認められるが、フルRRA実施の優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo cria fundo para proteger pecuaristas e reforçar combate à febre aftosa | Jornal Acontece Botucatu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo sets up a fund to protect cattle ranchers and bolster the fight against foot-and-mouth disease | Jornal Acontece Botucatu.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo will launch Fundesa-PEC (Fundo de Defesa da Sanidade Animal para a Pecuária) in May to accelerate responses to foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) and mitigate producers’ losses from sanitary culling. The state has had no FMD cases for 30 years and aims to remain FMD-free without vaccination to safeguard access to international markets, including Japan and South Korea. Fundesa-PEC functions as a sanitary insurance: producers receive indemnity if culling is required, strengthening financial resilience and outbreak responsiveness. Contributions are mandatory and based on the number of cattle declared in May and November herd updates; for 2026, the estimated rate is R$1.06 per animal. The fund also incentivizes rapid notification of suspected cases, reinforcing São Paulo’s veterinary surveillance and reinforcing its status as a high-standard cattle producer for export markets.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、口蹄疫との戦いを強化するため牧畜業者保護基金を設立
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける口蹄疫対策の制度的強化であり、現在の発生ではなく予防措置である。ただし畜産業への重大な影響、国際市場アクセスとの関連性、および疾患の予防的対応強化に関わることから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は現在の感染症発生ではなく、ブラジル・サンパウロ州における口蹄疫予防のための資金制度（Fundesa-PEC）の立ち上げについて述べている。同州は30年間FMD発生なく、ワクチン非接種のまま国際市場アクセスを維持するという戦略的背景がある。Bluedot APIが日本・韓国を発生地域として付与しているが、サマリーはあくまでブラジルでの予防的対応であり、これらの国での発生は記述されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 一针采血15人诊所甩锅员工难服众 居民担忧传染风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One-needle blood draw at a 15-person clinic; staff scapegoated, public not placated; residents worry about infection risk.
article.articleSummary: Hangzhou's Binjiang District reports a charity outreach at a local clinic where about 15 residents underwent blood draws using a single needle. Residents questioned whether the needle was replaced; staff said it was, but discarded-needle evidence appeared missing in the trash. The clinic says the incident occurred a few days ago during a free community service; it has since conducted medical checkups and administered HIV post-exposure prophylaxis injections and hepatitis B vaccine to participants. The employer fired the employee responsible, attributing the lapse to busy conditions and the use of a non-professional for phlebotomy. The Binjiang District Health Commission is investigating; community staff say the outreach was organized by property management with community cooperation. Some residents demanded large compensation for mental distress, which the clinic declined. No infections have been confirmed, but concerns about HIV or hepatitis B transmission persist.

triage.headline_ja: 一針採血15人診療所責任転嫁で住民納得せず 感染リスク懸念
triage.triage_reason: 不衛生な採血行為による複数人のHIV・B型肝炎曝露の可能性が報告され、異常性と公衆衛生的懸念が高い。地域保健当局が調査中で、社会的関心が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事では杭州市濱江区のコミュニティ医療機関で約15人が同一針での採血を受けた事案が報告されている。血液媒介感染（HIV・B型肝炎）の感染リスクがあり、保健当局による調査が進行中。現在のところ確認された感染者なし。非職業的採血者による医療行為の過失が原因とされ、社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 武汉病毒所、广州国家实验室等团队 | 16年揭示蝙蝠病毒共生机制：SARS相关冠状病毒共感染真相_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wuhan Institute of Virology, Guangzhou National Laboratory and other teams | 16 years to reveal the bat virus symbiosis mechanism: The truth about co-infection with SARS-related coronavirus
article.articleSummary: From 2004–2019, a joint study by the Wuhan Institute of Virology and Guangzhou National Laboratory examined bats across 10 southern/central Chinese provinces, sampling 9 species and identifying 238 SARS-related coronavirus (SARSr-CoV)–positive specimens; 76 samples underwent metagenomic sequencing. Analyzing individual bats, researchers found co-infections: 19 of 76 SARSr-CoV–positive samples (25%) also harbored other mammal-related viruses. Three co-infection categories: (1) mammal-related viruses co-circulating with SARSr-CoV (bat herpesvirus detected in 67.1% of 51 samples; linked to human beta-herpesvirus 7; alphacoronaviruses; bunyaviruses; small RNA viruses; circoviruses); (2) diet-derived viruses from plants and insects (plant tombusviruses; insect poxviruses); (3) microbiome-associated viruses (giant amoebal viruses; tailed bacteriophages; Chrysoviridae). Bacteria/fungi detected include Shigella, Salmonella, Listeria, Botulinum-related species, and Cryptococcus (cryptococcosis) in bat samples. The study identified 25 novel viral genomes across six families, including Alphacoronaviruses (HKU2-like; BtRf-AlphaCoV-related), Circoviridae, Dicistroviridae, and Solemoviridae. Implications: potential for coronavirus recombination and cross-species transmission; highlights need for surveillance and risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 武漢ウイルス研究所、広州国家実験室などのチーム | 16年をかけてコウモリウイルスの共生メカニズムを解明：SARS関連コロナウイルスの共感染の真実
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2004～2019年の基礎研究結果の発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・公衆衛生上の緊急事象ではなく、学術的な知見共有に該当する。現在進行する公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは報告されていない。
triage.notes: Bluedotが報告した複数疾患（パラチフス、ボツリヌス毒素、リステリア、COVID-19、腸チフス）は、実際には過去15年間のコウモリ標本中に検出された病原体の科学的発見であり、現在の人間感染症アウトブレイクではない。記事はコウモリの病原体共感染メカニズムに関する基礎研究成果であり、公衆衛生上の対応が必要な事象には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Gia tăng ca bệnh sẩn ngứa do bọ chét, nhiều người tự điều trị sai cách
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising cases of pruritic papules caused by fleas, many people self-medicate incorrectly.
article.articleSummary: Rising cases of flea bite dermatitis are reported in Vietnam, presenting as pruritic erythematous papules with occasional vesicles on exposed skin such as hands, feet, and trunk. Three patients illustrate the pattern: a 20-year-old man; a 50-year-old woman with two weeks of red plaques and vesicles on forearms and legs; and a 7-year-old child with red papules and vesicles on hands, feet, and trunk. Families report fleas—small dark to reddish-brown, wingless, fast-jumping—on pets and in homes. Lesions are 1–2 mm nodules with a vesicular top and may spread or worsen, causing itch and sometimes surrounding inflammation or bullae. Self-medication with unclear topical agents or folk remedies increases infection risk. Dogs and cats harbor fleas; Xenopsylla cheopis (Oriental rat flea) is linked to plague transmission in contexts, and pet fleas can spread tapeworms. Dr. Ha Giang urges medical assessment for pruritic eruptions and proper treatment, plus environmental/pet hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 蚤による痒疹の増加 - 多くの人が不適切な自己治療を行っている
triage.triage_reason: 蚤刺症皮膚炎の集積が報告されているが、ペスト疾患そのものではなく蚤による皮膚炎のみ。記事ではペスト伝播への言及はあるが実際のペスト患者報告はなく、現在の状況は管理可能と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はペスト（Plague）ではなく、蚤刺症皮膚炎（flea bite dermatitis）であり、蚤による皮膚被害の増加と不適切な自己治療を警告する内容。ペスト菌伝播媒介への言及があるが、実際のペスト患者の報告や発症は含まれていない。医学的評価と衛生管理を促すもので、ただちに公衆衛生上の深刻な危機を示唆するものではない。後続情報で実際のペスト感染が確認された場合は迅速に判定を変更する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒71型「多年沒大流行」！醫有2隱憂：重症風險恐增 | 生活焦點 | 要聞 | NOWnews今日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus Type 71: "There hasn't been a major outbreak for many years"! Two concerns for doctors: the risk of severe illness may rise.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising enterovirus activity amid travel-linked risk from Japan and Vietnam, with imported cases fueling concern. Since 1998, the first death was an 8-year-old girl who presented with hand-foot-mouth disease and rapidly developed CNS involvement; autopsy confirmed Enterovirus Type 71 (EV71). From 2005–2024, about 80% of severe enterovirus cases in Taiwan were due to EV71, reflecting its highest neuroinvasive risk and potential to cause encephalitis or cardiopulmonary failure; case fatality in severe EV71 can reach 20%. After a lull since 2019, public health authorities worry about immune debt and reintroduction from abroad. As of April, Taiwan’s outbreak shows 3,000 outpatient visits; circulating viruses are Coxsackie A6, A16, and A4, with EV71 not detected yet. The 2019 outbreak included 69 severe cases, 53 EV71 positives. TFDA-approved EV71 vaccine reduces severity or death but has no proven cross-protection; vaccination is self-paid after physician assessment, and ACIP continues to review use.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒71型「多年沒大流行」！醫有2隱憂：重症風險恐增
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのエンテロウイルス71型の活動上昇、日本・ベトナムからの輸入症例によるリスク、および重症化懸念（CFR 20%）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）に複数該当。社会的・医療的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はTaiwan（台湾）の状況が主題だが、Taiwan は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事サマリーではベトナムからの輸入症例リスクが言及されており、ベトナム（対象国）は該当。日本も発生地域に列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは「travel-linked risk from Japan」として台湾への渡航関連リスクとして言及されているのみで、日本国内での流行は記述されていないため除外。2019年以降の沈静化、免疫債務の懸念、ワクチン利用可能性も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: 女孩开颅3次 元凶就在冰箱里 警惕李斯特菌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl undergoes three craniotomies; the culprit is in the fridge—beware of Listeria monocytogenes.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-17, a 23-year-old woman from Shenzhen, Guangdong, Zhang Xiaoxiao, developed Listeria monocytogenes infection from contamination in a home refrigerator, causing severe intracranial infection and brain hemorrhage. She collapsed into a coma and required ECMO, CPR, and endotracheal intubation. By 2026-01-09 she was in Shenzhen Second People’s Hospital ICU with intracranial hematoma, hydrocephalus, fulminant myocarditis, multi-organ failure, disseminated intravascular coagulation, and inferior vena cava thrombosis. After three craniotomies and 52 days, the infection was controlled and cardiac function recovered, though she remained unconscious. The source was refrigerator contamination; Listeria grows best at 4–10°C, earning the nickname “fridge killer.” Earlier cases included a 37‑week pregnant woman infected in May last year causing abortion; a 27‑week pregnant woman in Yueqing (Zhejiang) who drank opened refrigerated milk leading to placental rupture and neonatal septic shock; and a middle-aged man with cardiac arrest. High-risk groups (newborns, pregnant women, elderly, immunocompromised) face 20–50% mortality. Prevention: separate raw/cooked foods, top-shelf storage for ready-to-eat items, regular fridge cleaning, and reheating leftovers.

triage.headline_ja: 女孩开颅3次 元凶就在冰箱里 警惕李斯特菌（女の子が3度の開頭手術、犯人は冷蔵庫に—リステリア菌に警戒を）
triage.triage_reason: リステリア感染症の複数例（散発例）が報告されており、スクリーニング基準「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当する。しかし現在のところ、公式な集団発生（クラスター）の宣言やIHR基準の国際的拡大リスク明記がなく、社会的関心は限定的と判断される。継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は散発的なリステリア感染症の複数例（深圳、浙江省の個別事例）を報告している。食品由来感染（冷蔵庫汚染）の経路が明確だが、感染拡大の報告はなく、現時点では公式な集団発生ではない。しかし妊婦や免疫不全者などハイリスク群での重症例が複数報告されている点は監視対象。国家衛生当局からの公式なアラート確認が得られれば、トリアージを上昇させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Pai de adolescente de 13 anos que morreu por Influenza em Sorocaba acusa hospital de negligência: 'Não pediu nenhum tipo de exame'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Father of a 13-year-old who died of influenza in Sorocaba accuses the hospital of negligence: 'Did not order any kind of test'.
article.articleSummary: A 13-year-old boy, Bryan de Souza Camargo, died on April 6 in Sorocaba, São Paulo, from influenza A infection. His family alleges medical negligence at Hospital AmheMed, claiming no tests were ordered and that initial chest-pain symptoms were dismissed as muscle pain from device use. Symptoms began March 29; first visit to a pediatric urgent care on March 30 reportedly involved no diagnostic tests. On April 1, a subsequent visit included a chest X-ray with no noted abnormalities, and no hemogram was ordered at that time. He then developed vomiting and shortness of breath, was escalated to the emergency department and transferred to the ICU. A hemogram reportedly confirmed influenza A. He stayed in hospital five days before death. Sorocaba has recorded five influenza deaths in 2026, with Bryan the youngest. The hospital issued condolences and said an internal review found no deviations; the family is considering legal action.

triage.headline_ja: ソロカバで15歳のインフルエンザで亡くなった少年の父親が病院の過失を非難：「いかなる種類の検査も命じなかった」
triage.triage_reason: 小児死亡事例は重症性を示唆するが、単一事例であり、疾患の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは明確でない。医療過失に関する社会的関心は存在するが、感染症クラスターの証拠が不足。
triage.notes: ブラジル（サンパウロ州ソロカバ）での小児インフルエンザA死亡事例。当該地域で2026年に5件のインフルエンザ死亡が記録されているが、社会的関心は医療過失論争に集中。季節性インフルエンザとしては予想内。クラスター発生の証拠不足のため、単一重症事例の報告と判断し、WATCHレベルに設定。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Supergripe avança no Brasil e vacinação é reforçada - Diário News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Superflu spreads in Brazil and vaccination is being stepped up - Daily News
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-17, Brazil is experiencing a surge of influenza A (H3N2) variant nicknamed 'Gripe K', associated with higher transmissibility and severity across regions, increasing hospitalizations and deaths. Elderly and unvaccinated individuals are at greater risk of progression to severe disease requiring extended hospital care. Vaccination via the SUS remains free, with emphasis on seniors, children, pregnant individuals, and those with comorbidities. Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases are rising due to influenza, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), and rhinoviruses; Fiocruz monitors weekly. In children, RSV affects infants and those up to two years old, contributing nearly 20% of SRAG cases. Over the last four weeks, rhinovirus detections led SRAG cases (40.8%), followed by influenza (32.7%) and RSV (19.9%); fatalities were influenza (43.7%), rhinovirus (27.3%), and COVID-19 (25%). Gripe K has been detected nationwide; the vaccine does not include this exact strain, but vaccination remains the best protection, with vaccinated individuals infected by Gripe K showing reduced risk of severe symptoms per Butantan.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーインフルエンザがブラジルで拡大し、ワクチン接種が強化されている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザA（H3N2）「Gripe K」の急速な拡大が報告され、入院患者数と死亡者数が増加している。IHR基準は3つ以上該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: ブラジルで「Gripe K」と通称されるH3N2インフルエンザ変異株が全国規模で検出されている。RSVおよび鼻ウイルスとの同時流行も報告されており、複数の呼吸器ウイルスによるSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例の増加が認識されている。死亡例も報告されており、特に高齢者と未接種者が重症化リスクが高い。フルのRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bat-borne virus sparks pandemic fears in Asia
article.articleSummary: West Bengal, India reports five Nipah virus cases linked to a private hospital; at least five healthcare workers infected and about 110 contacts quarantined. The outbreak centers on a hospital where two nurses and a doctor were affected; one nurse remains critically ill with high fever and respiratory symptoms between New Year’s Eve and January 2. There is no approved Nipah vaccine or specific antiviral. Nipah has a fatality rate of 40-75% per WHO; it is a zoonotic virus carried by fruit bats and, in some outbreaks, pigs, and can spread from animals to humans and, in some cases, between people—especially caregivers. No cases outside India yet. Thailand and Nepal have begun airport/entry screenings for arrivals from West Bengal; Taiwan plans to classify Nipah as Category 5 notifiable; Kerala travel alert Level 2 yellow remains in effect. Phuket International Airport has stepped up cleaning due to direct flights from West Bengal.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリ由来ウイルスがアジアでパンデミック懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染症は高い致死率（40-75%）を持つzoonotic diseaseであり、医療施設での集団発生（医療従事者含む5例以上、約110人の接触者隔離）、国際的な検疫強化対応、複数国での国境スクリーニング実施など、IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、インド（ウエストベンガル州及びケーララ州）で確認された実際の集団発生が主題。タイ及びネパールは検疫強化など対応段階。台湾は分類予定段階。記事本文内容がないため、サマリーに基づき評価。医療施設内での接触拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性、複数国での国境対応実施が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra a primeira morte por febre amarela em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records the first death from yellow fever in 2026.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state records three yellow fever cases, including a 38-year-old man who died—the first yellow fever fatality in São Paulo in 2026. None of the infected individuals had a yellow fever vaccination. The cases were in the Vale do Paraíba region, with the deceased resident in Cunha. Health authorities underscore vaccination as essential to prevent mosquito-borne infection in forested areas and urge travelers to immunize before visiting risk zones where vectors for yellow fever (and dengue) are present. The update signals ongoing local transmission risk in southeastern Brazil and highlights the need for continued vaccination campaigns and public awareness to avert further deaths in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の黄熱病による初の死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで黄熱病による死亡例が報告され、複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当。局所的な感染の継続が示唆されており、予防接種未実施者による感染リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年の架空の日付を含むが、サンパウロ州での黄熱病死亡例、複数の感染者（予防接種未実施）、およびデング熱ベクターの存在が報告されている。局所的な媒介蚊伝播リスクが継続しており、旅行者への予防接種勧告も発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: Stok vaksin rabies di Lombok Timur aman untuk cegah penyebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies vaccine stock in East Lombok is sufficient to prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine stock in East Lombok Regency, West Nusa Tenggara (NTB), Indonesia, remains sufficient to prevent transmission from animals in the area. Health officials say vaccines are administered to anyone bitten by potentially rabies-carrying animals (dogs, monkeys, cats) according to procedure. Through March 2026, 52 cases of wild-animal bites have been recorded in East Lombok in early 2026, with 159 such bites reported in 2025; there is no indication of human rabies so far. A child died following a bite by a stray dog on 13 April 2026, but authorities have not confirmed rabies status, as the dog reportedly disappeared. Lombok Timur Dinkes confirms vaccine stock is safe and available at each primary health center (puskesmas) and that vaccine supply is routinely maintained for ongoing prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ロンボク東部の狂犬病ワクチン在庫は感染拡大防止に十分
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで動物咬傷関連の狂犬病イベントが報告されており、4月に小児死亡例の可能性があるが、当局は狂犬病の確認をしておらず、現時点での感染の確認や国際的な拡大の兆候がない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は動物咬傷に関連した狂犬病のリスク管理に焦点を当てており、人間への感染確認はない。4月13日の小児死亡例は狂犬病の確認が取れていない。継続的な動物からの曝露リスクが存在するため、スクリーニング基準で「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当。ただし、IHR基準には該当せず、重症度や異常性の情報も不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 南韓忠清南道爆禽流感　涉事地區禽產品禁進口香港
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza outbreak in Chungcheongnam-do, South Korea; Hong Kong bans imports of poultry products from the affected area.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 has been reported in Nonsan City, Chungcheongnam-do, South Korea. Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety has immediately suspended imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from the affected area to protect public health. Last year, Hong Kong imported about 380 metric tons of frozen/chilled poultry meat and around 30.7 million eggs from South Korea. The Centre has contacted Korean authorities and will continue to monitor updates from the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and relevant authorities, adjusting measures as the local outbreak evolves. The report provides no details on infection sources or laboratory confirmation beyond the OIE notification.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国忠清南道で鳥インフルエンザ拡大　香港が該当地域からの家禽製品の輸入禁止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの発生で、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、貿易制限）の複数該当、およびWPRO基準（異常性、国際対応の必要性）に該当するシグナルと判定。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRepublic of Korea（韓国）が含まれているが、対象国リストに韓国は含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし香港（中国に含める）での輸入禁止措置が実施されており、中国の食品安全対応が関連している。H5N1は既知の高リスク病原体であり、国際貿易への影響も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Le commerce d'animaux sauvages fait monter en flèche les risques de transmission de virus à l'homme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The wildlife trade is driving up the risk of virus transmission to humans.
article.articleSummary: Wildlife trade increases the risk of human pathogen transmission, according to a Science study published April 9, 2026. Analyzing 1980–2019 trade data for 2,079 wild mammal species, the study found 41% shared at least one human pathogen, versus 6.4% of non-commercialized mammals. The risk is higher for illegal trade, but legal trade also elevates exposure; duration of trade is a key factor: on average, a wild mammal species would introduce an additional pathogen to humans every 10 years it remains in global wildlife trade. A historical example: in 2003, six US Midwest states reported 71 human monkeypox cases linked to prairie dogs sold as pets after exposure to Gambian pouched rats imported from Ghana. The findings may illuminate COVID-19 origins at Wuhan’s Huanan Market in late 2019; pangolins were cleared in 2024 by CNRS, with two other animals implicated.

triage.headline_ja: 野生動物の取引がウイルスのヒトへの感染リスクを急増させている
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（2003年米国事例）とCOVID-19（武漢起源仮説）に関連する野生動物取引由来の感染症リスク増加を論じた科学研究報告。複数国・複数疾患に関連し、国際的に拡大するリスクと予想外性がある。
