triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月17日付け（未来日付）。2003年米国Mpox事例（ガンビアネズミ→プレーリードッグ経由）と武漢Huanan市場のCOVID-19起源仮説が言及されている。2019-2026年の取引データ分析とリスク評価研究。China（武漢）とGhana（ガンビアネズミ輸入元）が verified_locations。米国の事例記載があるが、当該記事の主題はグローバルな野生動物取引リスク分析のため、発生地域の米国は主題地域ではなく verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 10.000 Hewan Kurban di Gresik Sudah Divaksin PMK Sambut Iduladha 2026, Cegah PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10,000 Eid al-Adha Sacrificial Animals in Gresik Vaccinated Against Foot-and-Mouth Disease Ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026, to Prevent Foot-and-Mouth Disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK) vaccines have been administered to 10,000 cattle and goats in Gresik Regency, East Java, ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026 on May 27. The vaccination drive by the Gresik Dinas Pertanian aims to safeguard sacrificial animals and reassure worshippers. As of 17 April 2026, 10,000 animals have completed PMK vaccination, part of Eid preparedness. In addition to vaccination, officials urge buyers to choose healthy animals, excluding those with lameness, blindness, illness, or severe thinness (P3K). Animals should carry a Surat Keterangan Kesehatan Hewan (SKKH) health certificate certifying health inspection and vaccination. For guidance, the public can consult UPT Puskeswan North and South. The program underscores PMK prevention to minimize disease risk during Eid al-Adha.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年イード・アル＝アドハーを前にグレシック地域の10,000頭の犠牲動物が口蹄疫(PMK)の予防接種を完了—口蹄疫の予防のため
triage.triage_reason: 本件は予防的な動物ワクチン接種プログラムの報告であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: このニュースは感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、インドネシアの地方自治体による計画的な動物衛生対策（予防接種キャンペーン）の報道である。既に感染が報告されていない状況での予防措置であるため、感染症危機管理のスクリーニング対象外と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda a infecção que levou à morte de padre desaparecido em Salvador
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand the Infection That Led to the Death of the Missing Priest in Salvador
article.articleSummary: Death of priest Elmo Andrade de Souza, 62, in Salvador, Bahia, after a fatal generalized infection from bullous erysipelas linked to a skin lesion. Last seen April 15 in the São Cristóvão neighborhood; death confirmed April 16, while hospitalized at Hospital Teresa de Lisieux. Bullous erysipelas is a bacterial skin and lymphatic infection, usually due to Streptococcus species, and severe forms can progress rapidly to sepsis, particularly in the elderly with circulatory problems or skin breaks. Early symptoms include high fever, chills, malaise, intense skin redness, edema, pain, and blister formation; diagnosis is clinical, with labs or imaging as needed. Treatment uses antibiotics, oral or intravenous, with hospitalization for extensive disease or septic risk. Prevention focuses on skin care and control of chronic conditions such as diabetes and venous insufficiency.

triage.headline_ja: 失踪した神父の死亡につながった感染症を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発的な死亡事例であり、集団発生や異常な流行パターンの兆候がない。Streptococcusによる丹毒は既知で予防可能な感染症であり、IHR基準またはWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の散発的な死亡事例（バイア州サルバドール在住の神父）を報道しており、集団発生の兆候がない。丹毒（bullous erysipelas）は既知のStreptococcus感染症であり、高齢者や基礎疾患のある者では重篤化する可能性があるが、本件は孤発事例であるため公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルとは判定されない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu in Bengaluru? H5N1 virus detected in Hesaraghatta poultry centre; no need for panic, says Dinesh Gundu Rao
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza detected at a poultry training centre in Muthkur village, Hesaraghatta, near Bengaluru, Karnataka. Lab confirmation came on 14 April 2026 from the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal. Containment measures have been initiated per protocol. Rapid response teams at state, district, and Primary Health Centre levels visited the site on 16 April 2026 to assess and implement controls. Officials say there is no need for panic. The event underscores routine animal health surveillance and formal NIHSAD-confirmed avian influenza findings in poultry, with government-led containment actions and ongoing monitoring to guide next steps.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール鳥インフルエンザ？ヘサラガッタ養鶏センターでH5N1ウイルスを検出。パニックは不要とディネシュ・グンドゥ・ラオ州議員
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確定検査陽性で異常/予想外の事象。公式機関（NIHSAD）による確認済みで、迅速な対応体制が整備されている。インドは対象国で、WPRO基準（異常性・曝露継続の可能性・流行リスク）および社会的関心の複数該当によりピックアップが妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はベンガルール（カルナタカ州）およびボパール（NIHSAD確認機関の所在地）の両地点を言及しており、いずれもインド国内。2026年4月14日にNIHSADで確定検査が実施され、4月16日に迅速対応チームが現地調査を実施。家畜感染事象であるが、H5N1の人獣共通感染リスク、食料安全保障への影響、および国内他地域への拡大リスクなどの観点からモニタリング継続が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 20岁女学霸染上艾滋，曾多次见网友，大学校园已变成艾滋病温床_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 20-year-old straight-A female student contracted HIV after meeting online partners several times; the university campus has become a breeding ground for AIDS.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-04-17: A 20-year-old female student at a Chinese top-tier university is diagnosed HIV-1 antibody positive after multiple meetups with online partners. The narrative frames the university campus as an AIDS breeding ground. A high-achieving student, under strict parental pressure and intense study, turns to anonymous dating apps to fill emotional voids. Over several months she meets several online partners; the most prominent, 'Chen Zhe,' is a 26-year-old UI designer who travels to her city, takes her to a private restaurant, and then to a riverside hotel. Under a wine-lit mood, he kisses her, and the moment is interrupted by her question: 'Are you prepared for that?' The account underscores risk factors associated with online dating and the personal toll of an HIV diagnosis on a young student.

triage.headline_ja: 20歳の女学生がHIVに感染、複数回オンライン交際相手に会った；大学キャンパスがエイズの温床に
triage.triage_reason: 中国での個別のHIV感染例の報道。公衆衛生上の重大な影響や国際的拡大リスクは明確でなく、異常性も限定的だが、大学キャンパスでの感染リスク環境という社会的関心のある内容。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 個別事例の報道であり、集団発生や流行の兆候は記事から明確でない。ただしオンライン交際アプリを介した感染リスクとキャンパス環境での感染可能性が社会的関心を集めている。流行性疾患としての異常性は低いが、若年層への啓発機会として注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: DPRD Jatim Dorong Gerakan TOSS TBC, Warga Diminta Waspada Batuk Lebih 2 Minggu - Surya.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Java DPRD Pushes TOSS TB Campaign, Residents Urged to Be Vigilant for Coughs Lasting More Than Two Weeks - Surya.co.id
article.articleSummary: East Java's DPRD pushes strengthening the national Find Treat Until Sembuh (TOSS) TB campaign to curb tuberculosis in Jawa Timur. The program covers case finding, diagnosis, treatment, and ensuring full cure to interrupt transmission. Residents are urged to seek testing if a cough lasts at least two weeks. TB treatment typically lasts a minimum of six months and must not be interrupted. Indonesia remains a high TB-burden country, with WHO and the Ministry of Health targeting elimination by 2030, underscoring the need for public vigilance and patient adherence. East Java official Sri Wahyuni notes many infections go undetected; timely testing is critical. The Bojonegoro-Tuban electoral district is cited as the representative area of concern. Data from the Health Ministry confirm Indonesia's global TB burden, highlighting ongoing efforts to combat spread.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャワDPRDがTOSS結核キャンペーンを推進、市民は2週間以上続く咳に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知感染症で、東ジャワ州での継続的な結核排除キャンペーン報道である。異常性や新規クラスターの証拠がなく、公式な予防啓発活動のための記事であるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に明確には該当しない。ただし、インドネシアは高TB負担国であり、今後の疫学データ変化を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の結核排除キャンペーンの推進報道であり、新規の異常事象ではない。インドネシアの高TB負担国としての地位と継続的な感染リスク（prolonged_exposure、epidemic_prone）が認識されているが、現在のシグナル強度は低い。今後、新規クラスターまたは耐性TB（MDR-TB）の報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: India Gets New Vaccine Tools To Fight Tuberculosis In Adolescents: Not 'A Magic Bullet' But A Good Breakthrough
article.articleSummary: Two India-developed vaccines, VPM1002 ( Serum Institute of India) and Immuvac (Cadila), were evaluated in a Phase III trial in India. The study enrolled over 12,700 participants aged six years and above who were household contacts of recently diagnosed TB patients, conducted at 18 sites across six states. The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) led and funded the independent trial, with results published in BMJ. VPM1002 showed 50.4% efficacy against extra-pulmonary TB at three years; safety was established, but neither vaccine yielded strong protection against all TB or pulmonary TB. Extra-pulmonary TB accounts for about 15–24% of India’s TB burden, is hard to diagnose, and causes significant morbidity. If regulators approve, these vaccines could be added to public programs, marking progress toward prevention in a country bearing ~27 lakh new TB cases and >3 lakh deaths in 2024, and aiming for elimination by 2025.

triage.headline_ja: インドは青少年の結核と闘うための新しいワクチンツールを取得：「万能薬」ではないが良好な進歩
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核ワクチンの臨床試験結果に関する発表であり、新規発生の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、医療介入の進展報告である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本報告は既存感染症に対する予防策の開発進展であり、シグナルトリアージの対象となる「新規・異常な感染症イベント」に該当しない。臨床試験結果の公表は公衆衛生上のポジティブなニュースだが、差し迫ったリスク評価の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Pasien Campak di RSD Gunung Jati Meningkat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles patients at Gunung Jati Regional General Hospital have increased.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases surge at Gunung Jati Regional General Hospital in Cirebon, Indonesia, with 50 patients admitted over three months (26 in January; 19 in February; March total about 50), of whom two under-five children died. One death occurred within 24 hours of admission to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit; symptoms included high fever, dyspnea, and rash. The two fatalities had severe risk factors—malnutrition and a congenital heart defect—and both were not fully vaccinated. An additional six outpatients were treated. The hospital notes rising transmission risk, with potential higher burden at primary care or community levels. Infection-control measures include comprehensive protocols, cohorting, and isolation spaces in each building. Bronchopneumonia is the most common severe complication. Adolescent transmission observed due to intrafamily spread from unvaccinated younger siblings. Vaccination at 9 months, 18 months, and school-entry booster is emphasized to reduce severity.

triage.headline_ja: グヌン・ジャティ地域総合病院での麻しん患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの医療施設における3ヶ月間での麻しん患者数の急増（3月約50人）と小児死亡2例（5歳未満）が確認され、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例）、流行しやすさ（ワクチン未接種、家族内感染）、継続的曝露リスクが認められ、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、発生地はインドネシア（Jawa Barat州のCirebon地域）で確定。3ヶ月間での患者急増、小児死亡2例、ワクチン未接種者の関与、家族内感染による思春期への波及、医療施設での感染制御対策実施中など、複数のWPRO基準を満たす。麻しんはワクチン予防可能疾患であり、予防接種カバー率の低さが背景にある可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: OAB-PI e CAAPI imunizam mais de 1,5 mil pessoas contra a Influenza em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: OAB-PI and CAAPI immunize more than 1,500 people against influenza in Teresina.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination drive in Teresina, Brazil: The Order of Attorneys of Brazil, Piauí section (OAB Piauí) in partnership with the CAAPI launched the 2026 Campaign to Vaccinate Piauiense Lawyers, conducting a drive-thru clinic at the association's Teresina headquarters on April 14-15. A total of 1,530 doses of the trivalent influenza vaccine (influenza A and B) were administered to lawyers, trainees, dependents, and CAAPI/ESA Piauí staff. The initiative provided free protection to the legal community ahead of the municipal campaign's expansion to the general population. In Teresina, public vaccination follows the National Immunization Program and prioritizes vulnerable groups such as children, the elderly, pregnant individuals, and post-partum women. The effort is part of broader health measures for professionals in the state of Piauí, with the campaign set to continue to the interior.

triage.headline_ja: OAB-PIとCAAP、テレジーナでインフルエンザワクチン1,500人以上に投与
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはブラジルにおけるインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事象ではなく、通常のルーチン予防接種活動である。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、危機対応が必要な感染症危機の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、インフルエンザの発生・流行を示す疾患監視信号ではない。通常のパブリックヘルス活動のニュース報道に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Alertan por virus asociado al consumo de mariscos que podría causar ceguera: ¿de cuál se trata?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning About a Virus Linked to Seafood Consumption That Could Cause Blindness: Which One Is It?
article.articleSummary: Hidden Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV), a aquatic nodavirus linked to seafood, may infect humans and cause vision-threatening disease. A Nature Microbiology study in the United States analyzed 70 patients with anterior viral uveitis with persistent ocular hypertension (POH-VAU), finding CMNV present in ocular tissues and blood. Notably, 71.4% reported frequent exposure to seafood (shrimp, fish and other aquatic products). Researchers describe a zoonotic risk, likely through consumption of raw or undercooked seafood and direct handling of marine animals without protection. While cases have emerged in China and other Asian regions, CMNV transmission is not currently a global health emergency or pandemic. CMNV was first detected in 2014, causing economic losses in the shrimp industry and affecting multiple aquatic species; it is widely distributed in aquatic ecosystems. Recommendations: ensure seafood is well cooked, avoid questionable raw products, wear gloves, and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 海産物の消費に関連するウイルスについての警告：失明を引き起こす可能性があるウイルスとは？
triage.triage_reason: Hidden Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV)は新規の人獣共通感染症で、眼部組織への感染例が報告されているが、記事では「現在グローバルヘルス上の緊急事態またはパンデミックではない」と明記されており、国際的拡大や制限措置のリスクは低い。情報が不足しており継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はCMNVの人獣共通感染症リスクであり、米国での研究報告が中心だが、米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事サマリー内で中国およびアジア地域での症例発生が言及されているため、Chinaのみを verified_locations に含める。重症度や症例数に関する具体的情報が限定的であり、現在のところ流行性感染症としての証拠は弱い。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo da Fiocruz evidencia relação entre dengue e a rara Síndrome de Guillain‑Barré, que afeta os nervos periféricos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz study shows a link between dengue and the rare Guillain-Barré syndrome, which affects the peripheral nerves.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers using the SUS health system data link dengue infection to a markedly higher risk of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS). From 2023–2024, over 5,000 GBS hospitalizations occurred, with 89 cases identified soon after dengue. A self-controlled case-series analysis shows GBS risk is about 17-fold higher 1–6 weeks after dengue onset, peaking near 30-fold in the first two weeks and returning to baseline after six weeks. Absolute risk is roughly 36 GBS cases per 1 million dengue infections. GBS is an immune-mediated weakness starting in the legs and potentially progressing to arms and face, sometimes requiring ventilatory support. Early treatment with intravenous immunoglobulin or plasmapheresis, available in SUS, improves outcomes; Brazil operates 136 specialized rehabilitation centers. Prevention centers on Aedes aegypti control and dengue vaccination (in SUS since 2024 with expanding age targets), plus Wolbachia vector-control pilots in some cities.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz研究により、デング熱と末梢神経に影響を与える稀なギラン・バレー症候群との関連が明らかになる
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とギラン・バレー症候群の因果関係を示すブラジルの重要な疫学研究報告。公衆衛生への影響が深刻（5,000件以上のGBS入院、デング後のGBS相対リスク17倍）であり、予想外の臨床所見である。
triage.notes: デング熱との関連性が確立された稀な神経合併症(GBS)に関する疫学的証拠。ブラジルは十分な医療インフラ（SUS、136の専門リハビリ施設）を有しており、外部支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。しかし、公衆衛生への重大な影響と予防戦略の重要性からピックアップ推奨。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Alert Near Bengaluru: Containment Zones Set Up After H5N1 Detected in Hesaraghatta
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza detected in Mattikere village near Hesaraghatta on Bengaluru's outskirts, Karnataka. Emergency containment zones established: 3-km infected zone and 10-km surveillance zone. 7,444 birds culled and 14,788 eggs disposed. Rapid Response Teams deployed; staff under medical observation. Door-to-door monitoring launched in 19 nearby villages; residents will be screened for fever and other flu-like symptoms over the next 10 days. No human cases reported; authorities advise against touching sick/dead birds and to report them. Government says properly cooked chicken and eggs remain safe to consume; medical supplies stocked at local centers. Infection source not specified; ongoing vigilance and surveillance emphasize containment.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール近郊での鳥インフルエンザ警報：ヘサラガッタでH5N1検出後に封じ込め地域を設置
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人への感染リスク（IHR基準2つ該当：深刻な公衆衛生への潜在的影響、異常/予想外の検出、国際拡大リスク）、および迅速な封じ込め措置が実施されている。インドの都市部での検出であり、監視の厳格化とスクリーニング活動は管理性の課題を示唆。
triage.notes: H5N1は国際的な懸念事項であり、インドの都市部（ベンガルール）での検出は公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。現在のところ人感染例は報告されていないが、ウイルスの存在、密集した鳥の個体数、19村での住民スクリーニング実施により、ヒト感染の潜在的リスクが存在。当局の迅速な対応（7,444羽の殺処分、10日間の戸別訪問監視、医学的観察）は懸念のレベルを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Under CM Bhagwant Mann, Punjab's Friday Dengue Attack Begins - Health Minister Appeals to Public
article.articleSummary: Punjab, India launches a weekly dengue crackdown under CM Bhagwant Mann with the campaign 'Har Shukarvaar Dengue Te Vaar' to curb dengue spread before the monsoon. Health Minister Dr Balbir Singh urged public participation, stressing community-led prevention and removal of mosquito breeding sites, such as stagnant water in coolers, flower pots, and tanks. The government aims to make Punjab dengue-free by 2026 and is boosting testing facilities, offering free diagnostics, and expanding healthcare access to support surveillance and on-ground readiness. Recent data show dengue cases in Punjab fell from more than 23,000 in 2021 to about 5,000 in 2025, with deaths declining as well. A new concern is rural spread, extending beyond cities, underscoring the need for awareness and early prevention through weekly actions and local involvement to reduce cases and save lives in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: CM Bhagwant Mannの下でパンジャブ州の金曜日デング熱対策が開始 - 保健大臣が国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は既知の風土病で、患者数は減少傾向（2021年23,000件→2025年5,000件）にある。ただし農村部への拡大という新たな懸念があり、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は既知の風土病であり、患者数は減少傾向にある。記事は政府のキャンペーンと予防策を強調しており、緊急性は低い。ただし農村部への拡大が新たな関心事として言及されているため、WATCH段階で注視することが適切。情報の詳細さと国際的な懸念の欠如により、フルRRAの対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Tangani KLB campak, Sulteng mulai berikan vaksin MR untuk nakes - ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tackling a measles outbreak, Central Sulawesi begins administering the MR vaccine to healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: Central Sulawesi health authorities initiated MR (Measles-Rubella) vaccination for 7,964 healthcare workers and internship physicians at RSUDs across Sulawesi Tengah, targeting frontline staff amid districts with measles outbreak status. The Central Sulawesi Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Sulteng) said on Friday, 17 April, that 2,060 vials of measles vaccine are available for distribution to regencies and cities. The MR vaccine campaign aims to bolster immunity among health workers and curb transmission as measles activity continues in the region. The report does not provide case counts or fatalities. This measure reflects intensified public health efforts to control the outbreak, with provincial vaccine stocks designated for broad distribution to districts and municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: 中部スラウェシ、麻疹アウトブレイク対策として医療従事者へのMRワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア中部スラウェシで麻疹アウトブレイクが確認されており、予防接種強化キャンペーンが実施されている。異常性と重症度・疫学的特性に該当する可能性があるが、症例数・死亡数などの詳細情報が記事に記載されていないため、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中部スラウェシにおける麻疹アウトブレイク対応として、医療従事者への予防接種キャンペーン開始を報じている。症例数・死亡数など重症度の客観的指標が記載されていないため、フルRRA前段階の情報としては不足。麻疹は予防可能感染症であり、ワクチン接種による対応が進んでいることは肯定的だが、アウトブレイクの規模・進行状況の詳細確認が必要。続報によって判定変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 20:27:57「診所1個針頭給15人採血」，杭州通報：涉事診所已停業整頓，隨訪受檢測人員
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 20:27:57 "One needle used to draw blood from 15 people at a clinic," Hangzhou reports: the involved clinic has ceased operations for rectification, with follow-up for those tested.
article.articleSummary: On April 10, 2026, in Hangzhou's Binjiang District, the Zhonghe (Hangzhou) Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic provided free blood glucose testing at a community event using a single needle that was reportedly reused, testing 15 residents and prompting infection-control concerns. Investigators found the on-site staff lacked appropriate medical qualifications and violated finger-prick blood collection norms. The Health Bureau conducted follow-up: on April 11, tested residents were referred to a provincial hospital for blood-borne disease screening; all results were negative. The clinic has been closed for rectification, with penalties including warnings and fines under relevant laws; illegal practice by a non-health professional and reuse of disposable medical devices were cited. Authorities will continue post-event surveillance with health checks at 1, 3, and 6 months. Media reports claimed AIDS post-exposure prophylaxis and hepatitis B vaccination were provided, though official results remained negative and regulatory actions ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 「1本の針で15人の採血」、杭州が報告：問題の診所は営業停止・整備中、フォローアップ検査実施
triage.triage_reason: B型肝炎を含む血液由来感染症への曝露事例であり、公衆衛生的な懸念は存在するが、当局による迅速な対応と全員の陰性結果により、即座のフルRRA対象とはならない。情報不足（継続サーベイランス結果の明確化）のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 杭州の診所での医療機器の不適切な再利用により15人がB型肝炎を含む血液由来病原体に曝露。初期検査は全員陰性だが、検査窓期の問題と継続サーベイランス（1・3・6ヶ月）が進行中。今後の検査結果が陽性例を示す場合は速やかにPICKUPへ昇格すべき。香港メディア報道のため検証必須。

article.articleHeadline: Vom Zootier bis zum Heimtier: Impfungen schützen / Welttag der Tierimpfung: Zooverband warnt vor Seuchenrisiken für bedrohte Arten. Abhilfe durch nationale Impfstrategie für Zootiere gefordert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From zoo animals to household pets: Vaccinations protect / World Day for Animal Vaccination: The Zoo Association warns of epidemic risks for endangered species. A national vaccination strategy for zoo animals is demanded.
article.articleSummary: On World Animal Vaccination Day, April 20, the Zoological Gardens Association (VdZ) warns that infectious diseases threaten not only individual animals but endangered species, food security, and human health, calling for a national vaccination strategy for zoo animals. Avian influenza is highlighted as a potential driver of extinction for species like Balistar and Edwards's pheasant, whose wild populations are already precarious in Vietnam due to habitat loss and poaching. Outbreaks such as African swine fever and bluetongue endanger both zoos and livestock, with mass culling common when vaccines are unavailable. The VdZ demands regulatory approval pathways for zoo and wildlife vaccines, national vaccine reserves for endangered taxa, and targeted research funding, plus EU/German guidelines and safe inter-zoo animal exchanges to sustain breeding programs. A One Health approach links animal vaccination to human, environmental, and economic health; Switzerland vaccinated 24 bird species against avian influenza in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 動物園の動物から家庭ペットまで：予防接種で保護 / 世界動物予防接種の日：動物園協会が絶滅危惧種への疫病リスクに警告。動物園動物の国家予防接種戦略が要求されている
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ、アフリカ豚コレラ、ブルータングの複数の獣医感染症が言及されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、記事は主にワクチン戦略と予防措置の呼びかけであり、実際の流行・アウトブレイク事象の報告ではない。ベトナムの絶滅危惧野生種への脅威が言及されているが、現在のアウトブレイク状況は不明確であり、情報不足のため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Animal Vaccination Dayのプレスリリースであり、複数の獣医感染症（鳥インフルエンザ、アフリカ豚コレラ、ブルータングス）の潜在的脅威と予防戦略についての警告である。ベトナムの野生動物への鳥インフルエンザの脅威が具体的に言及されているが、現在進行中の具体的なアウトブレイク事象や患者数・死亡数などの詳細は記事に含まれていない。スイスおよびドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。動物衛生面でのシグナルとしての価値はあるが、ヒトへの直接的な脅威や確認された流行の報告ではないため、WATCHとして要経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: A expansão global do sorotipo SAT1 da febre aftosa acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The global spread of the SAT1 serotype of foot-and-mouth disease raises alarm.
article.articleSummary: SAT1 serotype of foot-and-mouth disease (FMDV) is expanding beyond traditional East and Southern Africa, with detections of two co-circulating subtypes SAT1/I and SAT1/III in West Asia and North Africa by 2025. Global SHIC monitoring led by Dr. Sol Perez (University of Minnesota) indicates increased risk of transboundary introduction to regions previously unaffected, including Southeast Europe. Immunity to FMDV is serotype-specific, and current vaccines targeting serotypes O, A, and Asia-1 do not confer cross-protection against SAT1, leaving animal populations susceptible and enabling rapid spread under the new ecological niche. The spread is linked to international travel, contaminated animal products, and materials. Although the United States remains FMD-free, expanded SAT1 circulation presents more pathways for entry. Calls for enhanced early detection, surveillance, stringent biosecurity along production chains, and flexible vaccination strategies to cover emergent SAT1 subtypes.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫SAT1血清型のグローバル拡大が警報を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1のアフリカから西アジア・北アフリカへの地理的拡大と、従来ワクチンが効かない新興亜型の出現により、国際的な拡大リスク（IHR基準3項目該当）と家畜への深刻な経済的影響が示唆される。米国を含む非流行地域への侵入リスク増加により、動物衛生に関する国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はSAT1血清型の東・南アフリカからの地理的拡大（西アジア、北アフリカへの検出）を報告しており、Bluedot APIの発生地域にはMozambique、Shanghai Shi（中国）が含まれている。記事サマリーではモザンビークは言及されず、中国も監視プログラム実施地として暗示的だが、具体的な発生は西アジア・北アフリカと米国の脅威リスクが主題である。対象国リスト内では China のみが明確に地理的参照として関連しており、Mozambique は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。動物疾病であるが、国際貿易・旅行への影響及び農業経済への重大な影響から、感染症危機管理・バイオセキュリティの観点でのシグナル価値は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: BMC Launches 'Muvvi Trap' To Curb Mosquito Breeding, Target Dengue And Malaria
article.articleSummary: Mumbai's Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has unveiled the Muvvi Trap, an eco-friendly device aimed at breaking the mosquito breeding cycle to curb dengue and malaria. Presented under the SMILE initiative by the Society for Mumbai Incubation Lab to Entrepreneurship, the trap attracts female mosquitoes with a formulated lure and mild insecticides, causing eggs laid in treated water to be destroyed, preventing next-generation mosquitoes. Each trap remains effective for up to four weeks and operates without electricity, making it cost-effective and suitable for residential areas. The BMC notes the materials are safe for humans and envisions integration into broader mosquito-control strategies. Officials expect the technology could help reduce transmission of dengue, malaria, chikungunya, and Zika virus in Mumbai.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ：BMC、蚊の繁殖抑制のため「ムッヴィトラップ」を導入、デング熱とマラリアを対象
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介感染症の予防対策についての記事であり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし、複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング、マラリア、チクングニア、ジカ）がインドで言及されているため、動向監視の価値あり。
triage.notes: 本記事は蚊媒介感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、ムンバイにおける予防対策（Muvvi Trap導入）についての報道。ただしデング、マラリア、チクングニア、ジカの4疾患が言及されており、これらが現地で流行懸念のある疾患であることを示唆。政府当局（BMC）が積極的に対策を講じていることが確認でき、インドにおける蚊媒介感染症の環流状況の監視対象として注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Fever Cases Drop in Pematangsiantar, but Children Remain Vulnerable - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: 315 DHF cases in Pematangsiantar City, Indonesia, in 2024 with a 1.59% case fatality rate. Dengue fever cases declined overall, but children remain vulnerable. A study in the International Journal of Health and Environmental Sciences links water-reservoir management to DHF incidence: water containers available associated with lower infection risk (OR 0.088; 95% CI 0.011-0.708); open containers linked to higher risk (OR 0.332; 95% CI 0.167-0.662). Infrequent drainage (<1 per week) raised risk (OR 2.650; 95% CI 1.371-5.122); failing to cover water containers raised risk (OR 2.277; 95% CI 1.148-4.517). In Iloilo province, Philippines, dengue activity from January to September 20 recorded 4,706 infections and 17 deaths, with children aged 1–9 most affected. Officials stress warning signs—persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding gums, lethargy—especially in children. Preventive measures include draining and covering water storage containers, eliminating standing water, and maintaining clean surroundings to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者数がペマタンスシアンタルで減少するも、子どもの脆弱性が残る
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の複数国同時発生（インドネシア・フィリピン）と子どもの死亡事例を含む重症化が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度・流行しやすさ）かつ国境を越えた地域での流行パターンが確認されるため。
triage.notes: インドネシア（ペマタンスシアンタル市）で2024年に315件のデング出血熱（DHF）症例、1.59%の致死率を報告。フィリピン・イロイロ州では2026年1月～9月に4,706感染、17死亡を記録。両国で1～9歳の子どもが最も影響を受けている。Bluedot APIが両国を発生地域として識別しており、記事サマリーでも両国の同時発生が明示的に述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: MS inicia vacinação contra chikungunya com 20 mil doses - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health begins vaccination against Chikungunya with 20,000 doses - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination begins in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 20,000 IXCHIQ doses received from the Ministry of Health amid an ongoing outbreak that has caused 12 deaths in 2026 in the state. Dourados and Itaporã will receive the first shipments, with doses distributed in proportion to local populations. The initial target group includes people 18–59 years, prioritizing health professionals and indigenous populations most affected. IXCHIQ is a live attenuated vaccine; recipients include pregnant and puerperal, immunocompromised, and those with decompensated chronic diseases face restrictions. The vaccine went through the state's cold chain storage and will be deployed simultaneously to the municipalities. Mato Grosso do Sul accounts for 63% of chikungunya deaths in Brazil and experiences high transmission by Aedes aegypti, fueling a continuing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健省、2万用量のチクングニア熱ワクチンで接種開始 - マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア熱流行に対するワクチン接種開始という重要なイベントだが、IHR基準は2つ未満（異常性は低い）。ただしWPRO基準の複数該当と、ブラジル国内での高い死亡数（2026年に12死亡、全国の63%）により、情報追加を待ち慎重に監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始について報じており、進行中の流行を背景としている。マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州が2026年のブラジルチクングニア熱死亡の63%を占める点は注目。ただし、ワクチン接種自体は対応措置であり、新規感染や異常な事態の報告ではないため、IHR基準の「異常」には該当しない。Aedes aegypti媒介による継続的な流行とウイルスの国際拡大リスクについて追加情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вірус поза цензурою: як Росія перетворює ящур на транскордонну катастрофу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus Beyond Censorship: How Russia Is Turning Rinderpest into a Transboundary Catastrophe
article.articleSummary: Rinderpest outbreaks span Russia, Kazakhstan, and parts of China, triggering a regional veterinary crisis. Kazakhstan closes borders for livestock and derived products, restricts imports, and launches mass vaccination, indicating Russia as the likely source. Russia avoids public acknowledgment to escape export bans, while mass culling extends from Siberia to the Volga region. Farmers report confiscations under pretexts like pasteurellosis, fueling protests and social unrest. Lack of transparency on vaccines used in Kazakhstan raises concerns about vaccination integrity and potential dosing or quality errors that could fuel wider spread. Reports of unsafe carcass disposal at Russian burial sites heighten fears of ongoing transmission, including via wildlife and wild birds. China has detected a new strain, destroyed affected stock, and localized the outbreak. The crisis risks crossing borders, threatening regional and global food security and biopreparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスは検閲を超えて：ロシアがリンダーペストを国際的な大惨事に変える方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。ウイルス性家畜感染症の多国間での同時流行で、食糧安全保障と生物プレパレッドネスに対する重大な脅威。
triage.notes: ロシアはCEPR対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。カザフスタンも対象外。中国は記事で「新しい株を検出、患畜を殺処分、流行を局限化」と具体的に述べられており、対象国として確認。リンダーペスト（牛疫）は動物疾患だが、食糧安全保障と地域の獣医危機における国際的影響の大きさから PICKUP 判定。野生動物経由の拡散リスク、ワクチン完全性の懸念、情報透明性の欠如などが管理可能性を阻害。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус вне цензуры: как Россия превращает ящур в трансграничную катастрофу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus Uncensored: How Russia Is Turning Foot-and-Mouth Disease into a Transboundary Catastrophe
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks across Russia, Kazakhstan, and parts of China have become a transboundary crisis. Russia publicly hides the epidemic while a mass culling campaign sweeps from Siberia to the Volga region. Kazakhstan closes borders for livestock and dairy products, tightens imports, and launches mass vaccination. China identifies a new FMD strain, destroys affected herds, and localizes the outbreak. The piece frames the crisis as a clash of export interests and opacity, risking rapid regional spread as trade and mobility continue. Kazakhstan and Russia provide limited transparency about vaccines and effectiveness, fueling concerns of a systemic vaccination error. Video evidence suggests unsafe carcass disposal at Russian dumps, attracting wildlife and birds and enabling spillover. Migratory saiga and birds erode border controls. If unchecked, the outbreak could spread beyond the region, threatening global food security and biosecurity; risk may exceed COVID-19 in immediacy and long-term impact.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスは検閲の外：ロシアが口蹄疫をいかに国境を超えた大惨事に変えているか
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の複数国での同時多発アウトブレイク（ロシア、カザフスタン、中国）が報告され、国境を越えた危機に発展。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・貿易制限リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ロシア・カザフスタン・中国の3国でFMDアウトブレイクが発生していることが明記されている。発生地域にはロシアとカザフスタンが含まれるが、これらは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。中国のみが対象国であり、記事でも「中国は新しいFMD株を特定し、影響を受けた群れを破壊し、アウトブレイクを局所化」と記載されているため、verified_locations に中国を含める。口蹄疫は動物感染症だが、食糧安全保障・生物防御・国際貿易への脅威が明記されており、シグナルとしての優先度は高い。不透明な情報開示・不適切なバイオハザード管理（死骸処理）も管理可能性の問題を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Por que a vacina não resolve sozinha o controle da Salmonella na avicultura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the vaccine alone cannot solve Salmonella control in poultry farming.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian poultry farms face persistent Salmonella control challenges; vaccines reduce bacterial multiplication but do not prevent infection, as explained by Eva Hunka at the Facta Salmonella seminar in Toledo, Paraná. Salmonella has multiple hosts and environmental persistence, making eradication impossible in intensive systems. Vaccination is not a shield; it lowers bacterial replication within the bird, reducing clinical signs and keeping pathogen levels often undetectable, but does not stop contact with the organism. Therefore vaccines must be part of an integrated control program, combined with biosafety, environmental management, gut microbiota balance, and trained staff. The system is a multi-layer puzzle: to succeed, vaccination must be correctly used (timing, dose, route). People are both essential and the main disseminators; operational lapses can undermine efficacy. Emphasizes precision health, abandoning isolated solutions and adopting coordinated strategies.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンだけではニワトリ飼育におけるサルモネラ防除は解決しない
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの養鶏場におけるサルモネラ対策に関する専門家の解説であり、チフス/パラチフスの人間の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、動物衛生・食品安全に関する教育的情報である。IHR基準の該当がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急事象ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから得られた疾患名（チフス・パラチフス）と発生地域（ブラジル）は記事内容と一致しない。記事の主題は人間の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、養鶏産業におけるサルモネラ防除の技術的課題についての専門家セミナー報告である。対象国リストに該当する国でも、感染症イベント（人間への公衆衛生上の脅威）として評価される内容ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Adapar promove treinamento para controle de zoonoses em animais de produção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adapar Promotes Training for the Control of Zoonoses in Production Animals.
article.articleSummary: Paraná’s Agência de Defesa Agropecuária (Adapar) held a 13–17 April 2026 training in Guarapuava, Centro-Sul Paraná, focusing on prevention and control of rabies and transmissible spongiform encephalopathies (TSEs), including bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE), in production animals. The theoretical and practical program, conducted at the Sindicato Rural and Unicentro, aimed to strengthen surveillance, diagnosis, and field response, with emphasis on central nervous system sampling, use of PPE, and operation of the e-Sisbravet system under MAPA. Vet. Elzira Jorge Pierre stressed ongoing capacity building to address high-impact zoonoses and ensure rapid response. A key practical component involved capturing hematophagous bats in registered roosts to monitor rabies transmission; laboratory activities were conducted at Cedeteg, Unicentro. The training is split into two cohorts to maximize reach. This aligns with Paraná’s sanitary strategy, including a 2025 awareness campaign and a decree mandating rabies vaccination in 30 municipalities near Iguazú National Park.

triage.headline_ja: Adaparが家畜のズーノーシス管理のための訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病とBSEに関する能力構築・訓練プログラムで、異常/予想外な新規感染事例報告ではなく、公衆衛生上の重大な直接的危機を示す情報は不明。引き続き実際の疾病発生報告の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの農業防衛庁（Adapar）が実施した狂犬病およびBSEの訓練プログラム（2026年4月13-17日、パラナ州グアラプアバで開催）に関する報道。新規感染事例や疾病発生の報告ではなく、既存の疾病対策強化のための能力構築活動である。記事には現在の疾病の流行状況や具体的な患者・動物の死亡数などの具体的な公衆衛生指標が含まれていない。狂犬病はWPRO基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当し得る重要な人獣共通感染症だが、本記事だけでは国際的な拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を判断できないため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Virüs 16 vilayete yayıldı: Can kaybı 8'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus spread to 16 provinces: death toll rose to 8.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox virus continues to spread in Ghana, with the Ghana Health Service (GHS) reporting 1,062 cases and 8 deaths across 16 regions. Monitoring is ongoing in all 16 regions to prevent further transmission. The government first detected infections on 19 May 2025 in four people, and the first virus-related death was recorded on 28 July 2025. A vaccination campaign targeting high-risk groups remains active to curb spread. As of 17 April 2026, Ghana continues to manage the outbreak with surveillance and vaccination efforts to halt further spread and protect high-risk populations.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスが16の州に拡大：死亡者が8人に増加
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxがガーナで1,062例、8死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、16地域での広域拡大は異常・予想外の状況。IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響、異常性）に該当し、シグナルとしてピックアップする。
triage.notes: Mpoxの西アフリカでの急速な拡大。1,062例、8死亡という統計は2026年4月現在のデータ。政府による予防接種キャンペーンと監視体制が継続中。2025年5月の初検出から約11ヶ月で16地域に拡大した点で流行の勢いが強い。

article.articleHeadline: ลูกสาว 8 ขวบ "อ้วกเป็นหนอน" นานนับเดือน หมอเฉลยต้นตออยู่ในห้องน้ำ มีแทบทุกบ้าน!!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8-year-old daughter "vomiting worms" for months; doctors reveal the root cause is in the bathroom—found in almost every home!!
article.articleSummary: Drain fly (moth fly) infestation linked to an 8-year-old girl in Yangzhou, Jiangsu, China, who had months of vomiting with worm-like material. Refractory to standard dewormers, the case was re-evaluated at a hospital where experts identified the root cause in the bathroom environment rather than intestinal worms. Drain flies breed in dirty drains, sinks, toilet cisterns, and clogged grooves, carrying bacteria such as Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Salmonella that can cause severe gastroenteritis. The main risk is oral contamination from contaminated hands or surfaces. Diagnosis is often missed, leading to ineffective treatment with ordinary antihelminthics; targeted therapy such as ivermectin may be required. Key management includes destroying breeding sites and maintaining dryness. Precautions include using tweezers or cotton swabs to collect samples into alcohol-preserved vials for physician testing, avoiding bare-handed contact.

triage.headline_ja: 8歳の娘が「虫を吐く」症状が数ヶ月続く；医師が根本原因はトイレ—ほぼすべての家に見られると解明
triage.triage_reason: ドレインフライ（双翅目）による感染であり、腸道寄生虫症ではなく、臨床的には限定的である。一例の症例報告であり、集団発生の証拠がないため、IHR基準2つ以上の該当は認められない。ただし、複数の病原菌（E. coli、Salmonella）が環境由来で関連し、診断困難性が指摘されているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はドレインフライ由来の環境感染に関する一症例の医学的解説であり、集団発生ではなく単一患児の臨床事例。E. coliおよびSalmonellaは環境由来として言及されているが、実際の患児からの分離確認は明記されていない。診断困難性と環境管理の重要性が強調されているが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ಹೆಸರಘಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿಜ್ವರ ದೃಢ: ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರಿಗೆ ಆತಂಕ ಬೇಡ, ಜಾಗರೂಕತೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies confirmed in Hesaraghatta: Public should not panic, vigilance is necessary.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (H5N1) is confirmed in Matkuru village, Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, Karnataka, according to NIHSAD on April 14. On April 16, state and district Rapid Response Teams inspected the area. A 3 km infected zone and a 10 km surveillance zone are declared, with the area restricted for one year. On April 15, authorities culled 7,444 chickens, disposed of more than 14,000 eggs and 2,250 kg poultry feed; 10 staff were quarantined and treated with oseltamivir. The affected zone comprises 3,422 people in two villages; the surveillance zone includes 22,395 people in 17 villages. Fever screening for 10 days; PPE and medicines stocked at Hesaraghatta and Sonnehalli PHCs. No human cases detected; the situation is under control, but public vigilance is advised.

triage.headline_ja: ヘサラガッタで鳥インフルエンザH5N1が確認：公衆は慌てず、警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザH5N1の人獣共通感染症イベント。カルナタカ州ベンガルール地域で確認され、異常/予想外の発生、3km感染区域と10km監視区域の制限措置、大規模畜産物処分が実施されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行可能性、管理対応）に該当。IHR基準も複数該当の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 見出し翻訳に誤りあり（原文はバナナ熱/鳥インフルエンザH5N1だが、翻訳は「狂犬病」と記載）。記事サマリーは明確に鳥インフルエンザH5N1のアウトブレイクを描写。カルナタカ州で3,422人が感染区域内、22,395人が監視区域内に居住。現在までヒト感染例なし。動物疾患としての重要性が高く、人への感染リスク監視が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemic (human) - Ghana - GHS confirms over 1000 cases of Mpox
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Ghana continues to spread, with 1,062 confirmed cases reported as of 11 April 2026. The Ghana Health Service notes four new cases since the previous update, but no additional hospital admissions and the death toll remains eight since the outbreak began. Mpox is transmitted through close physical contact, body fluids, respiratory droplets, and contaminated materials, with symptoms typically including fever, swollen lymph nodes, and a painful rash. Surveillance has been intensified across all 16 regions, with more than 120 districts reporting cases; Accra and other urban centers remain high-risk transmission areas. Authorities emphasize hygiene, avoiding close contact with infected individuals, and early reporting of suspected cases. Public education campaigns are being expanded to promote early detection and responsible behavior to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エピデミック（ヒト感染）- ガーナ - GHS が1000件以上のサル痘症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外な大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準複数該当（重症度・入院・死亡の記録、16全地域での感染拡大、管理可能性への懸念）。社会的・政治的関心が高まっており、フルRRAへ進む必要あり。
triage.notes: 1,062件の確定症例、8件の死亡、16地域すべてで報告、サーベイランス強化中。ヒト間感染の明確なエビデンスあり。Mpox Clade I/IIの両方が関連している可能性あり。国家保健機関（GHS）による公式確認で信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 杭州某診所用同一針頭給15人採血 民憂疾病傳染 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hangzhou clinic used the same needle to draw blood from 15 people, raising public concern about disease transmission.
article.articleSummary: On April 10, 2026, Hangzhou’s Binjiang District witnessed a free blood glucose screening at Zhonghe (Hangzhou) Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic, where about 15 residents were bled using a single needle. Video showed needle reuse and concerns about disposal; residents questioned where used needles went. Netizens warned of transmission of blood-borne diseases, with claims of up to a six-month incubation. The clinic’s administrator said the staffer did not understand proper procedures and was fired; the clinic has since halted operations for整改. The Binjiang District Health Commission later stated that personnel performing the sampling lacked hygienic qualifications and that disposable needles were reused in violation. Authorities organized tests for participants at provincial hospitals on April 11; all results were negative for blood-borne diseases. The clinic claimed they provided health checks and administered AIDS post-exposure prophylaxis and hepatitis B vaccines; no imported/exported cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: 杭州の診療所が同一針で15人から採血、公衆衛生上の感染症懸念
triage.triage_reason: 予想外（不衛生な医療行為）および重症度スクリーニング基準に該当するが、初期検査で陰性結果が報告されており、実際の感染症発生の確認が不明な段階。今後の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 杭州の診療所における医療針の不衛生な再使用事案。B型肝炎を含む血液由来感染症のリスクが指摘されたが、4月11日の検査結果は陰性。ただし潜伏期間を考慮すると、今後の追跡検査が重要。当局対応および施設閉鎖が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 杭州某诊所用同一针头给15人采血 民忧疾病传染 | 大纪元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hangzhou clinic used the same needle to draw blood from 15 people, public concern over disease transmission | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: On April 10, 2026, Hangzhou's Zhonghe (Hangzhou) Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic in Binjiang District held a free blood-sugar screening at a local community. About 15 residents had blood drawn with a single needle, prompting concerns about blood-borne infection transmission. The clinic’s owner said the staff member lacked proper training and has been dismissed; the clinic has since suspended operations for renovation. The Binjiang District Health Commission reported on April 17 that the on-site blood-drawing personnel did not hold relevant health-professional qualifications and that a disposable needle was inappropriately reused. On April 11, residents who participated were advised to undergo blood-borne disease testing at a provincial medical institution; all results were negative. The operator stated participants were offered HIV post-exposure prophylaxis and hepatitis B vaccination. The clinic remains closed amid ongoing scrutiny and public safety concerns about unlicensed outreach activities.

triage.headline_ja: 杭州某診療所が同じ針で15人の採血を実施、感染症伝播への懸念 | 大紀元
triage.triage_reason: 血液媒介性疾患（HIV・B型肝炎）の針の使い回しによる曝露リスクが存在し、異常・予想外な事案として該当。ただし、実施時点（4月10日）から約1週間後（4月11日）にテストが実施され、参加者全員が陰性結果となっており、重篤な公衆衛生影響は現時点では確認されていない。情報不足のため経過観察継続が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国浙江省杭州市での医療事故（不衛生な採血行為）を報じている。HIV・B型肝炎という血液媒介性感染症の曝露リスクが理論的に存在するが、実施直後の迅速なフォローアップにより全員が陰性判定されている。当面、症例発生や疾病転帰の追跡情報が必要。医療の不備が社会的関心を集めているが、実際の感染症発生にはまだ至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bactérias no molho de tomate causaram morte em pizzaria de Pombal, aponta investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria in tomato sauce caused death at a Pombal pizzeria, investigation finds.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 April 2026, forensic results from La Favorita pizzeria in Pombal, Sertão da Paraíba, Brazil identified Escherichia coli and coagulase-positive Staphylococcus aureus in the tomato sauce used to prepare pizzas. The same bacteria were detected in the victims, including Raissa Bezerra, who died on 17 March 2026. Investigators concluded the tomato sauce contamination caused the fatal illness at the establishment. They also found evidence of cross-contamination with meat, since no infections were detected at the meat origin. The findings confirm sauce contamination as the outbreak driver at the Pombal pizzeria; public health authorities are reviewing food safety procedures at the establishment and region.

triage.headline_ja: ポンバル市のピッツェリアでのトマトソース汚染による死亡事件、調査結果で細菌が特定される
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な食中毒アウトブレイク（1施設）で、単一の死亡事例。IHR基準では該当が限定的だが、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度（死亡）」と「異常性」に該当するため、情報拡大を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 単一の食品施設における限定的な食中毒事例。死亡者1名、E. coliおよびS. aureusの同定された汚染源が特定されている。地域的な食品安全対策見直しが進行中。国際的拡大リスクは低い。IHR基準は2つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性）し、WPROスクリーニングでも2つ該当するため、PICKUP条件（IHR2以上またはWPRO1以上+社会的関心）に該当するが、限定的な地域・施設レベルのアウトブレイクのため、より詳細な情報展開を注視する位置付けとしてWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Focus on source reduction to curb dengue, says Kozhikode DMO
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases are rising in Kozhikode district, prompting an official alert and intensified emphasis on mosquito source-reduction by District Medical Officer K.K. Rajaram. The health department cites Aedes mosquitoes that spread dengue breed primarily inside homes and nearby surrounds, laying eggs in stagnant water. Major breeding sites include stored water containers; discarded coconut shells; broken utensils and toys; refrigerator trays; plant pots and trays under pots; discarded tyres; plastic sheets and tarpaulins used to cover firewood; rubber latex cups; areca leaf sheaths; tanks at construction sites; terraces and sunshades where water accumulates. Growing money plants indoors can pose a risk. Intermittent summer rains create favourable conditions for mosquito proliferation. The DMO advises ensuring water storage containers are properly covered and that water kept for birds and animals is changed at least weekly.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策で蚊の繁殖源削減に焦点、コーリコード保健当局
triage.triage_reason: インド南部ケーララ州コーリコード地区でのデング熱症例増加は異常かつ公衆衛生上の関心事だが、重症度、国際拡大リスク、死亡数などの詳細情報が不足している。経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコーリコード地区（ケーララ州、インド南部）でのデング熱症例増加と蚊の繁殖源削減対策に焦点を当てている。症例数、死亡数、入院数など具体的な重症度指標が不明であり、国際拡大の兆候もない。インド国内の地域的な公衆衛生上の課題として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo health teams on mission to save children from deadly measles outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 370 confirmed cases in 2026 to date (WHO), and 1,175 deaths reported by MSF in 2025; over the past decade, DRC averages about 33,000 measles cases annually. In Kipushi, Haut-Katanga Province, 17‑month‑old Marina’s case highlights vaccination gaps after she missed vaccines; nursing efforts emphasize vaccination coverage. Kinshasa’s immunisation indicators are low: 21% of children aged 1–2 are fully vaccinated against all basic antigens; about 10% are vaccinated per the national schedule; 23% have received no vaccines. In response, the government and partners are implementing Periodic Intensification of Routine Immunisation (PIRI) in Haut-Lomami, Haut-Katanga and Tanganyika, reaching >400,000 children in three months via vaccination sites in markets, churches and other gatherings, with Relais Communautaires (Recos) aiding outreach to hard‑to‑reach communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ保健チームが麻疹アウトブレイクから子どもたちを救う任務に当たっている
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける麻疹アウトブレイク（2026年370確認症例、2025年1,175死亡）はIHR基準で複数該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。ワクチン接種カバレッジが極めて低い（21-23%）ため、管理可能性にも懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されたDRC内の複数州（Haut-Katanga、Kinshasa、Haut-Lomami、Tanganika）での麻疹流行。ワクチン接種率が極めて低く（21%完全接種）、MSFが2025年に1,175死亡を報告している重大事案。政府主導のPIRI（定期予防接種の強化集約化）が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Uzbekistan Assesses Risks of New COVID Variant
article.articleSummary: Uzbekistan’s health authorities in Tashkent say the new COVID-19 variant Cicada (BA.3.2) poses no serious public health threat. Identified previously, it is not characterized by a high transmission rate; the World Health Organization has recorded Cicada in 23 countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and Mozambique. International health institutions continue to monitor the situation, with no evidence that Cicada is more dangerous than prior strains. Preliminary data indicate a clinical presentation similar to Omicron, featuring runny nose, cough, sore throat, mucosal irritation, and sometimes loss of smell or taste. Children may be more frequently affected due to lower adult immunity, while high-risk groups include the elderly, those with chronic illnesses, weakened immune systems, and respiratory conditions. In Uzbekistan, the epidemiological situation remains stable, with population immunity around 80%; authorities advise limiting contact with travelers from regions where cases have been detected, though Cicada is not expected to trigger a new epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: ウズベキスタン、新型COVID変異株のリスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: 新型COVID-19変異株（Cicada/BA.3.2）について、ウズベキスタン当局が「深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない」と評価しており、感染力も高くなく、新たな流行は予想されていない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはアメリカ、イギリス、モザンビークなども記載されているが、記事の主題はウズベキスタンでの評価・監視であり、実際のウズベキスタンでの流行兆候なし。対象国リストではウズベキスタンが含まれていないため、記事に記載されたChina（Hong Kong含む）のみを対象国として verified_locations に含める。Cicada変異株は既に認識されており、新規かつ深刻な脅威ではないと評価されているため DISMISS 判定。

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 outbreak confirmed in Hesaraghatta, containment measures underway
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza outbreak confirmed in Mathkuru village, Hesaraghatta. The National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases reported the event on April 14; health teams visited on April 16. Mathkuru is an infected zone, with 0-3 km and 3-10 km surveillance zones (PHC Hesaraghatta/Sonnenahalli). A total of 7,444 birds, 14,788 eggs, and 2,250 kg of poultry feed were culled and disposed on April 15; the burial site is secured and prohibited for one year. Ten cullers are quarantined under oseltamivir prophylaxis. In the 0-3 km zone, 2 villages (pop. 3,422); in the 3-10 km zone, 17 villages (pop. 22,395). Daily house-to-house fever surveillance by health workers/ASHAs; private hospitals alerted to report ILI/SARI via IHIP. PPE, triple-layer masks, oseltamivir, Viral Transport Medium, and throat swabs are stocked. Public advised not to panic; avoid contact with sick/dead birds; properly cooked poultry and eggs are safe.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1アウトブレイクがヘサラガッタで確認、封じ込め対策が進行中
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人獣共通感染症リスク、明確な公衆衛生対応（大規模淘汰・監視体制）が実施されており、国際懸念パスロジェンであるため、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は国際的に監視対象病原体（WHO/FAO)。記事は動物での確認事例であるが、人への感染リスク、鶏卵・家禽製品の国際貿易への潜在的影響がある。オセルタミビル予防投与などの対応準備が報告されており、人間への二次感染監視体制が整備されている。ヘサラガッタはベンガルール都市圏の農村地域。

article.articleHeadline: Diresa Piura intensifica acciones contra el dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diresa Piura intensifies actions against dengue.
article.articleSummary: In Piura, Peru, the Regional Health Directorate (Diresa Piura) intensifies dengue prevention. As of 2026-04-17, inspections have covered more than 28,000 homes in the Piura district, with larvicidal treatment using pyriproxyfen applied to over 32,000 containers to interrupt Aedes aegypti transmission. Over 40 health inspectors conducted larval control rounds in neighborhoods including A.H. Señor de los Milagros, Susana Higuchi, Javier Herod, José María Escrivá Balaguer, Jorge Basadre, José María Arguedas and San Pedro. During house visits, staff identify and eliminate breeding sites and counsel families to adopt healthy practices to prevent Aedes aegypti breeding at home, aiming to curb dengue transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ピウラ地域保健局がデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ペルーのピウラ州でのデング熱予防強化は、対象国リストに含まれない地域での公衆衛生対応の報道。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準を満たさず、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域にはフィリピンとペルーが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はペルーのピウラ州でのデング熱予防対策である。ペルーは対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。フィリピンは発生地域リストに含まれるものの、サマリー本文には言及されておらず、地理情報への誤分類と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Lockdown in Bengaluru: 3km Zone Sealed After H5N1 Outbreak at Hesaraghatta Poultry Center
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza detected at a poultry training centre in Muthkur village near Hesaraghatta on Bengaluru's outskirts, prompting immediate containment in Karnataka. Lab confirmation came on April 14 from the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal, with rapid response teams deploying by April 16. A 3-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone have been established, restricting movement of poultry and related products in the areas. In line with culling and biosecurity protocols, 7,444 birds were culled and 14,788 eggs destroyed at the facility; personnel involved are under medical observation. Door-to-door health monitoring is underway in 19 surrounding villages, screening residents for fever and flu-like symptoms over the next 10 days to detect any potential human transmission, though such cases remain rare. Public advisory: avoid contact with sick or dead birds; properly cooked poultry is safe.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール鳥インフルエンザロックダウン：ヘサラガッタ養鶏センターでのH5N1発生後、3km区域が封鎖
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の確定検査陽性、多地域での封鎖・移動制限、人間への伝播可能性がある高病原性ウイルスによるイベント。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: H5N1はWHO対応対象の高病原性ウイルス。ベンガルール（カルナータカ州）での確定検査、中央政府機関（ボーパルの高度警戒動物疾患研究所）による確認、迅速な封鎖・検査対応がなされている。人間への伝播事例は現在報告されていないが、19村での戸別訪問健康監視が実施中であり、潜在的な人間-ヒト感染のリスク評価が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Tips Merawat Anjing Kintamani Agar Bebas Rabies, Simak!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tips for Caring for a Kintamani Dog to Keep It Rabies-Free, Check This Out!
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk persists in Bali, Indonesia, where Kintamani dogs—a Bali local guardian breed—are kept by farmers. Although seen as a companion, Kintamani dogs can contract rabies like any breed; hence owners should ensure complete vaccination, ideally annually, as of 17 April 2026 Bali is not yet rabies-free. Signs of rabies in these dogs resemble other breeds and include two clinical patterns: a quiet, withdrawn demeanor that may suddenly bite anything, or an agitated, restless behavior with voracious appetite. Affected dogs may have red eyes, drool, and heightened sensitivity to light and sound, with noticeable physical changes. In Bali, rabid dogs may carry a red collar on their neck as a sign. Regular veterinary health checks and vaccination are emphasized by breed representatives to keep Kintamani dogs safe, particularly for dogs frequently going outdoors.

triage.headline_ja: キンタマーニ犬を狂犬病から守るための飼養のコツ、確認してみましょう！
triage.triage_reason: 記事はバリ州における狂犬病リスクの啓発記事であるが、新規の感染症イベント（ヒト感染症、アウトブレイク、死亡報告など）を報告していない教育的コンテンツである。動物への狂犬病ワクチン接種推奨が主題であり、公衆衛生への具体的な深刻な影響や国際的懸念は示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はバリ州における狂犬病リスク啓発記事であり、新規感染症事案の報告ではなく、ペット飼養者向けの予防教育コンテンツである。感染症イベント（ヒト症例、死亡、アウトブレイク）の報告がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Rejang Lebong kampanyekan pengendalian penyakit prioritas - ANTARA News Bengkulu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rejang Lebong Health Office campaigns to control priority diseases.
article.articleSummary: Rejang Lebong District Health Office in Bengkulu launches a campaign to control priority non-communicable diseases (PTM) to curb deaths from heart disease, stroke, hypertension, and cancer. Led by Dinkes head Asep Setia Budiman, the program aligns with the Ministry of Health’s main initiative targeting 15 districts and began April 16 at Talang Rimbo Lama Health Center in Curup Selatan, with plans to extend to other districts. While focusing on PTMs, officials reaffirm ongoing priority for infectious diseases such as tuberculosis, hepatitis, and HIV/AIDS. The effort aims to improve service quality by offering education and free health checks, promoting use of Puskesmas, Posyandu, and Pustu for routine screening. Activities include group exercise and PHBS education. Authorities expect increased public awareness will reduce chronic disease risk and improve life expectancy in Rejang Lebong.

triage.headline_ja: レジャン・レボン保健局が優先疾患の管理キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事は非感染性疾患（心臓病、脳卒中、高血圧、がん）の予防キャンペーンであり、感染症の新規発生や流行を報告していない。TB・肝炎・HIVは優先対象として言及されているのみで、具体的なイベント情報を含まない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の新規発生・流行報告ではなく、保健当局による疾患予防キャンペーンの実施情報である。TB・肝炎・HIVは既存優先対象疾患として言及されているが、新規シグナルはない。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak in Bengaluru; thousands of birds culled
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza outbreak confirmed at a poultry training centre in Mathkuru village, Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, based on NIHSAD confirmation (report dated 14 April). Containment: infected zone 0–3 km; surveillance zone 3–10 km around Hesaraghatta. On 15 April, 7,444 birds, 14,788 eggs, and 2,250 kg of poultry feed were culled. Burial site secured as a prohibited area for one year. Ten cullers are quarantined under oseltamivir prophylaxis. Population in the 0–3 km zone includes 2 villages (3,422 people); in the 3–10 km zone, 17 villages (22,395 people). Daily house-to-house fever surveillance by health workers/ASHAs; private hospitals alerted to report ILI/SARI on the IHIP portal. PPE, masks, oseltamivir, VTM, and throat swabs stocked. Public advised not to panic; avoid contact with sick/dead birds; properly cooked poultry and eggs remain safe. No human infections reported in the article. As of 17 April 2026, the outbreak remains under containment with monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール(バンガロール)での鳥インフルエンザ発生; 数千羽の鳥が処分される
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認事例であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」および「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（大規模な鳥の処分）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染リスク）、管理可能性（対症療法と封じ込めの必要性）が認識される。鳥インフルエンザA(H5N1)は国際的な関心事であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1はWHO監視対象の高リスク病原体。記事では現在までにヒト感染例は報告されていないが、防疫対応（予防的オセルタミビル投与、密接接触者隔離）が実施されている。今後のヒト感染の可能性監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Health minister launches state-level anti-dengue campaign - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Punjab launched a state-level awareness and prevention campaign against dengue and water-borne diseases, with Patiala hosting the event on 2026-04-17. Health Minister Dr Balbir Singh outlined the statewide 'Every Friday Dengue Te Vaar' initiative, stressing public participation for prevention. The drive emphasizes awareness, monitoring, and timely treatment, and includes door-to-door outreach in both rural and urban areas. Officials outlined dengue basics, symptoms, and preventive steps to residents, and encouraged prompt care for suspected cases. Practical measures highlighted: prevent water stagnation around homes, keep water containers covered, regularly clean water tanks, and maintain sanitation to reduce mosquito breeding. The campaign also underscores safe drinking water to avoid related illnesses. The Health Department aims for a clean, healthy Punjab through community cooperation and sustained awareness activities.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣がデング熱対策の州レベルキャンペーンを開始 - ザ・トリビューン
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防・啓発キャンペーンの発表であり、デング熱の新規発生や流行の報告ではない。IHR基準および WPROスクリーニング基準に該当する具体的な疾病発生情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーンの報告であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。デング熱の症例数増加や異常な流行の兆候を示す具体的なデータがない。予防キャンペーンの開始は通常の公衆衛生活動であり、感染症危機の兆候ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Polícia Civil conclui inquérito sobre surto alimentar em Pombal e aponta crime
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Civil Police have concluded an investigation into a foodborne outbreak in Pombal and have pointed to a crime.
article.articleSummary: In Pombal, in the sertão of Paraíba, Brazil, the Civil Police concluded an investigation into a foodborne outbreak linked to a local pizzaria. Technical evidence, lab analyses, and witness statements established bacterial contamination in the restaurant’s prepared foods, with Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus species detected. The fault was traced to handling practices at the establishment, not the ingredients’ source. A woman died amid the outbreak; more than 80 people were treated for suspected food poisoning. Investigators could not single out a person responsible for the contamination, so charges for homicide or bodily injury were not filed. The case will be considered under consumer relations crimes under federal law, given the outbreak’s severity and number of victims. The establishment has been judicially interdicted and remains closed by sanitary surveillance, and the procedure was forwarded to the judiciary.

triage.headline_ja: ポンバル市での食中毒集団発生についてシビルポリスが捜査を完了し犯罪を指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるローカルな食中毒事件であり、国際的拡大リスクや異常性が低く、IHR基準およびWPRO基準をほぼ満たさない。既に原因特定・対応完了段階のため、新規感染症シグナルとしての価値は限定的。
triage.notes: 本事例は単一の飲食店における局所的な食中毒事件であり、既に捜査完了・原因特定・施設閉鎖という対応がなされている。新規感染症の出現や国際的懸念ではなく、食品衛生事案として処理されている。WPROスクリーニング基準2つを満たすが、社会的・国際的関心がなく、既に制御されているため、シグナルピックアップの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 Outbreak Confirmed In Hesaraghatta, Containment Measures Underway
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza outbreak confirmed at a poultry rearing training centre in Mathkuru village, Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru. The outbreak was validated by NIHSAD in a report dated April 14. State authorities declared Mathkuru an infected zone (0-3 km) and surrounding 3-10 km area under PHC Hesaraghatta and Sonnenahalli as a surveillance zone. On April 15, culling removed 7,444 birds, 14,788 eggs, and 2,250 kg of poultry feed, with disposal and burial site secured; the area is prohibited for one year. The State Rapid Response Team, District RRT, and PHC teams visited the site on April 16, initiating containment measures per protocol. There is no information on human cases in the report. The outbreak appears confined to the training centre, with measures aimed at preventing further spread within the infected and surveillance zones and minimizing import/export risk.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1アウトブレイク確認、ヘサラガッタで封じ込め対策進行中
triage.triage_reason: 動物でのH5N1確認（異常/予想外、重症度あり）だが、ヒト症例なく、地域限定的で対策実施中。情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 動物でのH5N1確認は異常でありスクリーニング基準を満たすが、ヒト感染例なし、地域限定的（訓練センター），適切な封じ込め対策実施中であり、現時点では国際的拡大リスク低い。ただしH5N1はヒト感染の可能性あり（流行しやすさ基準該当），フルRRA判定待ちの段階として WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: God55 - Cập nhật corona ngày 14-2: Hồ Bắc thêm 116 người chết, Trung Quốc điều chỉnh số thống kê - tsukubike.net - God55
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: God55 - Coronavirus Update on February 14: Hubei Reports 116 More Deaths, China Adjusts the Statistics - tsukubike.net - God55
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 update (Feb 14, 2020): China reports 5,090 new infections and 121 new deaths, total 63,851 cases; in Hubei 4,823 new infections and 116 deaths. Discharges reach 1,081, with recoveries totaling 6,723 as of Feb 13. World totals cited: about 64,434 infections and 1,383 deaths (1,380 in China) with 6,766 recoveries; AFP later adjusts Chinese deaths to 1,380. Hong Kong adds 3 cases (total 56), including a dim sum restaurant worker; a second case involves a cousin in a family cluster of 29 with at least six infections. Tianjin bans wildlife consumption to curb spread. Six healthcare workers have died in China, with over 1,700 infected among medical staff. In Hubei, Huanggang and Xiaogan impose “wartime” controls from 17:00, Feb 14, for 14 days, restricting movement and delivering supplies. Origin linked to a Wuhan wildlife market; bats initially suspected, with pangolins considered possible. Huoshenshan and Leishenshan hospitals report seven discharges from Huoshenshan, which has treated over 1,000 patients.

triage.headline_ja: God55 - 2月14日コロナウイルス更新：湖北省がさらに116人の死亡を報告、中国が統計数を調整
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年2月14日のCOVID-19の過去の統計更新に関するもので、歴史的情報の再配信である。現在のアクティブなシグナルではなく、公開情報の後処理的な報告のため、新たなシグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 配信日時が2026年4月17日と記載されていますが、記事内容は2020年2月14日のCOVID-19初期段階の統計報告です。過去イベントの再掲載または日付誤記の可能性が高く、現在のシグナル検出対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: El 'café con huevo' arrasa en Instagram, pero una médica advierte del riesgo real de salmonela al tomarlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Egg coffee' takes Instagram by storm, but a doctor warns of the real risk of Salmonella from drinking it.
article.articleSummary: Egg coffee, a Vietnamese cà phê trứng beverage made by folding raw egg yolks with sugar and condensed milk into strong coffee, poses a Salmonella infection risk when eggs are not cooked. Originating in Hanoi in the 1940s, the practice is now a social-media fad, with mixed reactions online. Health experts warn that the primary danger lies in the raw yolks, which do not receive heat sufficient to kill Salmonella. Symptoms of infection include diarrhea, fever, abdominal cramps, nausea, and vomiting; pregnant women and older adults are particularly at risk for complications. There is no reported laboratory confirmation or outbreak in the article; advice centers on using pasteurized eggs or avoiding raw preparations. The recommendation is to opt for pasteurized egg products to reduce risk while still enjoying the beverage, though nutritional concerns persist.

triage.headline_ja: 「卵入りコーヒー」がInstagramで流行、医師がサルモネラ感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 実験室確認や集団発生の報告がなく、健康リスク警告は食品安全の一般的な情報提供に過ぎません。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しません。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの伝統的な食品「卵入りコーヒー」に関する一般的な食品安全情報です。実際の患者数、入院、死亡の報告がなく、特定の集団発生や異常事態の報告もありません。ソースはスペイン語メディアであり、警告情報は専門家による一般的な予防的アドバイスです。感染症サーベイランスシグナルの基準を満たしません。

article.articleHeadline: Reserva Ecológica do Taim é reaberta após fim de foco de gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taim Ecological Reserve reopens after end of avian influenza outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 16 April 2026, the Taim Ecological Station in Santa Vitória do Palmar, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reopened after closing on 3 March due to a high-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 focus detected in Coscoroba coscoroba swans at Lagoa da Mangueira. The closure lasted 28 consecutive days with no new bird mortalities at the reserve. During the interdiction, Seapi teams conducted wildlife surveillance with boats and drones and carried out 95 farm surveillance actions within 10 km of the focus, targeting subsistence operations, and 22 inspections in regional poultry farms to enforce biosafety norms. Taim remains a permanent risk zone due to migratory bird traffic. Visitors and residents are advised not to approach sick or dead animals; suspected cases should be reported to the Agropecuária Defense Inspectorate or via WhatsApp (51) 98445-2033.

triage.headline_ja: タイム生態保護区、鳥インフルエンザの終息後に再開
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの野生動物での確認は重要だが、本事例は既に終息し保護区が再開されている。人への感染報告がなく、現在のリスクレベルは低い。ただし継続的な野生動物監視の重要性から経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: ブラジルの野生動物（白鳥）でH5N1検出。人感染の報告なし。既に終息し保護区再開済みだが、渡航性野鳥による再導入リスク存在。地域当局による継続監視体制が確立されている。
