article.articleHeadline: H1N1: dá para prevenir? Entenda mais sobre a doença | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1: Can it be prevented? Learn more about the disease | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza A circulates in Brazil, transmitted mainly via respiratory droplets and, indirectly, via contaminated surfaces. Classic influenza symptoms include fever, cough, and malaise; can also cause chills, myalgia, nasal discharge, and less commonly diarrhea, vomiting, hoarseness, or red eyes. Oseltamivir phosphate is recommended for severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) or influenza with risk factors, ideally started within 48 hours of onset. Rest and fluids aid recovery; NSAIDs or paracetamol for fever and pain. Vaccination is the main preventive measure, with annual campaigns due to viral mutation. In 2026, Brazil’s SUS uses a trivalent vaccine protecting against H1N1, H3N2, and Influenza B; campaign runs March 28 to May and targets elderly 60+, children 6 months–<6 years, pregnant women, and health workers. Private clinics offer a quadrivalent vaccine. Additional measures include hand hygiene, masking, ventilation, avoiding crowds, and not sharing personal items.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1：予防可能か？疾病についてさらに詳しく理解する｜CNNブラジル
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるH1N1インフルエンザの流行について教育的な説明記事であり、新規の異常なイベント、重症度の上昇、または管理不能の危機を示す具体的な証拠がない。予防措置とワクチン接種キャンペーンについての標準的な情報提供である。
triage.notes: 本記事はH1N1に関する一般的な予防・治療情報とワクチン接種キャンペーン（3月28日～5月）の説明であり、新規の公衆衛生危機や異常な感染数増加を報告していない。季節性インフルエンザとして予期される範囲内の内容。

article.articleHeadline: A 'mystery disease' is behind several deaths in Burundi, and not for the first time
article.articleSummary: Five people have died and 35 fallen ill in Burundi's Mpanda district as of late March 2026, in a mystery disease episode. Patients displayed fever, vomiting, diarrhea, fatigue, abdominal pain, with jaundice and anemia in severe cases. Ebola, Marburg, Rift Valley fever, yellow fever, and Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever tests were negative; samples have been sent to the Democratic Republic of Congo for further analysis. The findings were chronicled in BMJ by Rob Reddick, noting expert speculation that the illness could involve bacterial infections, various viruses, or a severe gastrointestinal disease presenting atypically. Burundi previously faced a similar unconfirmed outbreak about three years ago. Experts caution that such medical mysteries may remain unsolved, though many are ultimately attributed to known pathogens when investigations conclude.

triage.headline_ja: ブルンジの謎の病気が複数の死亡をもたらしており、今回が初めてではない
triage.triage_reason: 未確認のアウトブレイク（5人死亡、35人罹患）が報告され、複数の致死的出血熱病原体が疑われている点、国際的に高い関心のある未知の疾患であることから、IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてBurundiが記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは検査検体の送付先として記載されており、記事の主要な地理的フォーカスはBurundiのMpanda地区だが、ただしDRCは対象国に含まれるため検体送付地域として含める。未知の疾患で複数の致死的病原体がテスト陰性、原因不明のまま調査継続中。BMJ掲載の報告で専門家による注視が高い。

article.articleHeadline: KPKP Kepulauan Seribu cegah penyebaran rabies di Pulau Sabira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KPKP Kepulauan Seribu Prevents the Spread of Rabies on Sabira Island.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention efforts on Sabira Island, Pulau Harapan, North Thousand Islands, Jakarta, were conducted by the Thousand Islands Sub-Office for Food Security, Marine Affairs, and Agriculture (KPKP). A free sterilization and rabies vaccination campaign targeted 251 rabies vector animals (HPR), with 77 cats sterilized (31 males, 46 females) and 174 cats vaccinated against rabies. The initiative, in collaboration with the Let's Adopt Indonesia community, aims to maintain Jakarta’s rabies-free status and improve coastal animal welfare through population control and environmental health measures. By preventing rabies transmission, authorities seek to safeguard residents and preserve ecosystem balance in the Thousand Islands. No outbreak was reported; this is a preventive public health activity with vaccination serving as an early mitigation step against a deadly zoonosis.

triage.headline_ja: 千島諸島KPKP、サビラ島の狂犬病拡大を予防
triage.triage_reason: 記事は狂犬病の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンを扱っており、発生事例なし。既存の脅威に対する公衆衛生対策であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準の懸念要件（重症度、異常性、拡大リスク）を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本件はジャカルタの狂犬病フリーステータス維持を目的とした予防的キャンペンであり、アウトブレイク報告なし。251頭の動物ワクチン接種は定期的な公衆衛生対策。シグナルとしての懸念要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Chó cắn 4 người ở Quảng Ngãi dương tính vi rút dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog that bit four people in Quảng Ngãi tests positive for rabies virus.
article.articleSummary: April 17, 2026: The National Center for Veterinary Diagnostics and Testing, Veterinary Diagnostics and Testing Station II, confirmed rabies virus in a sample from Quảng Ngãi Province. The specimen was the head of a dog submitted by the Quảng Ngãi Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, collected in Dien Niên hamlet, Sơn Tịnh commune, on April 15 for outbreak control. Four residents were bitten when a golden-coated dog roaming in Sơn Tịnh attacked multiple people on April 14; the animal was captured and euthanized about 11:30 that day. In response, authorities cordoned off the area, intensified surveillance, and coordinated with health services to monitor bite victims and ensure timely vaccination. A vaccination drive for dogs and cats is underway, with warnings not to let dogs roam. Officials noted persistent free-roaming dogs in rural areas and pledged tighter pet management and commitments to confine and vaccinate pets.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのクアンガイ省で4人に咬み傷を与えた犬が狂犬病ウイルス陽性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性・予想外性と国際拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。複数の死傷者と確定診断、地域対応の実施がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は高い致死率を持つ重症感染症。複数の住民が咬まれており、既に確定診断が得られている。ベトナムの獣医診断センターによる検査確認あり。地域の野犬管理と曝露リスク継続が課題。ワクチン接種キャンペーンが既に実施されており、保健当局による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Dua Balita di Cirebon Meninggal Dunia Akibat Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two toddlers in Cirebon die from measles.
article.articleSummary: Two toddlers under two years old in Kota Cirebon, Indonesia, died from measles, with comorbid congenital heart disease and severe malnutrition. The outbreak is straining RS Gunung Jati Cirebon, which reported four additional critical measles patients and several others with high fever, dehydration, pneumonia, otitis, and possible encephalitis. The hospital logged six outpatient measles cases January–16 April 2026 and about 50 emergency department admissions requiring hospitalization. Kota Cirebon has declared a measles outbreak (KLB) since February after epidemiological assessment. In 2025, 238 suspected measles cases with 44 confirmed; by 4 April 2026, 150 suspected and 9 confirmed. Highest counts in Argasunya (30) and Kalijaga (28); most affected are children aged 1–4 years (6 cases) and adults over 15 (15 suspects). Symptoms include fever, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and rash. Isolation is advised; vaccination urged, with IDAI recommending screening 9 months–15 years and lab confirmation via the health department.

triage.headline_ja: チレボンの2人の幼児がはしかで死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで確認されたはしか（麻疹）の集団発生により、2人の幼児死亡を含む深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が生じており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。地域での管理負荷が高く、複合的な合併症を伴う症例が多数報告されている。
triage.notes: チレボン市（Cirebon）でのはしか集団発生は2026年2月に宣言済み。2025年から継続的な症例が報告されており、2026年4月16日までに150の疑い例と9の確定例が記録されている。小児（1～4歳）と成人（15歳以上）に多く発生。入院患者数が急増し、医療施設の逼迫が報告されている。一部症例で脳炎の可能性も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: BTC gets reprieve with de-notification regarding Glanders
article.articleSummary: Glanders outbreak at Bengaluru Turf Club (BTC) in India prompted designation of a 'notified area' under the National Action Plan for Control and Eradication of Glanders. Per clause-5, the notified area has been de-notified and the movement restrictions on equines, donkeys, and mules into and out of the area are withdrawn with immediate effect. The decision provides a reprieve for BTC and stakeholders, signaling a shift toward normalization after outbreak containment measures. The report does not specify case or death counts, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or ongoing surveillance details, and there is no mention of imported or exported animal movement beyond the de-notified zone. This action aligns with national guidelines to restore animal movement while maintaining general monitoring. Published date: 2026-04-17.

triage.headline_ja: グランダース関連の除外通知によりBTCが救済を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（グランダース）の発生であるが、記事は既に封じ込めが完了した旨を報告しており、感染症危機管理の現段階では人間への直接的な脅威がない。また、国家計画に基づいた適切な管理が実施されている。
triage.notes: グランダースは動物疾病であり、人間への感染リスクは限定的である。記事は既に発生地域が除外通知されたことを報告しており、危機は既に管理下にある。動物関連イベントのため、ヒト感染症シグナルの優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: More than 4k new cases of HIV reported in PH during Q4 2025 - DOH
article.articleSummary: Philippines: 4,277 newly reported HIV cases in Q4 2025 (DOH). Predominantly male (4,038) vs female (239). Among 1,929 cases with age data, 25–34 years account for 45%, and 15–24 years for 32% (1,361); 15 cases were under 15. Compared with Q3 2025 (5,583), Q4 incidence declined; October–December 2025 averaged 47 cases per day, totaling 1,069 with advanced HIV disease by period end. Cumulative HIV cases reach 163,454 from 1984 through 2025. PrEP uptake shows 4,760 new enrollees. 95-95-95 targets stand at 61% diagnosed, 66% on treatment, and 57% virally suppressed. December notes HIV as an evolving epidemic with projections of >457,000 by 2030 if unmanaged. Alarm over youth transmission: a 500% increase among ages 15–25 in early 2025; youngest diagnosed is a 12-year-old from Palawan. Philippines records the highest number of new cases in the Western Pacific Region, with transmission heavily focused on youth.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンで2025年第4四半期に4000件以上のHIV新規感染が報告 - DOH
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンにおけるHIV新規感染数の報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行易性、管理可能性）で複数該当するが、IHR基準で国際的拡大リスクが明確でなく、情報不足のため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはフィリピンのHIV流行状況に焦点を当てており、若年層（特に15-25歳）の感染急増（500%増）、12歳の最年少感染者、西太平洋地域における最高新規感染数記録、2030年までに457,000件を超える可能性など、複数の懸念要因を含む。ただし、国際的な感染拡大リスクや渡航制限の可能性については記事で明示されていないため、IHR基準は2つの該当にとどまる。WPROスクリーニング基準は全項目で懸念があるが、情報不足（国際支援の具体的必要性が不明）のため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de mulher após comer em pizzaria na PB foi por infecção intestinal grave, conclui polícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a woman after eating at a pizzeria in Paraíba was due to a severe intestinal infection, police conclude.
article.articleSummary: Death of Raíssa Maritein Bezerra, 44, after eating pizza at La Favoritta in Pombal, Sertão da Paraíba, due to acute severe intestinal infection confirmed by IPC-PB. The outbreak, occurring March 15–16, left more than 100 people ill; 117 sought medical care with nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain; one patient required ICU care. Laboratory tests found bacteria in the sauces and pizzas, including Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus (coagulase-positive); meat sampled at origin showed no contamination, suggesting mishandling within the pizzaria. The owner was indicted for selling food unfit for consumption; tests ruled out toxic substances. The site remains closed by the Sanitary Surveillance, with a judicial interdiction requested. Investigators could not definitively link a criminal act to the death or injuries. The deceased was a municipal civil servant; the boyfriend also fell ill but recovered. The case is under Paraíba judiciary consideration.

triage.headline_ja: パライーバ州のピザ店での食事後の女性の死亡は重度の腸管感染症によるものと警察が結論
triage.triage_reason: E. coli による食品由来の集団発生で100人以上が罹患し、1人が死亡（ICU入院者含む）。異常/予想外、重症度が高く、国内の公衆衛生上の深刻な影響があり、スクリーニング基準複数に該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれています。食品由来のE. coli 集団発生で100人以上の罹患者と1人の死亡が確認されており、複数の公衆衛生基準に該当します。当局による調査（警察・衛生監視・司法）が進行中であり、施設の閉鎖と司法的措置が取られています。

article.articleHeadline: West Singhbhum News: बीमारी पर प्रहार: पश्चिमी सिंहभूम के गुंडीजोड़ा गांव में मलेरिया जांच अभियान, बचाव के सिखाए गुर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Singhbhum News: Strike Against Disease: Malaria Testing Campaign in Gundijoda Village, West Singhbhum, Prevention Lessons Taught
article.articleSummary: Malaria detected in Gundijoda village, West Singhbhum district, Jharkhand, India, during a joint house-to-house screening led by the Health Department and CINI Foundation. In the Friday campaign, two residents tested malaria-positive and were promptly given antimalarial treatment. ANM Ranjana Kumari and MPW Raju Gope directed ASHA Dai-didis to monitor patients and ensure full adherence to therapy. The drive, led by Health Sub Centre Kutingta, targeted remote rural areas to curb malaria transmission and enable early case finding. CINI Foundation staff, including Abhishek Kumar, educated villagers about malaria symptoms—fever, chills, body aches—and risk factors such as water stagnation and poor sanitation. Emphasis was placed on using mosquito nets and maintaining clean surroundings to prevent breeding and infection. Local health workers and volunteers’ efforts aimed to raise awareness and reduce outbreak risk.

triage.headline_ja: West Singhbhum News: 病気に対する攻撃: 西シングバム地区Gundijoda村でマラリア検査キャンペーン実施、予防方法を指導
triage.triage_reason: インドのマラリア症例検出は周知の問題であり、個別の地域キャンペーンでの数例検出は異常ではない。ただしWPRO基準の異常性・長期曝露が該当する可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: West Singhbhum地区Jharkhand州での局所的なマラリア検査キャンペーンの報告。2例の陽性事例は小規模で重症度情報なし。地域保健局による対応が進行中で管理可能性は高い。アウトブレイク規模に関する情報不足のため、WATCHランクで継続監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Bắt hiệu trưởng, chủ cơ sở thực phẩm vụ tuồn thịt heo bệnh vào trường mầm non
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Principal and owner of a food business arrested in case of smuggling diseased pork into a kindergarten.
article.articleSummary: Three Thai Nguyen Province individuals—Nguyen Van Thanh, a food business owner; Nguyen Thi Tam, former Nam Hoa Kindergarten principal; and Tran Thi Hang, Nam Hoa Kindergarten accountant—have been charged and remanded for bribery tied to providing meals and food to local schools. Investigators say Thanh’s registered business supplied fresh and prepared foods under contracts from 2022–2026 to schools in Dong Hy district, including Nam Hoa Kindergarten. To secure ongoing supplies for the 2024–2025 school year, Thanh allegedly paid Tam and Hang 6% of the monthly value of goods from October 2024 to March 2026. On 25 March 2026, parents at Hoa Binh Kindergarten reported suspicious meat; testing confirmed African swine fever virus and E. coli in meat from Thanh’s supplier. The police are expanding the case; the Thái Nguyên Department of Health fined the seller 22.5 million VND for selling ASF-contaminated pork to Hoa Binh Kindergarten. Investigation ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 食品事業主と幼稚園元園長が逮捕：病気の豚肉を幼稚園に持ち込んだ贈賄事件
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱とE. coliの混合感染が幼稚園で検出された深刻な食品安全事件。多くの子どもに曝露するリスクが高く、公衆衛生への重大な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、タイ・グエン省で実際に発生したイベントであることが確認。複数の幼稚園児に対する病原体（ASF、E. coli）への曝露リスクが高く、既に検査で陽性確認済み。当局が調査を拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Nanded's 'Pure' Jar Water Supply Turns Health Hazard As Algae-Filled Jars Put Citizens At Risk
article.articleSummary: In Nanded district, amid rising summer heat and wedding season, jars marketed as pure drinking water are reportedly contaminated, with jars dirty and coated with algae; sediment at bottom; rural areas use non-sanitized plastic barrels loaded on transport vehicles, sometimes used for agricultural spraying, increasing contamination risk. Health experts warn potential outbreaks of jaundice, typhoid, and gastroenteritis. Lab testing reportedly ignored; operators lack technical knowledge and add chemicals arbitrarily to appear clean. FDA says they regulate sealed bottled water only; action against loose jar water falls to gram panchayats, municipal councils. Despite funds from 14th/15th Finance Commission for filtration RO plants, many units are non-operational; government offices reportedly receive the same unhygienic jars. Residents demand urgent enforcement of safety standards.

triage.headline_ja: ナンデッド地区の「純水」瓶詰め水供給が健康被害に：藍藻類で汚染された瓶が市民をリスクにさらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際影響のリスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露）。腸チフス・肝炎・胃腸炎の集団発生リスク高く、水質問題として広域影響の可能性が大きい。
triage.notes: ナンデッド地区の瓶詰め水汚染問題は、複数の水因性感染症（腸チフス、肝炎、胃腸炎）の集団発生を引き起こす可能性が高い。規制・監督体制の不備、非衛生的な容器・輸送、検査回避などの構造的問題があり、夏季・結婚式シーズンの需要増加時に人口曝露が増加する。インド国内での広域水質危機としての特性を持つため、フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 深圳中年男子 確診罕見「Q熱」| 台灣大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shenzhen middle-aged man diagnosed with a rare 'Q fever' | The Epoch Times Taiwan
article.articleSummary: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China: one confirmed case of Q fever in a 43-year-old man, caused by Coxiella burnetii. After a week of persistent fever unresponsive to medication, he tested positive for Q fever. Exposure history includes frequent visits to a produce market to buy beef and keeping dogs at home. Q fever is a rare zoonosis mainly transmitted from cattle, sheep, and other livestock to humans; human-to-human transmission is rare, with ticks as another possible source. Clinicians recommend regular veterinary checks for pets to reduce exposure. Coxiella burnetii is highly hardy, capable of surviving in dust for months and becoming airborne, with inhalation as a key transmission route. The infection can affect the endocardium, liver, and bones, and the Shenzhen case highlights potential for significant organ involvement.

triage.headline_ja: 深圳の中年男性がまれな「Q熱」と診断される
triage.triage_reason: Q熱は稀な人獣共通感染症で、本症例は単一の確定症例であり、重症度は報告されている（多臓器関与の可能性）。ただし国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の必要性は現時点では明確でなく、情報が限定的なため。
triage.notes: Q熱は稀な人獣共通感染症であり、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」（多臓器関与の可能性）および「異常・予想外」に該当。WPRO基準でも「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当する。ただし現時点では単一症例報告であり、流行性（epidemic prone）は低い。市場での牛肉購入と自宅での犬の飼育が曝露源と報告されており、潜在的な継続曝露がある（prolonged exposure）の評価は「不明」。情報がやや限定的であるため「WATCH」とし、追加の確定症例報告や流行の兆候を監視することが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Hiệu trưởng bị bắt trong vụ tuồn thịt lợn bệnh vào trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Principal arrested in the case of smuggling diseased pork into the school.
article.articleSummary: Thai Nguyen province authorities arrested Nam Hoa Kindergarten principal Nguyen Thi Tam, 45, and accountant Tran Thi Hang, 44, for taking 6% of purchase value as bribes from Oct 2024–Mar 2026 to secure food supplies and meals for schools in Dong Hy District. Vendor Nguyen Van Thanh, 50, owner of a local food business in Vo Tranh commune, was arrested for offering bribes. Thanh’s firm supplied fresh and prepared foods to multiple district schools since 2022; for Nam Hoa Kindergarten’s 2024–2025 school year, Thanh agreed to pay 6% of the goods’ value monthly. Parents at Hoa Binh Kindergarten in Van Lang commune raised concerns about diseased pork; lab tests confirmed African swine fever virus and Escherichia coli in meat from Thanh’s supply. On Apr 8, 2026, the Thái Nguyên Health Department fined Thanh 22.5 million VND for food safety violations. Police are expanding the investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 学校への病気豚肉密輸事件で校長が逮捕
triage.triage_reason: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）とE.coli汚染肉が学校給食に供給される深刻な食品安全・公衆衛生事案。複数校への継続的な汚染曝露、地方自治体による実施、国内拡大リスクあり。
triage.notes: 本事案は学校給食への病原体汚染肉の供給という重大な食品安全事案。ASFウイルスとE.coli両者が検出され、複数の学校（Nam Hoa Kindergarten、Hoa Binh Kindergarten他）が2024年10月から2026年3月にかけて長期間汚染肉を供給されていた。ベトナム地方保健当局が違反を認定・罰金処分し、警察が捜査を拡大。子どもを含む多くの住民への潜在的食品ルート曝露リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sindnapi alerta para o perigo da gripe, que pode ser grave em idosos - Revista Fórum
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sindnapi warns about the danger of influenza, which can be severe in older adults - Revista Fórum
article.articleSummary: Influenza (flu) poses a heightened risk to people over 60, with potential progression to pneumonia, hospitalizations, and death as temperatures drop and respiratory illnesses rise. In Brazil, Sindnapi intensifies vaccination advocacy, noting annual flu shots as the most effective prevention. A special Podcast dos Aposentados episode features physician Luiz Alberto Catanoce outlining practical measures: keep vaccination up to date, frequent hand hygiene, well-ventilated spaces, and heightened care when flu symptoms appear. Beyond immunization, stay hydrated, avoid gatherings, and seek medical care at the first signs. Flu vaccine is available free at health posts for priority groups including seniors. For more information, contact Sindnapi at (11) 3293-7500 or 0800 357 7777. Publication date: 2026-04-17.

triage.headline_ja: Sindnapi、高齢者に重篤となる可能性のある季節性インフルエンザの危険性について警告 - Revista Fórum
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの一般的な健康情報・予防啓発記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の新規危機を示唆していない。既知の感染症の定期的な予防キャンペーン。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの既知リスク（特に高齢者）についての定期的な予防啓発・ワクチン推奨であり、新規の感染症シグナルではない。Sindnapi（退職者組合）による公開キャンペーンであり、異常な疾病発生や流行を報告していない。

article.articleHeadline: Sau vụ thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tuồn vào trường học, một hiệu trưởng bị bắt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After diseased pork was smuggled into a school, a principal was arrested.
article.articleSummary: Thai Nguyen Province's Investigation Police Agency on 17 April 2026 charged a bribery case involving the supply of school meals in Đồng Hỷ District. Nguyen Van Thanh, 1976, owner of a food business in Vo Tran Commune, allegedly paid bribes to Nam Hoa Kindergarten staff to secure contracts. Suspects Nguyen Thi Tam, 1981, former Nam Hoa Kindergarten principal, and Tran Thi Hang, 1982, the school's accountant, are charged with receiving bribes. From 2022–2026, Thanh supplied fresh and prepared foods to several local schools; for the 2024–2025 school year at Nam Hoa Kindergarten, Thanh agreed to pay Tam and Hang six percent of the total goods value monthly from Oct 2024 to Mar 2026. On 25 March 2026, tests on meat used in Nam Hoa's meals from Thanh's supplier returned positive for African swine fever virus and Escherichia coli. Investigators seized documents and assets.

triage.headline_ja: 豚肉感染症が学校に流入した事件後、校長が逮捕
triage.triage_reason: アフリカンスワインフィーバー（ASF）とE.coliの検出が学校給食で確認され、異常性・重症度・拡大リスクを備えており、IHR基準3項目該当。学校での感染防止対策・食品安全面での公衆衛生影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: ASFはベトナムの食肉産業に対する重大な脅威であり、学校給食への混入は公衆衛生上の重大事象。記事は捜査対象の汚職事件が主軸だが、基盤にあるASF・E.coli検出は感染症イベントとしてのシグナルに該当。ベトナムの食品安全管理体制と今後の疾病対策に関する情報追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dono de pizzaria é indiciado após surto alimentar que deixou uma mulher morta e mais de 100 intoxicados na Paraíba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pizzeria owner indicted after a food outbreak that left one woman dead and more than 100 people poisoned in Paraíba.
article.articleSummary: In March, a foodborne illness outbreak at Pombal's La Favoritta pizzaria in Paraíba, Brazil left 117 people seeking care at regional hospital and urgent care centers; one woman, Raissa Maritein Bezerra e Silva, died two days later from an acute severe intestinal infection. Investigations found contamination developed during food handling inside the establishment. Laboratory analysis by IPC-PB detected Escherichia coli and coagulase-positive Staphylococcus in tomato sauce and pizzas; meat tested at the source showed no contamination. Symptoms reported included nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, sweating, and pallor. No external toxins were found. The owner, Marcos Antônio, was indicted for crime against consumer relations; the pizzeria remains closed by Sanitary Surveillance, with judicial interdiction requested. The police concluded the inquiry and forwarded it to the judiciary; no single individual conduct could be pinpointed as causing the death, but sanitary violations prompted charges.

triage.headline_ja: ピザリアオーナーが起訴 パライーバ州での食中毒アウトブレイクで1人死亡、100人以上中毒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常性」の2基準に該当。1人死亡、117人が医療機関を受診した限局的な食中毒アウトブレイクであり、フルRRAの対象。
triage.notes: ブラジル・パライーバ州ポンバルのピザ店での限局的な食中毒事件。E. coli とコアグラーゼ陽性ブドウ球菌が原因。事業者が起訴され、施設は閉鎖。対象国リスト内ではブラジルのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue may pose similar risk of Guillain-Barre as flu, Campylobacter
article.articleSummary: Dengue infection markedly elevates Guillain-Barre syndrome (GBS) risk in Brazil, with an incidence rate ratio (IRR) of 16.75 during 1–42 days after dengue onset versus a 43-day post-onset control period; attributable GBS excess is 35.5 per million dengue infections. Among 5,055 GBS hospitalizations, 147 had a dengue diagnosis, with 89 cases in the risk window. The risk is greatest in the first two weeks and returns to baseline by day 43. Dengue-related GBS risk is comparable to influenza (IRR 16.6) and Campylobacter jejuni (OR 3–41). Data derive from linked national Brazil databases on hospitalizations, dengue notifications, and deaths (2023–2024, through December 2024). Studies in tropical regions like Brazil, India, and Malaysia suggest arboviruses may be more common GBS triggers than C. jejuni there. Clinicians in dengue-endemic areas should consider GBS in patients with progressive weakness during or after dengue to enable early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱はインフルエンザやカンピロバクターと同様のギラン・バレー症候群のリスクをもたらす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング感染とギラン・バレー症候群の強い関連性（IRR 16.75）が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、予想外の疾病負荷増加が示されている。また、インド・マレーシアを含む複数国での影響が示唆されており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの詳細な疫学データに基づいており、インド・マレーシアは文脈上、熱帯地域でのアルボウイルスのGBS誘発リスク検証の対象地域として言及されている。ただしブラジルとインドはWPRO対象国リスト内に含まれるため両国を verified_locations に含める。マレーシアはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。デング-GBS関連性の臨床的意義は高く、早期治療推奨の医療提言が含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Dono de pizzaria vai responder 117 vezes por venda de alimentos impróprios após morte e surto de intoxicação na Paraíba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pizzeria owner will face 117 charges for selling unsafe foods after a death and a poisoning outbreak in Paraíba.
article.articleSummary: Pombal, Sertão da Paraíba, Brazil, faced a foodborne illness outbreak linked to La Favoritta pizzeria. A municipal civil servant died from an acute severe intestinal infection; no toxins were detected. More than 100 others—117 people—sought medical care with nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain after dining during March 15–16. IPC-PB laboratory analyses identified pathogenic bacteria Escherichia coli and coagulase-positive Staphylococcus aureus in the sauce and pizzas; meat samples from origin showed no contamination, suggesting mishandling at the pizzaria. Owner Marcos Antônio Neto is indicted on 117 counts of selling or offering sale of food unfit for consumption, under a negligent crime against consumer relations. The business remains closed by health authorities, with prosecutors deciding whether to pursue criminal action. The case underscores food-safety failures in Paraíba.

triage.headline_ja: ピザ屋オーナーが衛生管理不備で117回の違法食品販売で起訴される。パライバで死亡者と食中毒集団発生
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで100人超の食中毒集団発生と1名死亡が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」と「重症度」に該当する。しかしブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため、フルRRA段階への進行は限定的。情報の確実性と発生国の適用基準を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジル（GeoNames ID: 3469034）は提供された対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。IHR基準2つ以上、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上が該当し、通常はPICKUP対象だが、対象国外のため監視段階（WATCH）と判定。記事は2026年4月17日の報道で、食中毒の原因はE. coliとS. aureusの混合感染と特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Adolescente de 17 anos com suspeita de raiva humana morre em hospital em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17-year-old with suspected human rabies dies in hospital in Teresina
article.articleSummary: As of 17 April 2026, a 17-year-old resident of rural Oeiras, Piauí, Brazil, died in Teresina with suspected human rabies. He had been bitten by a sagui about 40 days before symptom onset and presented to a local urgent care on 11 April with disorientation, projectile vomiting and persistent fever. Due to severity, he was transferred the same day to the Natan Portella Institute for Tropical Diseases in Teresina. Health authorities collected preliminary samples, with further specimens to be collected in Teresina and sent to Instituto Pasteur in Rio de Janeiro for analysis. The Sesapi has opened an epidemiological investigation; a laboratory confirmation of rabies is pending. Ongoing monitoring and public health actions will be taken as the investigation proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナの病院で狂犬病疑い患者の17歳少年が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ヒト狂犬病の死亡疑い例で深刻な公衆衛生影響あり。ブラジルにおける予想外の重症例であり、国内での感染確認による流行リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが示すイベント発生地域はTeresina, Oeiras, Piauíの各所在地であり、全てブラジル国内。対象国リストではBrazil (3469034) のみ該当。ヒト狂犬病の確定診断待機中であり、Instituto Pasteurでの検査結果が重要。動物咬傷源（サグイ）の確認も含め、公衆衛生対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 80% dos focos de dengue estão nas casas, diz governo de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 80% of dengue hotspots are in homes, says the São Paulo state government.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in São Paulo state, Brazil: about 80% of dengue hotspots are inside residences, prompting intensified home-focused vector control. More than 40,000 health workers are deployed to monitor Aedes aegypti foci, conduct house visits, cleaning campaigns, and education efforts. To prevent new infections, 2.6 million vaccine doses produced by Instituto Butantan have been distributed; the vaccine is a single-dose formulation covering all four dengue serotypes. Households are advised to remove standing water, store or discard tires, regularly clean pet water containers, keep water tanks sealed, clean gutters and drains, cover pools when not in use, and dispose of items that collect water. Actions reflect the São Paulo government’s public health measures as of 17 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 80%のデングス熱の発生源は住宅内にあるとサンパウロ州政府が報告
triage.triage_reason: デングス熱の流行がブラジル（対象国）で確認されており、スクリーニング基準で複数該当するが、記事は政府の対応・予防措置の説明が中心で、直近の患者数増加の深刻度や国際的拡大リスクの具体的な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州でのデングス熱流行に対する州政府の積極的な対応（40,000人以上の保健労働者配置、260万用量のワクチン配布）を報告している。流行は継続中（prolonged_exposure）でありヒト-ヒト媒介（ネッシー）の特性がある（epidemic_prone）が、現在の患者数の重症度や国際的拡大のリスクについては記事から明確ではない。続報を注視する段階と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose assusta: Dr. Leandro Baptista orienta população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Scares: Dr. Leandro Baptista Advises the Public
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces ongoing tuberculosis activity, transmitted via airborne droplets, particularly in poorly ventilated enclosed spaces. The causative agent is Mycobacterium tuberculosis, requiring targeted management. Early warning signs include evening fever, night sweats, and unintentional weight loss; without timely treatment, disease can progress to pulmonary and pleural complications. Subdiagnosis is common as patients delay seeking care, sustaining community transmission. In the public health system (SUS), diagnosis relies on sputum smear testing for acid-fast bacilli (BAAR), a low-cost, rapid method with broad access. Treatment is offered free nationwide, beginning promptly after confirmation with a six-month multi-drug regimen and regular follow-up. However, treatment abandonment remains a barrier, enabling relapse and continued spread. Dr. Leandro Baptista underscores rapid diagnosis, effective therapy, and patient adherence as key to interrupting transmission and protecting the community. The discussion accompanies World TB Day, highlighting the importance of awareness and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 結核が懸念を呼ぶ：レアンドロ・バプティスタ博士が国民に指導
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける結核の継続的な活動に関する啓発記事。異常性や予想外性は低く、重症度に関しても個別症例ではなく一般的な疾病管理の説明。ただし、治療中断による伝播継続という管理可能性の課題が述べられており、スクリーニング基準（流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に部分的に該当する可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld TB Dayに関連した啓発キャンペーンの一環。患者の診断遅延と治療中断が継続的な伝播を促進しているという管理可能性の課題が指摘されている。新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、周知的な公衆衛生メッセージであるため、IHR基準は該当しない。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」の3つが該当するが、情報が不足しており、現在の疾病活動の量的規模が不明である。

article.articleHeadline: Il virus dei pesci che può far perdere la vista all'uomo: ecco come avviene il contagio e i rischi in Italia - L'Unione Sarda.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fish virus that can cause blindness in humans: how transmission occurs and the risks in Italy.
article.articleSummary: Covert Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV) was first identified in 2014 in Chinese shrimp farms and may cross to humans via handling infected crustaceans (open wounds) or consumption of raw seafood. A Nature Microbiology study notes a possible human leap but emphasizes the small number of cases and the need for more data. In Italy, the Istituto Zooprofilattico Sperimentale delle Venezie (IZSVe) states there is currently no real risk linked to consuming fish or crustaceans, and no human cases have been reported in Europe. The article stresses caution about a potential zoonotic event, but evidence remains unconfirmed. Do not confuse CMNV with Betanodaviruses, which are common in the Mediterranean and do not infect humans because they cannot replicate at mammalian body temperatures. Italian national controls continue to ensure seafood safety; no active outbreaks reported.

triage.headline_ja: 魚のウイルスが人間の視力喪失を引き起こす可能性：感染がどのように発生するか、そしてイタリアのリスク
triage.triage_reason: 潜在的な人獣共通感染症イベントですが、ヒトでの確認症例がなく、科学的根拠が不確実であり、イタリアおよび欧州での現実的なリスクは現在のところ低いと当局が評価しています。
triage.notes: 記事は覆面死亡率ノダウイルス（CMNV）の潜在的な人獣共通感染症について述べていますが、本質的に予防的・教育的な内容です。イタリア当局は魚介類消費に関する実質的なリスクはないと明確に述べており、欧州でのヒト感染例は報告されていません。2014年に中国の養殖エビ場で初めて識別されたことから、中国は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加しましたが、イタリアはこの対象国リストに含まれていません。現在のところ深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは判断されません。

article.articleHeadline: MS representa 63% das mortes por Chikungunya do País
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health accounts for 63% of the country's Chikungunya deaths.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fatalities in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), Brazil, reached 12 as of April 16, 2026, accounting for 63% of the national total (19 deaths). By end-March 2026, MS had seven deaths, making the year about seven times more lethal than the worst year in SES history. The outbreak centers on Dourados, ~231 km from the state capital, which has eight MS deaths; the latest urban-area fatality is a 63-year-old man from Parque das Nações 2, confirmed by Lacen on April 16 after private-hospital care. Other MS deaths include two women (60, 69), three men (55, 73, 77) and two infants (1, 3 months). Two deaths are under investigation. MS reports ~5,352 probable and 2,639 confirmed cases; 46 pregnant women positive. Aedes aegypti is the vector. In 2025, MS had 17 chikungunya deaths—the most in SES history, from 5,428 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのチクングニヤ死亡の63%をマットグロッソ・ドスル州が占める
triage.triage_reason: チクングニヤウイルスの異常な死亡率上昇（前年比7倍）と多数の確定患者・死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準においても重症度が高く、管理可能性に懸念がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではないが、IHR基準2つ以上該当のため、ならびに死亡率が極めて異常（2026年は2025年比で約7倍のレート）かつ妊産婦感染46例を含む多数の患者が報告されているため、PICKUP判定。妊婦への感染と先天性異常のリスク、ならびに都市部での継続的な感染拡大に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: At least 5 dead in Burundi from a mystery illness: Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Burundi reports an outbreak of a mystery illness in the Great Lakes region with 5 deaths among 35 cases (case fatality rate 14%) since March 30, 2026. Common symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, and dark urine; severe cases involve neurologic symptoms, anemia, jaundice, and difficulty breathing. Testing has ruled out more than 200 pathogens, including Ebola, Marburg, Rift Valley fever, yellow fever, and Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever. Animal testing on pigs and cattle is underway to assess potential zoonotic spillover. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention is supporting disease surveillance, field investigation, clinical care, laboratory diagnosis, and infection prevention and control. The World Health Organization is assisting Burundi’s health ministry and has facilitated shipment of samples to the National Institute of Biomedical Research in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for further analysis.

triage.headline_ja: ブルンジの謎の病気で少なくとも5人が死亡: アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の致命的な出血熱が除外できない新興感染症で、アフリカ大湖地域での集団発生であり、WHO・Africa CDCが対応中。
triage.notes: ブルンジでの発生が主題だが、ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただしDRCは検体分析に関与しており対象国リストに含まれるため記載。記事では200以上の病原体が除外されているが、未判明の致命的疾患であり、高い致死率（14%）と神経症状を含む重症例が報告されている。複数の出血熱が鑑別に上がっていることから、国際的な懸念と支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Viagem no feriado exige cuidados para evitar dengue em casa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Holiday travel requires precautions to prevent dengue at home.
article.articleSummary: Holiday travel prompts precautions against dengue in São Paulo State, Brazil. With Aedes aegypti transmitting dengue, authorities note about 80% of breeding sites are indoors. Before leaving home, residents should eliminate any container that can hold standing water and perform essential steps: empty and clean plant pots, saucers and bottles; keep water tanks closed; discard trash and items that collect water (lids, tires, packaging); clean gutters and drains to prevent blockages; cover pools and tighten tarps; store buckets and containers upside down; check refrigerator and air-conditioning trays. Prevention reduces transmission; the São Paulo State Health Secretariat launched an awareness campaign. As of Thursday, 17 Apr 2026, dengue has 28,281 confirmed cases and 12 deaths; chikungunya 537 cases and 2 deaths. Data are available at nies.saude.sp.gov.br. The “Dengue 100 Dúvidas” portal offers FAQs on dengue, zika and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: 休日の旅行に際してはデング熱の予防対策が必要
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（サンパウロ州）でのデング熱、チクングニア、ジカの流行状況に関する予防啓発記事。確定患者数が報告されているが、記事の主眼は予防対策の周知であり、新規の疾病多発やアウトブレイク通知ではない。継続監視の対象。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の流行地域（ブラジル・サンパウロ州）における季節的な予防啓発であり、新規の異常事象ではない。死亡数（デング熱12例、チクングニア2例）は報告されており重症度は認識されているが、フルRRA進行の緊急性は限定的。サンパウロ州保健局による啓発キャンペーン実施中であることから当局による対応は進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Entrevista | Carmen Stephan: Malária, autoficção e como enxergamos a nossa própria mortalidade - Entretetizei
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Interview | Carmen Stephan: Malaria, Autofiction, and How We Perceive Our Own Mortality - Entretetizei.
article.articleSummary: Malaria: A Novel—Autofiction by German author Carmen Stephan—tells a malaria story set in Rio de Janeiro and informed by her 2003 illness contracted in the Brazilian Amazon. After a dengue misdiagnosis amid an outbreak and a period of delirious fever and hospital neglect, the disease is narrated not by the patient but by a female Anopheles mosquito, offering a forest-origin perspective on the human–nature bond while tracing the disease’s progression. Published early March by Tinta da China Brasil, with Claudia Abeling’s Portuguese translation and Goethe-Institut support, the work has won Germany’s Jürgen Ponto-Stiftung for literature and the Buddenbrookhaus debut prize. The autofiction also revisits malaria’s history and vector discovery at the turn of the 20th century, challenging air-transmission myths. Stephan maintains a strong personal/creative link to Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: インタビュー | カルメン・シュテファン：マラリア、自動フィクション、そして私たち自身の死亡率をどのように認識しているか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はドイツの著者による文学作品（小説）に関するインタビューであり、実際の感染症の流行やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。マラリアとデング熱は小説の題材として言及されているに過ぎず、現在の疾病負担や公衆衛生上の危機を示す根拠がない。
triage.notes: 本イベント情報は感染症の実際の発生（outbreak）ではなく、マラリアとデング熱を題材にした文学作品のインタビュー記事である。Bluedot APIが疾患名を抽出したが、これは作品の内容言及であり、疫学的シグナルではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya provoca a oitava morte em Dourados; há 4,9 mil casos prováveis - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya causes the eighth death in Dourados; there are 4,900 probable cases.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya has caused the eighth death in Dourados, with about 4,900 probable cases. A 63-year-old man, resident of Parque das Nações 2, is the eighth fatality; the seven previous deaths were Indigenous individuals, all confirmed by laboratory criteria. The patient developed symptoms on the 7th of the month, was hospitalized, and died on the 13th. As of the epidemiological bulletin released on Friday, the 17th, there is one more death under investigation: a 12-year-old Indigenous boy who died on the 3rd. The bulletin notes the chikungunya positivity curve in Dourados remains exceptionally high, roughly 67–79% during the period analyzed, indicating intense viral transmission in the community.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアがドウラードスで8番目の死亡を引き起こす。約4,900の疑い症例がある。
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドウラードスでのチクングニア流行は、確認された8件の死亡と4,900件の疑い症例を伴う重度かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響・異常性）およびWPRO基準複数（重症度・流行易感性・管理可能性）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、チクングニアの流行はブラジル内のドウラードス地域に限定される。高い陽性率（67-79%）と持続的な感染伝播、確認死亡数8件、疑い症例約4,900件は重大な公衆衛生脅威を示唆する。国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは現時点では記事に明記されていないため「不明」と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Profissionais de saúde de 4 municípios receberão capacitação contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare professionals from four municipalities will receive training to combat chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 4,492 probable cases and 1,710 laboratory-confirmed cases as of April 15, 2026; seven deaths confirmed, three more under investigation; 46 patients with positive or symptomatic infection hospitalized in the city; regional viral circulation remains high (case-positivity curve between 68% and 79%). In response, the State Health Secretariat (SES) and Civil Defense held a meeting to train clinical management for Basic Health Units in Fátima do Sul, Nioaque, Itaporã and Jardim, emphasizing care organization, operational support, and epidemiological monitoring; municipalities are updating SINAN data; SES surveillance technicians will reinforce field operations. In Dourados, actions in indigenous communities target eliminating breeding sites and improving water storage; Itaporã has begun cleaning efforts; the Dourados nucleus will continue to support operations. Conab provided basic food baskets for affected communities. Crhistinne Maymone stresses integrated, accountable actions.

triage.headline_ja: 4つの自治体の医療専門家がチクングニア熱対策の研修を受ける
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州でチクングニア熱の本格的な流行が発生しており、IHR基準2項目以上に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：死亡者7名・入院患者46名、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマットグロッソドスル州におけるチクングニア熱の急速な流行を報告している。4,492例の推定患者数、1,710例の確認患者、7名の死亡確認（3名追加調査中）、46名の入院患者という深刻な状況。ウイルス循環の継続的な活発性（陽性率68～79%）と複数自治体への地理的拡大が確認されている。政府当局による体系的な対応（医療専門家の研修、原住民コミュニティへのアクティビティ等）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hiệu trưởng bị bắt trong vụ tuồn thịt heo bệnh vào trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Principal Arrested in Case of Smuggling Diseased Pork into a School
article.articleSummary: Three people were arrested in Thai Nguyen province, Vietnam, for bribery linked to supplying meals and contaminated pork to schools. Former Nam Hoa Kindergarten principal Nguyen Thi Tam and accountant Tran Thi Hang were detained for accepting bribes; pork supplier Nguyen Van Thanh was arrested for giving bribes. Thanh’s registered business provided fresh and cooked foods to multiple schools in Dong Hy District since 2022. To secure Nam Hoa’s 2024-2025 meal contracts, Thanh allegedly paid 6% of the total value monthly from Oct 2024 to Mar 2026. In mid-March, parents at Hoa Binh Kindergarten, Van Lang commune, reported meat from Thanh’s supplier showing disease signs. Laboratory tests confirmed African swine fever virus and Escherichia coli in the meat. The investigation is ongoing, with authorities expanding the case.

triage.headline_ja: 学校への病気の豚肉密輸事件で校長が逮捕
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱と病原性大腸菌が確認された食品安全事件。複数の学校の児童が汚染された食肉に曝露された可能性があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、および管理体制の問題が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明示されている通り、タイ・グエン省ベトナムで発生した食品安全事件。アフリカ豚熱ウイルスと大腸菌の両方が学校給食用豚肉から検出された。複数の学校児童が長期間にわたり汚染食品に曝露されている可能性がある。当局による展開中の調査と処理体制が確認され、管理可能性基準に合致する。

article.articleHeadline: Sesapi investiga morte de adolescente com suspeita de raiva humana no Piauí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SESAPI investigates the death of a teenager with suspected human rabies in Piauí.
article.articleSummary: Suspected human rabies in a 17-year-old resident of rural Oeiras, Piauí, who died on 17 April 2026 at the Institute of Tropical Diseases Natan Portella in Teresina. The adolescent sought care on 11 April with disorientation, jet vomiting, and persistent fever; he had been bitten by a sagui (monkey) about 40 days earlier. Due to the severity, he was transferred the same day to the reference infectious diseases unit in Teresina. Diagnostic samples were collected, with additional samples to be sent for analysis at the Instituto Pasteur in Rio de Janeiro for definitive testing. Sesapi (State Health Secretariat of Piauí) has opened an epidemiological investigation into the suspected human rabies case and will implement necessary public health measures. Lab confirmation is pending.

triage.headline_ja: セサピ（ピアウイ州保健局）がピアウイ州での人間狂犬病疑い例の少年の死亡を調査中
triage.triage_reason: 人間狂犬病の疑い例による死亡例が報告されており、狂犬病は極めて高い致死率を有する疾患であり公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。また、確定診断待ちの状況であり、異常・予想外の事象としてスクリーニング基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は極めて高い致死率（発症後はほぼ100%致死的）を有する感染症である。17歳の少年がサグイ（タマリン属の小型猿）に約40日前に咬傷されており、その後発症した疑いが強い。診断サンプルはIPアメリカのリオデジャネイロの研究所（Instituto Pasteur）に送付予定で、確定診断待ち。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Unsafe drinking water in Shopian prompts public health fears
article.articleSummary: Unsafe drinking water in Shopian, south Kashmir, with turbid supplies from Gagren, Bonabazar and Nakhasi Mohalla raising fears of water-borne illness. Residents report water is muddy and unusable for drinking or even washing, persisting for weeks during the ongoing rains. Local fears center on jaundice, diarrhoea and gastroenteritis linked to contaminated water. Jal Shakti Department officials confirm high turbidity (NTU) during rainfall and attribute the problem to mountain landslides washing silt into sources amid Mughal Road construction. They say filtration plant work is underway and an extra water line from Padpawn is being laid to improve quality and reliability, though no completion timeline was provided. No laboratory-confirmed cases or outbreak number are reported in the article; authorities emphasize ongoing mitigation to prevent potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ショピアンの飲料水の安全問題が公衆衛生への懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 飲料水汚染による水系感染症の潜在的リスクが報告されているが、現時点では確認された患者数やアウトブレイクの報告がなく、情報が限定的である。今後の患者発生報告を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は南カシミール地域（ショピアン）での飲料水汚染問題を報道している。複数の地区（ガグレン、ボナバザール、ナカシモハラ）で濁った水の供給が報告されており、赤痢、下痢、胃腸炎などの水系感染症への懸念が示されている。ただし、現在のところ検査確認症例やアウトブレイク数の報告はなく、当局は予防対策を実施中とされている。患者発生の報告を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Quando tomar a vacina contra febre amarela? Infectologista faz orientações após casos em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When to take the yellow fever vaccine? An infectious disease specialist provides guidance after cases in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Three yellow fever cases have been reported in Vale do Paraíba, São Paulo state, Brazil, including a 38-year-old man who died; all patients lacked prior vaccination. Infectious disease specialist Ho Yeh Li, speaking to Alerta Brasil, notes the yellow fever virus is present in the country but largely restricted to the Amazon region and western Brazil. Vaccination is essential to prevent mosquito-borne infection, even in areas where urban and forested zones merge. Travelers should be vaccinated at least two weeks before exposure to forested areas to allow antibody development. If vaccination occurred in adulthood, protection persists; if first vaccination was in childhood (under 5), a booster is required. Since 2020, Brazil has recommended routine yellow fever vaccination to reduce risk and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病ワクチンはいつ接種すべきか？感染症医がサンパウロでの患者発生後に指導
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。ブラジルでの黄熱病患者死亡と未接種者の発生は公衆衛生上の懸念材料であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルのサンパウロ州パライーバ地域での黄熱病患者発生。死亡者を含む3例報告。未接種者が患者の全体構成を示しており、予防接種の重要性が強調されている。黄熱病は伝播可能性があり、アマゾン地域と西部ブラジルに限定されているとされるが、都市部での発生例は国際的な懸念となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sau vụ thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tuồn vào trường học, một hiệu trưởng bị bắt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After diseased pork was smuggled into a school, a principal was arrested.
article.articleSummary: On March 25, 2026, parents at Hoa Binh Kindergarten in Van Lang Commune, Thai Nguyen Province, reported pork used by the school showed signs of disease. Laboratory tests confirmed the meat was positive for African swine fever virus and Escherichia coli. The meat was supplied by the household business of Nguyen Van Thanh. During searches, investigators seized documents, items, and other assets with signs of legal violations to broaden the case. A school principal has been arrested in connection with the incident. The investigation is ongoing as authorities determine the infection source and any broader food safety breaches related to the school meal supply. This report is current as of 17 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病肉がこっそり学校に流入した後、校長が逮捕される
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラと大腸菌に汚染された食肉が学校給食に供給され、当局による逮捕と調査が進行中。食品安全の異常事態が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行可能性、管理可能性）が複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラはOIE報告対象疾患。学校給食への汚染食肉供給は公衆衛生上の重大事態。複数の病原体（ASF、E.coli）の同時検出と、食品サプライチェーンの法的違反が指摘されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当するため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: चीन की 'जीरो कोविड' नीति पर बड़ा खुलासा, 25 लाख अतिरिक्त मौतों का दावा र‍िपोर्ट | volunteer,Shanghai,Covid,disinfection,
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's 'Zero-Covid' policy: a major revelation, report claims 2.5 million additional deaths | volunteer,Shanghai,Covid,disinfection,.
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 mortality estimates for people aged 65 and older range 1.44–2.56 million excess deaths by end-2022, far above official tallies. A Bitter Winter report attributes the heavy toll to Zero-Covid measures—mass testing, digital surveillance, apartment-block quarantines, and stringent lockdowns—that persisted until late 2022. Omicron later breached the system, sparking protests and the December 7, 2022 abrupt end to Zero-Covid. Following reopening, shortages of fever medicines and antivirals, overwhelmed hospitals, and rapid viral spread ensued. In late 2022, elderly deaths surged up to tenfold; weekly mortality peaked at about 1030% above baseline, then 680% the next week, normalizing by February 2023. Across 2022 and 2023, total deaths rose 19% and 24%, respectively. The report argues the tragedy stemmed from abrupt reopening rather than the policy itself, leaving the health system unprepared.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の『ゼロコロナ』政策が大きく暴露、報告書が250万人の追加死亡を主張
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の過剰死亡に関する回顧的分析報告であり、現在進行中の新規感染症アウトブレイクではない。ただし公衆衛生政策の影響評価として社会的・政治的関心が高い可能性があるため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は2022年末のゼロコロナ政策終了後の過剰死亡に関する回顧的分析であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク検知ではない。記事配信日時（2026年4月）は未来年号であり、データとしての信頼性の確認が必要。IHR基準では『深刻な公衆衛生影響』には該当するが、『異常性』『国際拡大リスク』『渡航制限リスク』は認められない。政策批判と健康影響の議論が中心であり、アクティブなシグナルではなく歴史的評価。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmado primeiro óbito por dengue de 2026 no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue death of 2026 confirmed in Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleSummary: Dengue death confirmed in Rio Grande do Sul: an 83-year-old woman with comorbidities from Jacutinga in the state’s north died on April 15, marking the first dengue fatality in 2026 for RS. The notification comes as the state reports 596 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases so far in 2026. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; prevention centers on eliminating standing water and mosquito breeding sites, with health authorities urging seeking care at first symptoms. The Brazilian SUS dengue vaccine program, using Qdenga from Takeda, has operated since 2024; since February 2026 the strategy extends to all municipalities, prioritizing ages 10–14. A new national vaccine, Butantan-DV, is being introduced as a single-dose option, with initial doses distributed to Primary Health Care teams in RS and gradual rollout to the public beginning at age 59 and progressing to 15+. Historically, April is the peak transmission period (weeks 15–16).

triage.headline_ja: 2026年にリオグランデドスルで確認されたデング熱初死亡例
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル内のデング熱による死亡例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれておらず、IHR基準またはWPRO基準の明確な多基準該当が判定しにくい。ただし地域的な関心と季節性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはBluedot APIで検出されているが、提供された対象国リスト（CEPR対象国）に含まれていない（対象国はZambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）。実は3469034がBrazilのGeonamesIDであり対象国に該当する。したがってverified_locationsを修正すべき場合はBrazilを含める。ただし指示に厳密に従い、フィールド値3469034がリスト内のID 3469034と一致するため、Brazilを含めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Nodavirus, sintomi e cura del virus marino che può colpire l'uomo. "Il contagio avvenuto da gamberi infetti o crudi"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nodavirus, symptoms and treatment of the marine virus that can affect humans. "Transmission from infected or raw shrimp"
article.articleSummary: Covert Mortality Nodavirus, a marine Nodavirus first detected in 2014 in farmed shrimp in China, is being evaluated for human infection. A Nature Microbiology study suggests a spillover to humans could cause ocular lesions via contact with infected shrimp or raw consumption, but the evidence remains limited and not robust due to the case numbers analyzed. No confirmed human cases have been reported in Europe or Italy; IZSVe cautions there is no risk to Italian fish and shellfish consumption. Do not conflate with Betanodavirus, common in the Mediterranean and causing encephalopathy and retinopathy in fish; Betanodavirus cannot infect humans as it does not replicate at mammalian body temperatures. If human infection occurs, symptoms would resemble glaucoma: eye inflammation, elevated intraocular pressure, irreversible loss of corneal endothelial cells, and optic nerve damage. The virus appears to target corneal endothelium; it has a two-gene genome and may sequester mitochondrial structures to replicate.

triage.headline_ja: ノダウイルス、人間に影響を与える可能性のある海洋ウイルスの症状と治療。「感染した生のエビからの感染」
triage.triage_reason: 未確認の人畜共通感染症の可能性があり異常性があるが、確認された人間感染例がなく、証拠が限定的で不確実である。情報が不足しており続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2014年中国で養殖エビで初検出されたノダウイルスについて述べており、人間への感染の可能性を評価しているが、確認された人間感染例はない。イタリア・ギリシャ地域での実際の発症例の報告がないため、これらは検証対象から除外。中国での既知事例に基づく理論的リスク評価記事と考えられる。続報で実際の人間感染例の報告があるかどうかを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Infants at risk as measles cases climb
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in Quezon City, with 143 confirmed between 1 January and 15 April 2026. About one-sixth of infections occur in infants too young to be vaccinated, including 23 patients who are not eligible for the measles vaccine. Health officials issued an advisory warning that these infants rely on herd immunity—the indirect protection that results when a high proportion of the population is immunized—to avoid infection. The advisory was released late Thursday, signaling ongoing vulnerability among unvaccinated or vaccine-ineligible children during this period. The report underscores the need for sustained vaccination coverage in the community to protect the youngest residents, given the age-based eligibility gap described in the advisory.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹患者数の増加で乳幼児がリスク下に
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・ケソン市で2026年1月～4月に143例の麻疹確定患者が報告されており、患者の約1/6が予防接種対象外の乳幼児である。予防接種適格性の低下による異常な集団での流行であり、国内での持続的感染リスク、公衆衛生への影響、および管理・対策の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはフィリピン（特にケソン市・首都圏）での麻疹流行を主題としており、対象国リスト内の Philippines (1694008) に該当。143例の確定患者、約1/6（23名を含む）が予防接種対象外の乳幼児という報告はWPRO基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性）を満たす。IHR基準も2項目以上該当するため、フルRRA進行の優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese researcher on J-1 visa pleads guilty to smuggling E. coli bacteria into US disguised as women's underwear
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli DNA concealed in a shipment labeled as women's underwear was smuggled from China to the United States and delivered to Bloomington, Indiana, in March 2024. Youhuang Xiang, a 32-year-old Chinese national on a J-1 visa at Indiana University, pleaded guilty to concealing the bacterial DNA and was sentenced to more than four months in prison; he must depart the United States and face a fine and supervised release. The case arose from FBI investigations into suspicious shipments, and Xiang was stopped at Chicago O’Hare International Airport in November 2025 after returning from the United Kingdom. Investigators confirmed the parcel contained Escherichia coli DNA, illustrating the risks of importing biological materials without safeguards. The incident is part of broader enforcement against foreign researchers attempting to import biological materials, highlighting ongoing public-health and national-security concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 中国人研究者がJ-1ビザで米国にE. coli菌を女性用下着に偽装して密輸、有罪を認める
triage.triage_reason: 記事は犯罪行為（密輸）の司法手続きであり、実際の感染症の発生や患者発生を報じていない。生物学的素材の意図的な密輸であり、実在する感染症クラスター/アウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の発生事例ではなく、生物学的素材の違法密輸に関する司法事件である。実際の患者発生やアウトブレイク、感染症クラスターの報告はない。Bluedot APIが China を含める理由は記事中で密輸元国として言及されているためと考えられるが、実際の感染症イベント発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。米国も対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 को लेकर सालों बाद चीन की खुली पोल, मौत को लेकर डरावना आकंड़ा आया सामने | China S Covid 19 Case Exposed After Years Terrifying Death Toll Emerges
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 cover blown after years; terrifying death toll figure has emerged.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 first emerged in Wuhan, China, in 2019. The article notes that the pandemic has claimed tens of millions of lives, highlighting China’s role in the early spread. About six years later, a new report has emerged that questions China's official COVID-19 death toll figures, suggesting the reported mortality may be inaccurate. The piece frames this as a significant accountability issue, with researchers or observers challenging the official counts and reigniting scrutiny of mortality data since the Wuhan outbreak. It emphasizes the sensational death toll figure raised by the report, without providing detailed laboratory confirmation or infection sources. The focus remains on whether China’s official counts reflect the true impact of COVID-19 and on the ongoing debate over transparency in pandemic mortality reporting.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスをめぐり数年後に中国の隠蔽が露呈、恐ろしい死亡者数が明かされる
triage.triage_reason: 2019年に遡及するCOVID-19の死亡統計に関する後発的な報道であり、現在の新規感染症シグナルではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019年のCOVID-19初発生時の遡及的な死亡統計に関する報道であり、現在の新規感染症イベントではない。検出された異常（中国の公式統計への疑義）は、既知の歴史的なパンデミックに関する政治的・社会的議論であり、疾病サーベイランスのシグナルとしては不適切である。2026年の配信日時は将来日付であり、情報の信頼性に疑問がある。
