article.articleHeadline: Adolescente de 17 anos morre após contrair vírus da Gripe K
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17-year-old dies after contracting the K flu virus
article.articleSummary: European variant of influenza A(H3N2), known as 'gripe K', caused six cases in the Brazilian Federal District (DF) during epidemiological week 14 (5–11 April 2026); a 17-year-old girl died after infection in DF. In the same period, DF recorded 1,627 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, with 67 influenza-related, including the six H3N2 cases. Goiás State confirmed three K-flu cases in Caldas Novas, Anápolis, and Itumbiara; all patients had mild symptoms and recovered without progression. The report highlights ongoing transmission of the European-variant H3N2 in central Brazil, with health authorities monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: 17歳の少女がK型インフルエンザウイルス感染後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ヨーロッパ変異株H3N2による死亡症例が報告され、複数州での確認と継続的な流行の可能性がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルで報告された「K型インフルエンザ」（欧州H3N2変異株）。死亡症例1件、確定6件、複数州での確認がある。記事サマリーに基づきブラジルが確実な発生地であることを確認。SRAG症例数の多さ（1,627件）と継続的な流行兆候がRRA実施の根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente morre com suspeita de raiva humana no Hospital Natan Portella, em Teresina - Portal O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient dies from suspected human rabies at Natan Portella Hospital in Teresina - Portal O Dia
article.articleSummary: A 17-year-old resident of the Rural zone of Oeiras, Piauí, died in Teresina from suspected human rabies. The patient presented at the Oeiras UPA on April 11 with disorientation, vomiting, persistent fever, and progressive decreased consciousness after reportedly being bitten by a sagui (small monkey) about 40 days earlier. He was transferred the same day to the Instituto de Doenças Tropicais Natan Portella in Teresina, a reference center for infectious diseases. Clinical samples were collected; additional specimens will be sent to Instituto Pasteur, Rio de Janeiro, for laboratory confirmation. Sesapi states the case is under epidemiological investigation with measures to be taken as the inquiry proceeds. The event underscores potential zoonotic rabies exposure in central Brazil and prompts ongoing public health surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: テレシーナのナタン・ポルテーラ病院で狂犬病の疑いで患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ブラジルでの動物咬傷由来の人獣共通感染症（狂犬病）による死亡であり、公衆衛生上重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく、通常の対象国リストに含まれていないが、IHR基準を複数満たす重要なシグナルとして識別。動物咬傷（サグイ小猿）から40日後の発症であり、治療困難な狂犬病の臨床的特徴を示す。検査確認待ちだが、Pasteur研究所での確定診断予定。流行性疾患ではなく散発例だが、一度発症すれば致命的で、公衆衛生上の監視価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Az óceánból származó vírus fenyegeti az emberek látását
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ocean-originating virus threatens people's vision.
article.articleSummary: China reports the first documented human infection from a virus previously linked only to marine life. The persistent ocular hypertensive viral uveitis (POH-VAU) causes eye inflammation and elevated intraocular pressure, glaucoma-like vision damage. In a study of 70 patients diagnosed between 2022 and 2025 in China, all had confirmed infection with Hidden Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV). This marks the first human disease linked to a water-environment virus. Disease ranges from moderate to severe: about one-third required surgery, and one person became blind. Some cases occurred without direct water-contact exposure; the only common factor was close household contact or shared devices; human-to-human transmission not proven. CMNV is widespread in oceans across Europe and Africa and other continents, detected in about 50 marine species (shrimp, crabs, fish, sea cucumbers), causing symptoms such as discoloration and lethargy in animals. Virologist Edward Holmes notes the virus’ unusually broad host range.

triage.headline_ja: 海から由来するウイルスが人々の視力を脅かしている
triage.triage_reason: 未知のウイルス（CMNV）による新規人獣共通感染症の報告であり、IHR基準では異常性・予想外性が明確（基準2つ以上）、かつWPRO基準では重症度（失明例含む）、長期曝露（広域分布）、管理可能性で複数該当。公開情報レベルでも科学的・公衆衛生的な関心が高い事象。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月の日付（未来日）であり、シナリオ情報の可能性があるが、科学的合理性に基づきトリアージを実施。CMNV（Hidden Mortality Nodavirus）の人への初感染事例であり、海洋環境ウイルスの人獣共通感染症化は新興感染症として高い関心対象。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠は限定的だが、世帯内接触での集積が報告されている。欧州・アフリカを含む世界的な海洋分布が確認されており、国際的な懸念の対象となる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Profissionais da saúde de 4 cidades recebem treinamento para frear chikungunya em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health professionals from four cities receive training to curb chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Health professionals from Fátima do Sul, Nioaque, Itaporã and Jardim in Mato Grosso do Sul will receive targeted training to curb the chikungunya epidemic in Basic Health Units, focusing on care organization, operational support, and epidemiological monitoring. The reinforcement emerged from a 15 April meeting with the State Health Secretariat and Civil Defense to ensure integrated action and rapid population response. As of 16 April 2026, the state bulletin reports 12 chikungunya deaths in MS, representing about 63% of national fatalities. Dourados, about 231 km from the state capital, is the epicenter with eight deaths this year; two additional deaths are under investigation. Across MS, 5,352 probable cases and 2,639 confirmed cases have been recorded.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソドスル州でチクングニア熱の流行抑止のため4都市の医療専門家が研修を受ける
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱の深刻な流行で、12名の死亡（国内の約63%）、5,352疑似症例、2,639確定症例が報告されており、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」と「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度（複数死亡）と流行しやすさ（確定症例多数）が該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではないが、記事はマットグロッソドスル州での深刻なチクングニア熱流行を報告しており、死亡率が高く（12例、全国の63%）、州政府と防災機関による統合対応が実施されている。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Surto bacteriano: Molho de tomate contaminado causa morte e intoxica 117 pessoas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacterial outbreak: Contaminated tomato sauce causes death and poisons 117 people.
article.articleSummary: Contaminated tomato sauce at La Favoritta pizza restaurant in Pombal, Paraíba, Brazil, caused a bacterial outbreak linked to 117 illnesses and one death. Patients developed nausea, pallor, vomiting, diarrhea, and sweating after consumption. Investigators collected samples from the restaurant and consumers’ homes, finding high concentrations of Escherichia coli and coagulase-positive Staphylococcus in the tomato sauce and in pizza leftovers. The Paraíba Civil Police and the Institute of Forensic Science confirmed the contamination occurred during food handling in the kitchen, with no other sources or external contamination identified. The final report did not attribute responsibility to any individual owner, instead citing errors in internal production/manejo processes. The investigation began on March 15, 2026, following hospital visits by victims, and confirmed sanitation failures as the outbreak source.

triage.headline_ja: 細菌性アウトブレイク：汚染されたトマトソースにより1人が死亡し117人が中毒症状
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は1つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡と117人の患者）に留まり、国際拡大リスクや予想外性が低い。食品汚染由来の限定的なアウトブレイクと判断される。
triage.notes: ブラジルに該当する対象国（3469034）が確認されましたが、本イベントは1つの飲食店での食品汚染に限定され、継続的な公衆衛生脅威を構成しない可能性があります。死亡例を含む重症度は注視の対象ですが、情報源が地方メディアに限定され、全国規模の流行兆候がないため、経過観察段階が適切です。

article.articleHeadline: Alianza científica internacional impulsa investigación sobre el Chagas desde El Salvador
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International scientific alliance advances Chagas disease research from El Salvador.
article.articleSummary: An international scientific alliance backed by NIH will advance Chagas disease research in Latin America, led by the University of El Salvador with partners the University of South Carolina and the National University of General San Martín (Argentina). NIH funding will prioritize diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers and more effective treatments, focusing on early detection and clinical management of Trypanosoma cruzi infection. The multilateral program aims to strengthen regional research capacity, develop surveillance tools, and transfer technology to healthcare systems, while fostering evidence-based public policy and continuous training for medical and scientific personnel. In El Salvador, endemic transmission by the kissing bug (Triatominae) is present in Texistepeque, Santa Ana, San Fernando, Morazán; a rural housing improvement trial using earth, sand, cement, volcanic ash and lime reduced vector presence in about 150 homes. Experts include project lead Stanley Rodríguez and researcher Melissa Nolan.

triage.headline_ja: 国際科学連携がエルサルバドルからシャーガス病研究を推進
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病の研究・容量構築イニシアティブであり、新規の流行・アウトブレイク警報ではない。既知の地域的流行への対応支援プログラムであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国を発生地域として抽出しているが、記事サマリーはエルサルバドル発のシャーガス病研究プロジェクト（NIH資金）の発表であり、新規感染症イベント・流行警報ではない。対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）にはサマリー上で実際の発生報告がないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde certifica eliminação da transmissão vertical da doença de Chagas para cidades goianas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Certifies Elimination of Vertical Transmission of Chagas Disease in the Cities of Goiás.
article.articleSummary: Brazil certified elimination of vertical transmission of Chagas disease in two Goiás municipalities, Goiânia and Anápolis, during Expoepi in Brasília. The 18th Expoepi saw the Ministry of Health confer the certification on April 16, 2026, marking a milestone in stopping mother-to-child transmission. The achievement reflects decades of SUS work, including surveillance, primary care, and federative cooperation, and aligns with Brazil’s Brasil Saudável program and One Health approach targeting elimination of such neglected diseases by 2030. Officials Mariângela Simão and Marília Santini described the move as symbolic and a model for other municipalities. Ongoing risk persists in socioenvironmentally vulnerable areas with vectors, emphasized by climate considerations. The government has expanded Chagas diagnostics and treatment (notably pediatric benznidazole) with >130% growth in 2023–2025. Portaria GM/MS 9.628 (Dec 2025) allocated ~R$11.7 million to 155 municipalities; 2026 adds ~R$12 million to strengthen surveillance and vector control.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がゴイアス州の都市におけるシャーガス病の垂直感染排除を認証
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病の垂直感染排除は正の公衆衛生成果であり、感染症危機を示唆していない。IHR基準では「深刻な影響」「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」いずれも該当せず、スクリーニング基準も満たさない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはシャーガス病の垂直感染排除という正の公衆衛生成果の認証であり、感染症危機的状況ではない。政府レベルの関心は高いが、危機的なシグナルは存在しない。トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Primeiro óbito por dengue no RS em 2026 acende alerta para pico da doença em abril
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue-related death in Rio Grande do Sul in 2026 raises alarm about the disease's peak in April.
article.articleSummary: First dengue-related death in Rio Grande do Sul in 2026: an 83-year-old woman with comorbidities from Jacutinga died on April 15. The case was validated by the Centro Estadual de Vigilância em Saúde (Cevs) of the State Health Secretariat. The death coincides with peak dengue circulation, typically in epidemiological weeks 15-16 (mid-April). Rio Grande do Sul reports 596 confirmed dengue cases and one death in 2026; numbers are down this year, but authorities urge sustained vigilance and rapid response to initial symptoms. Common dengue symptoms include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, vomiting, and rash; early medical care is advised, particularly for older adults and those with preexisting conditions. In 2024, the state saw over 209,000 cases and 281 deaths. Preventive measures remain essential: eliminating standing water and expanding vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・リオグランデドスル州の2026年の最初のデング熱死亡が4月の疾患ピークに対する警告を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の死亡例確認に伴う重症度の上昇、季節的ピーク時期の流行状況、および当該地域での監視体制の必要性が確認されたためシグナルとしてピックアップ。
triage.notes: 2026年にリオグランデドスル州で初のデング熱死亡例が記録された。患者は83歳の合併症を有する女性であり、4月15日に死亡。州の監視機関（Cevs）により確認済み。2024年の同州でのデング熱は209,000件以上の症例と281人の死亡があり、流行リスクが継続している。季節的ピーク（4月中旬）時期での死亡確認であり、高齢者および既往症を有する者への注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vereador J. Wellington cobra ações contra mosquito da dengue em bairros de Caucaia - Portal Jurema News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Councilman J. Wellington calls for action against the Aedes aegypti mosquito in the neighborhoods of Caucaia - Portal Jurema News
article.articleSummary: Councilman J. Wellington filed two motions (Req. 524/26 and 525/26) with the Caucaia City Council urging urgent measures against Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Req. 524/26 requests the mayor and health secretary to deploy the fumigation truck (carro fumacê) in Parque São Gerardo, in coordination with the endemic-health team, to reduce local mosquito breeding. Req. 525/26 extends to Parque Soledade amid reports of increased suspected dengue cases and persistent mosquito presence. The proposals have been forwarded to the Executive for feasibility assessment and scheduling of actions in the two neighborhoods. The push reflects public demand for rapid health responses, particularly during rainy periods when Aedes proliferation rises. Health authorities emphasize community participation to remove breeding sites inside homes.

triage.headline_ja: カウンシルマン J. ウェリントン、カウカイアの地域でデング熱蚊に対する対策を要求 - Portal Jurema News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でのデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニアに関する地方議員の公式要求を報道しており、ベクター対策の必要性が示唆されているが、具体的な症例数、重症度、死亡者数が記事に記載されていないため情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのカウカイア地域でのデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア対策についての地方議員による要求活動を報道している。公衆衛生的な影響の深刻度、具体的な患者数、死亡者数などの重要な疫学情報が記事に含まれていない。ベクター対策の要求が提出されたという行政的事実のみの報道であり、フルリスク評価に必要な詳細データが不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。雨期のベクター増殖リスクが示唆されており、続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Adolescente morre com suspeita de raiva humana em Teresina após ser mordido por sagui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teen dies of suspected human rabies in Teresina after being bitten by a squirrel monkey.
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected in Teresina, Brazil, after a 17-year-old male dies, reportedly bitten by a squirrel monkey. The patient, from rural Oeiras, was admitted to an Oeiras emergency unit on April 11 with projectile vomiting, persistent fever, and disorientation, and died on April 17 at the Instituto de Doenças Tropicais Natan Portella in Teresina. Health authorities collected initial samples and will obtain additional specimens in Teresina, sending them to Instituto Pasteur in Rio de Janeiro to confirm or rule out rabies. The Secretaria de Estado da Saúde do Piauí (Sesapi) will open an epidemiological investigation. The bite occurred about 40 days before symptom onset, illustrating rabies’ long incubation; the patient was transferred the same day to the infectious diseases reference unit in the state capital for care and investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのテレシーナで17歳少年がサグイ咬傷後の狂犬病疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響と異常性）。狂犬病による死亡事例で、ブラジル北部パイアウイ州での人獣感染リスク。確認待ちの状況だが、致死的感染症の死亡報告のため迅速な確認と対応が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率ほぼ100%の重篤感染症。本事例はサグイ（リス属）による咬傷後約40日で発症し、多臓器障害（嘔吐、発熱、意識障害）後に死亡。ブラジル保健当局によるInstituto Pasteur（リオデジャネイロ）への検査確認待ち。野生動物との接触による動物由来感染リスク評価と地域での狂犬病予防啓発が重要。本データは2026年4月17日付で、イベント報告は迅速に実施されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: "SES-DF confirma 6 casos de "gripe K" no Distrito Federal em 2026"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SES-DF confirms 6 cases of 'K flu' in the Federal District in 2026
article.articleSummary: Six cases of Influenza A H3N2 subclade K (K flu) were confirmed in the Federal District (DF) between 5–11 April 2026 (epidemiological week 14), including the death of a 17-year-old girl; DF region logged 1,627 SRAG episodes in the same period. Three cases were confirmed in Goiás in Caldas Novas, Anápolis, and Itumbiara; Goiás patients had mild symptoms and all recovered. The DF and Goiás outbreaks coincide with the onset of the influenza season in March, with vaccination urged; over 100,000 doses have been administered in DF since 25 March, but vaccination coverage remains low (elderly 23%, pregnant 19.5%, children 6 months to <6 years 10%). The K sublineage—first detected in Pará in December—circulates with other variants; OMS/PAHO say there is no evidence of greater lethality or transmissibility. Diagnosis is laboratory-based; control relies on vaccination and basic measures (hand hygiene, masks, distancing).

triage.headline_ja: SES-DF、2026年にブラジル連邦直轄地区で「K型インフルエンザ」6症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでH3N2亜系統K（K型インフルエンザ）による限定的なクラスター（6症例、死亡1例）が確認されたが、公式当局は病原性や感染性の増加を示す証拠がないと述べており、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当性は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル対象国外のため verified_locations に含まず。ただし記事に明記されているのはブラジル（DF、ゴイアス州、パラー州）のみであるため、対象国リスト外のイベント。WPRO基準では複数該当するが、WHOおよびPAHOが病原性・伝播性の増加を否定していること、ワクチン対応が実施中であること、国際的拡大リスクが低いことから WATCH 判定。続報で重症度やクラスター特性が明らかになれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados não tem novos casos de chikungunya nas reservas, mas chega a 111 na área urbana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados has no new chikungunya cases in the reserves, but reaches 111 in the urban area.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya remains a major health issue in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. CHIKV is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. In 24 hours, 111 new cases were confirmed in the urban area, bringing the urban total to 1,858; indigenous reserves reported no new cases and remain at 1,461 since January 2026. The shift from Indigenous communities to urban transmission is evident. No new deaths were recorded, though one case is under investigation: a 12-year-old Indigenous boy who died on April 3. The bulletin notes a high positivity rate, with about 64.9% of suspected cases under investigation confirmed. Hospitalizations among positives are stressing urban primary care, urgencies, and hospital beds. Dourados accounts for more than half of state chikungunya deaths, with seven Indigenous victims, including two infants; the city’s seventh death (11th statewide) involved a 77-year-old Indigenous man with cancer. Diagnostic labs are available via SUS.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラドスではチクングニア熱が新規治療施設では新規症例なし、都市部では111に達する
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の都市部での継続的な伝播と高い陽性率が確認されているが、死亡者数が限定的(7名)であり、国際的拡大のリスクや渡航制限の可能性は記事では明示されていない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルのマットグロッソド・スル州ドゥラドス市でのチクングニア熱の都市部への伝播シフトが確認されている。2026年1月以来、都市部で1,858症例、先住民地域で1,461症例が報告されている。高い陽性率(約64.9%)と医療施設へのストレス(入院患者数増加)が課題。ただし、現時点では国際的な拡大リスクの記載がなく、IHR基準は2つ未満のため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Exams postponed as chickenpox spreads in Karnataka's Somwarpet
article.articleSummary: Spread of varicella (chickenpox) in Somwarpet, Karnataka, with the summer surge. More than 30 students at a private school in Somwarpet affected, leading to postponement of exams for a few days. Parents complain of insufficient pediatric care at Somwarpet government hospital, lacking a permanent pediatrician; visiting pediatricians from Madikeri only once weekly (Mondays) and until 3 pm. Shortages of anesthesiologists and radiologists reported, pushing families toward private or district facilities, creating financial burden for poorer families. Residents urge MLA Manthar Gowda to secure immediate deputation of a permanent pediatric specialist. Hospital administrator Dr Jameer Ahmed says chickenpox treatment is available at the government hospital and differentiates treatment for adults and children; high-dose antibiotics not routinely prescribed. Typical recovery within two weeks; skin marks may fade in six months.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州ソムワルペットで水痘が広がる中、試験が延期される
triage.triage_reason: インド南部で水痘の集団発生が報告されているが、現在のところ重症度や国際的拡大の証拠に乏しく、地域の医療体制問題が主焦点となっている。続報で患者数増加や管理困難性の確認を要する。
triage.notes: 水痘は一般的に予防可能な疾患であり、記事では重症例や死亡に関する記載がない。集団発生は30名を超える学生に限定されている。ただし、地域の医療体制の問題（小児科医の不足）と継続的な住民曝露の可能性から、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目が該当している。現在のところIHR通知基準には該当しないが、患者数の増加や医療体制の破綻兆候が報告される場合はPICKUPへの昇格を検討する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RS confirma primeira morte por dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul confirms first dengue death in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, confirms the state’s first dengue death of 2026. As of 2026-04-17, 596 dengue cases and one death have been recorded in the state; the deceased is an 83-year-old resident of Jacutinga in the northern region with comorbidities. The fatality occurred on April 15 and was disclosed by the State Health Secretariat on April 17. This year shows a substantial decrease from 2025, when 20,573 cases and 13 deaths were reported by the same point. Dengue symptoms include high fever for 2–7 days, headache and retro-orbital pain, myalgias/arthralgias, malaise, nausea/vomiting, diarrhea, and red skin rashes. Early diagnosis improves treatment and reduces complications. Vaccination is available across all RS municipalities, with priority groups including 10–14-year-olds since February, plus elderly, pregnant, and people with comorbidities. To vaccinate, visit the nearest health post with SUS card and vaccination booklet.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州がデング熱による2026年初の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」に該当（死亡者発生、複数州での流行）。WPROスクリーニング基準のうち「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事サマリーに基づきBrazilのみをverified_locationsに含めた。複数州（Minas Gerais、Rio Grande do Sul）での流行と死亡報告により重症度が確認されている。2025年同時期との比較で症例数は減少しているが、死亡者発生は公衆衛生上の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Adolescente morre no DF após contrair vírus da 'Gripe K'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teen dies in the Federal District after contracting the 'Gripe K' flu virus.
article.articleSummary: Gripe K, an influenza subclade, is affecting Brazil's Federal District (Distrito Federal) where a teenager died after infection; officials provided no patient details. Authorities say subclade K presence in DF has not altered the expected seasonal pattern, with no evidence of increased hospitalizations, ICU admissions, or additional deaths. In Goiás state, three recent cases were reported in Caldas Novas, Itumbiara, and Anápolis; all were mild and resolved with recovery. The subclade K shows symptoms including headache, runny nose, fever, cough, sore throat, muscle pains, and chills, with possible diarrhea, vomiting, hoarseness, and red, tearing eyes in some cases. No information on laboratory confirmation or infection sources is provided; no exported/imported case details are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: 思春期の少年がブラジル連邦地区で「グリペK」インフルエンザウイルスに感染後、死亡
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ新系統（Subclade K）の死亡例報告だが、現在の季節パターン内で異常なし、入院・ICU増加なし、検査室確認情報なし。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot発生地域にBrazil(3469034)が含まれており、記事はブラジル（連邦地区及びゴイアス州）での流行を主題としている。ただし、公式当局は季節パターン内での異常なしと述べており、検査室確認や国際的拡大のリスク情報が不足している。死亡例の報告は社会的関心を生じさせているが、RRA進行前に追加情報の入手を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: 中國非洲豬瘟疫情凶猛 病毒變異3天病亡 | 中國養豬業 | 生豬價格 | 養豬戶 | 新唐人电视台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's African swine fever outbreak is ferocious; virus mutates, causing deaths within 3 days | China's pig farming industry | live pig prices | pig farmers | New Tang Dynasty Television
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks are spreading across China with the virus mutating, causing infected pigs to die within about three days. Authorities are reportedly suppressing information, and many infected pigs have entered markets without proper disposal. Live pig prices have collapsed, with standard pigs around 110 kg selling for under 4 yuan per jin, and some stalls under 2 yuan per jin, far cheaper than vegetables. Hotspots include Hebei, Shandong, Liaoning, Yunnan, Jiangxi, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Fujian. External purchases show up to 80% infection in purchased piglets; self-reared pigs are deemed safer but may harbor asymptomatic, covert infections. A Beijing slaughterhouse owner says ASF is present nationwide and has mutated to cause death in three days, reminiscent of the 2019 outbreak when prices surged to about 40 yuan per kg. Current supply exceeds demand, with market manipulation by groups attempting short-term gains.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のアフリカ豚コレラ疫情は激しく、ウイルスが変異して3日以内に死亡 | 中国の養豚業 | 生豚価格 | 養豚農家 | 新唐人電視台
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラの中国全域での急速な拡大、ウイルス変異による高い致死性（3日以内）、および市場混乱を示す複数の警告信号（情報隠蔽、市場流通への混入）がWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は動物感染症だが、食糧安全保障・国際貿易・経済への重大な影響を及ぼす。記事は中国全域での広がりを明示し、複数省で急速な蔓延を記載。ウイルスの変異（3日での致死率）、当局による情報隠蔽、感染豚の市場流通、生豚価格の暴落などが深刻な社会経済的混乱を示唆。2019年のASF流行との比較言及あり。国際的な豚肉・飼料取引への影響リスク存在。

article.articleHeadline: Dono de pizzaria na PB é indiciado após 100 casos de intoxicação | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pizzeria owner in Paraíba indicted after 100 cases of poisoning | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Paraíba, Brazil — The Civil Police of Paraíba concluded an inquiry into March events in Pombal involving 117 people intoxicated after eating pizza at La Favorita, resulting in one death. Examinations detected Escherichia coli and coagulase-positive Staphylococcus in tomato sauce and pizzas; meat showed no problems, indicating contamination occurred during handling. Laboratory analyses confirmed bacterial infection, and the death of Raissa Maritein was attributed to acute severe infectious enteritis; toxic/exogenous substances were ruled out. The owner will be charged with multiple counts of crime against consumer relations (selling or exposing to sale a harmful or unfit product), due to the number of people needing medical care (117). The pizzeria remains closed by sanitary surveillance; the inquiry has been forwarded to the Paraíba Court of Justice, with a request for judicial interdiction of the establishment.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州のピザ店オーナーが100件の食中毒事件後に起訴される | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での限定的な食中毒事件（死亡1件、患者117名）であり、国際的拡大リスク、新興感染症の懸念、渡航制限リスクはなく、予防・管理も確立している公衆衛生上のシグナルではない。
triage.notes: このイベントはブラジルで発生していますが、ブラジルは本スクリーニングの対象国ではないため verified_locations は空配列となります。内容は食中毒事件の刑事告発であり、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては該当しません。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue pode aumentar em 17 vezes o risco de síndrome rara, diz Fiocruz | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue could increase the risk of a rare syndrome by 17-fold, says Fiocruz | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Dengue infection in Brazil markedly raises Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) risk, Fiocruz Bahia researchers report in the New England Journal of Medicine. The study, linking three SUS databases (hospitalizations, dengue notifications, mortality records), found 89 of more than 5,000 GBS hospitalizations from 2023–2024 occurred after dengue onset, with overall GBS risk 17-fold higher and up to 30-fold in the first weeks of dengue infection. GBS is a rare autoimmune neuropathy causing progressive weakness and potential respiratory failure. Brazil faced its worst dengue outbreak in 2024, recording ~4,013,746 probable dengue cases and 3,809 deaths, plus 232 deaths under investigation. The Health Ministry added rapid dengue testing to SUS and approved the Instituto Butantan dengue vaccine, which showed ~80.5% efficacy against severe dengue and durable protection for at least five years, per Nature Medicine. About 3.9 million doses procured; vaccination underway in 2026 for priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱はギラン・バレー症候群の稀な症候群のリスクを17倍増加させる可能性があるとFiocruzが発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱と重症合併症（ギラン・バレー症候群）の関連性に関する重要な科学的知見が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」および「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのFiocruzが行った研究結果を報告しており、2024年のデング熱大流行（約401万例、3,809人の死亡）の背景がある。ギラン・バレー症候群との関連性は医学的に重要な発見である。発生地域にBahia、New England、North Dakotaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はブラジルでのデング熱関連合併症であり、米国の地名は翻訳・報道関連の参照のみであるため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Primeira morte por dengue é confirmada no RS em 2026 | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue death confirmed in Rio Grande do Sul in 2026
article.articleSummary: First dengue death in Rio Grande do Sul in 2026 confirmed: an 83-year-old woman with comorbidities from Jacutinga in the state's north; death confirmed April 17, 2026 (case first documented on April 15). As of that day, Rio Grande do Sul had 596 confirmed dengue cases and 4,254 cases under investigation. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; prevention centers on eliminating standing water and mosquito breeding sites, with public participation emphasized. Health authorities urge prompt medical care at first symptoms to prevent progression, noting higher risk among the elderly and those with comorbidities. The state health secretariat notes ongoing transmission in the territory. Dengue vaccination via the SUS has operated since 2022, targeting children/adolescents aged 10–14, with expansion to all municipalities since February this year for the same age group.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年にリオグランデドスル州でデング熱による初の死亡が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部のリオグランデドスル州でデング熱による初の死亡が報告され、同州での継続的な感染拡大が確認されている。IHR基準（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性）および WPRO スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行性、継続的曝露）で複数の基準に該当し、国レベルでの関心が高い事例である。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事内容が明確にブラジル（リオグランデドスル州）でのデング熱死亡確認を主題としているため、この評価は参考情報である。同州での感染継続、高リスク群（高齢者、合併症保有者）への影響、公開ワクチン接種プログラム進行中などの文脈から、国内公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルとして認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Após 12ª morte, Câmara propõe mutirão de limpeza para enfrentar chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the 12th death, the City Council proposes a cleanup drive to tackle chikungunya in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, has caused 12 deaths, prompting a citywide cleanup drive to curb mosquito breeding. Councilor Pedro Pepa, president of the Health and Hygiene Commission, proposes that the Municipal Secretariat of Urban Services (Semsur) deploy teams and collection trucks to remove bulky waste, furniture, tires and other materials across districts on a published schedule. The effort targets Aedes aegypti breeding sites, vectors of chikungunya and dengue. Residents would place discarded items outside homes on designated days; routine household garbage collection would not be included. Public-private partnerships and media campaigns are urged to inform the population. Pepa emphasizes the rise in chikungunya cases and frames urban cleaning, alongside community participation, as key prevention. The plan cites his 2025 'Cidade Limpa' bill for ongoing cleaning actions and funding.

triage.headline_ja: 12番目の死亡例後、ドラード市議会がチクングニア熱対策のための一斉清掃キャンペーンを提案
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドラードでのチクングニア熱により12人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生）を満たし、地方自治体レベルでの対応強化が求められている。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドラード市）でのチクングニア熱の死亡事例（12人）と、地方自治体による積極的な対応（一斉清掃・媒介蚊対策）を報告している。チクングニアとデング熱の両疾患が言及されており、ネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の繁殖地対策が重点。地域での流行状況は深刻段階にあると判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmada a primeira morte por dengue em 2026 no Rio Grande do Sul - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First dengue death in 2026 confirmed in Rio Grande do Sul - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: First dengue death of 2026 confirmed in Rio Grande do Sul (RS): an 83-year-old woman with comorbidities from Jacutinga in the state’s north; death occurred on April 15. The SES via CEVS confirms ongoing dengue transmission in RS. Typical dengue symptoms include high fever (2–7 days), retro-orbital pain, headache, myalgia/arthralgia, malaise, nausea/vomiting, diarrhea, and rash. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water and mosquito breeding sites, installing screens, using repellents, and securing water containers. Since 2024, Brazil’s SUS dengue vaccination targets 10–14-year-olds, with two doses three months apart; the Takeda Qdenga vaccine is used, and a new national single-dose vaccine, Butantan-DV, is being rolled out, starting with primary care workers in RS and expanding to people aged 59 down to 15 as doses permit. By April 2026 RS reports 596 dengue cases and 1 death; 2025 had 52,794 cases and 53 deaths; 2024 had 209,669 cases and 281 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年リオグランデドスル州でデング熱による初の死亡例を確認 - ジョルナル・オスル
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による死亡例が確認されて重症度の懸念があるが、単一事例であり既知の流行地域内での発生。国際的な懸念や対策困難性の証拠は不足している。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではないが、提供された対象国リストに含まれている（3469034=Brazil）。デング熱は南米での既知の風土病であり、2024-2025年の統計から継続的な流行が進行中。単一死亡例であるが、ブラジル全体での死亡数増加傾向（2024年281件、2025年53件）の文脈内での発生。国内対策体制（ワクチン接種など）は機能しているため、国際支援の必要性は現時点では認識されていない。

article.articleHeadline: PIMS offers support to tackle measles, viral fever outbreak in Bangladesh | Others
article.articleSummary: Pacific Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), a multi-super specialty hospital based in Udaipur, Rajasthan, expressed willingness to support Bangladesh in combating ongoing measles and viral fever outbreaks by strengthening technical and healthcare services. Speaking at a press briefing in Dhaka, PIMS proposed advanced training for Bangladeshi physicians and low-cost treatment for complex diseases, including cancer. PIMS Onco-Surgery Services Director Dr Quresh Bambora said the institute is ready to send skilled medical teams if requested by the Bangladesh government, and to provide consultations and run awareness programs via digital platforms. The institute offers comprehensive treatment packages for Bangladeshi patients—covering accommodation, meals and diagnostic services—at more affordable rates than many Indian hospitals, with emphasis on cancer, gastroenterology and complex liver diseases, and no hidden charges. Dr Kamal Kishore Bishnoi highlighted plans for specialized training to help Bangladeshi doctors deliver modern, internationally standardized care.

triage.headline_ja: PIMSがバングラデシュの麻疹・ウイルス熱アウトブレイク対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで麻疹とウイルス熱のアウトブレイクが報告されており、異常性と長期曝露の可能性が認められるが、記事の主題はインド側の支援表明であり、アウトブレイク自体の重症度・規模・国際的拡大リスクに関する具体的情報が極めて限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからは、バングラデシュでの麻疹・ウイルス熱アウトブレイクの存在が示唆されるが、患者数、死亡例、重症度分布、流行期間などの具体的情報が欠落している。発生地域にはバングラデシュが含まれるが、記事の主題はインド・ウダイプルの医療機関による支援提案であり、アウトブレイク自体の詳細は不明。引き続き続報を注視し、アウトブレイク規模・影響に関する情報が得られた場合はフルRRAに進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: MS recebe vacina contra chikungunya e inicia ação em Dourados e Itaporã - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul receives chikungunya vaccine and initiates action in Dourados and Itaporã - O Progresso
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul received 20,000 doses of IXCHIQ chikungunya vaccine from the Ministry of Health, part of a 46,500-dose campaign. Doses will be stored in the state Cold Chain before distribution. On Friday, April 17, they will be sent to Dourados and Itaporã in proportion to population, with Itaporã receiving fewer due to its smaller population. The SES Immunization Coordination will forward the doses; vaccination will be carried out by municipal health secretariats under Ministry guidelines. The vaccine is a single-dose regimen for people aged 18–59. Because it is a live attenuated vaccine, there are restrictions: it should not be given to pregnant or puerperal women, immunocompromised individuals, those with decompensated chronic diseases, or people with a history of severe allergic reaction to components. Public target and operational strategy follow the Ministry of Health directives.

triage.headline_ja: マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州がチクングニアワクチンを受け取り、ドゥアラドスとイタポラで対策を開始
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアワクチン配布キャンペーンであり、新規流行や異常な公衆衛生事象ではない。予定された予防接種事業のため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州におけるチクングニアワクチン配布キャンペーンの進行状況を報道するもので、感染症の流行や異常事象の報告ではない。定期的な公衆衛生介入であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Sorocaba confirma sexto caso de raiva em morcego em 2026 | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorocaba confirms the sixth rabies case in a bat in 2026 | TVS+.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in a bat confirmed in Sorocaba, Brazil—the sixth case in 2026. The bat was found in the Ipanema neighborhood on 13 April and laboratory-confirmed on 17 April. Zoonoses teams initiated preventive actions within a 500-meter radius, conducting house-to-house visits, distributing informational materials on bat behavior, rabies risks, and how to respond to an abnormal bat. They also screen for potential bat roosts inside residences, perform active surveillance for contacts with dogs, cats, or residents, and verify that domestic animals are up to date with rabies vaccination. Preventive measures include reinforcing vaccination if domestic animals had bat exposure, and advising rapid access to post-exposure prophylaxis for anyone with suspected human exposure. No human cases reported; ongoing local surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ソロカバでコウモリ狂犬病の6番目のケースが2026年に確認される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのコウモリからの狂犬病確認事例だが、人間への感染は現在報告されていない。動物での複数事例は異常だが、地域の防疫対応が実施されており、情報不足により慎重な判定が必要。
triage.notes: コウモリからの狂犬病確認は2026年に既に6例発生しており、異常性がある。人間への感染は現在報告されていないが、地域の継続的なサーベイランスと予防措置が実施中。ブラジルはWPRO対象国外だが、地域検証により発生地がブラジル（対象国リストに含まれるため）として適切に記録。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentam os casos de Influenza em Japorã e Secretaria de Saúde alerta a população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases on the rise in Japorã, and the Health Department warns the public.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases rise in Japorã, Brazil, with health authorities warning that demand may exceed local capacity, threatening bed shortages and medicine stock as of 17 April 2026. Health Secretary Ivoni Maciel Góes Rosa calls vaccination the primary defense and reports vaccines are available at three sites: Unidade de Saúde da Sede (City), Distrito de Jacareí, and Unidade de Saúde da Aldeia Porto Lindo Yvy Katu. Alongside vaccination, authorities reemphasize hygiene and public-health measures—mask use, frequent hand sanitizing, social distancing, and well-ventilated environments—to curb transmission. People with symptoms should seek care promptly to enable diagnosis and prevent progression to pneumonia. Priority groups are urged to vaccinate without delay. The Ministério da Saúde guidelines include handwashing, nasal hygiene, covering coughs/sneezes, avoiding shared personal items, and staying away from crowds. Influenza can lead to pneumonia, dehydration, or cardiac complications.

triage.headline_ja: ジャポラでインフルエンザの症例が増加、衛生当局が国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのローカルレベル（Japorã市）でのインフルエンザ増加報告。医療容量の逼迫懸念が報告されているが、国際的拡大リスクや重大な公衆衛生危機の証拠は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はJaporã市（人口が限定的なローカルコミュニティ）でのインフルエンザ増加を報告。医療容量の懸念が記載されているが、絶対的な患者数、死亡数、重症度については記事に明記されていない。季節性インフルエンザの定期的増加である可能性が高く、異常性が限定的。対象国リストではブラジルが含まれているため verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Adolescente de 17 anos de Oeiras com suspeita de raiva humana morre em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17-year-old from Oeiras with suspected human rabies dies in Teresina
article.articleSummary: 17-year-old from Oeiras, Piauí, Brazil, died in Teresina at the Instituto de Doenças Tropicais Natan Portella with suspected human rabies. He was bitten by a sagui (squirrel monkey) 40 days before symptom onset, presenting vomiting, persistent fever, disorientation, and reduced consciousness; he was transferred to Teresina six days earlier. Epidemiological investigation is ongoing; additional samples have been collected and sent to the Instituto Pasteur in Rio de Janeiro for analysis, with preliminary tests already performed. Rabies, caused by Lyssavirus of the Rhabdoviridae family, is nearly 100% fatal. Transmission occurs via saliva from infected animals, mainly through bites; human incubation varies, averaging about 45 days. Prevention emphasizes human and animal vaccination and timely post-exposure prophylaxis; treatment protocols (including coma induction and antivirals) exist but survival remains rare.

triage.headline_ja: オエイラス出身の17歳がテレシーナで狂犬病の疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例として異常・予想外である。致死率がほぼ100%であり重症度が極めて高く、動物からのヒト感染が確認されており、さらなる感染事例の発生リスクがある。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではないが、記事サマリーは具体的な症例報告であり、狂犬病の致死率の高さ、動物媒介感染、進行中の疫学調査、パスツール研究所での検査依頼など、公衆衛生上の重要性が明確である。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、PICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Adolescente de 17 anos morre no DF após contrair vírus da gripe K - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 17-year-old dies in the Federal District after contracting the influenza K virus - O Alto Acre.
article.articleSummary: Six confirmed influenza K (H3N2) cases in the Federal District (DF) in 2026, including a 17-year-old girl who died. Cases were identified in epidemiological week 14 (April 5–11); DF also reported 1,627 SARI cases that week, with 67 due to influenza, including six H3N2. Goiás State confirmed three influenza K cases in Caldas Novas, Anápolis and Itumbiara; all mild, recovered. The pattern aligns with the seasonal March–April rise; vaccination campaign since March 25 has reached over 100,000 doses in DF, with 23% coverage in the elderly, 19.5% in pregnant women, and 10% in children aged 6 months to under 6 years. PAHO/WHO alerted on influenza K after cases in Europe; Brazil’s first case was reported in Pará in December; influenza A remains the main circulating virus; influenza K produces flu-like symptoms and is not shown to be more transmissible or severe. Vulnerable groups should seek care for fever or extreme fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: 17歳の少女がインフルエンザK(H3N2)感染後、連邦直轄地区で死亡
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザKウイルス(H3N2)による初の死亡例が発生し、ブラジル国内で確認症例が複数州に拡大。季節的流行時期における人口密集地での死亡事例は公衆衛生への重大な影響と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでブラジル国内の連邦直轄地区(DF)およびゴイアス州、パラー州での確認症例が報告されている。ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、PICKUP判定の理由はIHR基準2つ以上該当(serious_impact, unusual_unexpected)およびスクリーニング基準による多角的評価に基づいている。インフルエンザKはPAHO/WHOが既にアラートを発出しており、欧州での報告後にブラジル国内での死亡例確認は国際的関心を集める可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: RS confirma primeira morte por dengue em 2026 | Passo Fundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RS confirms first dengue death in 2026 | Passo Fundo
article.articleSummary: First dengue death in 2026 confirmed in Rio Grande do Sul: an 83‑year‑old woman from Jacutinga (northern RS); death occurred April 15. The state has 596 confirmed dengue cases, with 448 locally acquired and 4,254 cases under investigation. Novo Hamburgo, in Vale do Sinos, leads with 106 confirmations. Compared with the same period in 2025, RS shows a sharp decline from over 20,000 diagnoses and 13 deaths. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; prevention focuses on eliminating standing water and breeding sites. Vaccination under SUS since 2024 targets 10–14-year-olds with Qdenga (two doses, 3 months apart); expanded to all municipalities in February 2026. A national vaccine from Instituto Butantan, a single-dose shot, is used in RS for Primary Health Care workers; general population vaccination will roll out gradually as doses allow, starting with 59-year-olds and moving to 15+.

triage.headline_ja: RS、2026年最初のデング熱による死亡を確認 | パッソ・フンド
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的な懸念対象）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、ブラジルにおけるデング熱の明確な流行シグナル。
triage.notes: リオグランデドスル州での2026年初の死亡確認は重大。同州で596確認例、4,254疑似例。前年同期比では大幅減少（2025年同時期：20,000+件、13死亡）だが、新規死亡例の発生は流行の継続を示唆。AedesAegyptiによる媒介で、ブラジルの公式予防・ワクチン接種プログラムが進行中。対象国リストの要件により、ブラジルのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem 75% no Brasil em 2026, aponta Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall 75% in Brazil in 2026, according to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a 75% drop in dengue cases in the first months of 2026, with 227,500 probable cases from January 1 to April 11, down from 916,400 in the same period of 2025. This follows a downturn after 2024’s record 6.6 million cases and 2025’s ~1.7 million. The Ministry of Health attributes the decline to intensified, coordinated actions with states and municipalities. Key measures include expanding Aedes aegypti ovitrap surveillance to 1,600 municipalities (aiming for 2,000 by year end), deploying sterile irradiated insects, and broadening Wolbachia release programs to 72 priority municipalities. Vaccination efforts also contribute: since 2024, immunizing children and adolescents aged 10–14 has reached 1.4 million doses. The data reflect ongoing domestic dengue control initiatives across Brazil. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak prevention, vector control, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるデング熱患者数が2026年に75%減少、保健省が報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで報告されたデング熱患者数の大幅な減少は、感染症危機ではなく積極的な公衆衛生対策による改善事例であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準の懸念基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはデング熱の「発生」ではなく「感染者数の減少」を報告するもので、通常のシグナルトリアージ対象外である。ただしブラジルが対象国リストに含まれていないため、別途の地域政策判断が必要な場合がある。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim aponta casos de chikungunya e dengue em Bonito e alerta para prevenção - Prefeitura Municipal de Bonito - OPINIÃO E NOTÍCIA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bulletin reports chikungunya and dengue cases in Bonito and urges preventive measures - Bonito Municipal City Hall - Opinion and News
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya and dengue cases reported in Bonito, Brazil, amid Aedes aegypti transmission. As of 16 April 2026, Bonito records 82 confirmed chikungunya cases, 297 notifications, and 1 death; dengue has 4 confirmed cases, 297 notifications, and no deaths; Zika shows no cases, no notifications, and no deaths. The municipality notes the presence of the vector and urges prevention. Ongoing integrated control measures include chemical and human house-to-house blocking, routine door-to-door visits, elimination of breeding sites, and a citywide cleanup campaign with cross-sector participation. Health education is expanding, especially in schools, plus information campaigns via radio and social media. Fogging (fumacê) is being applied, with a second cycle to start soon; residents should keep doors/windows open during fogging to improve coverage and continue eliminating standing water at home.

triage.headline_ja: ボニート市でチクングニアとデング熱の症例を報告する公報および予防対策を促す - ボニート市役所
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのボニート市でチクングニア82例（1死亡）とデング熱4例の確認例が報告されており、Aedes aegyptiによる継続的な媒介があるため、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）およびWPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行性）の複数に該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: チクングニア82例（1死亡）の発生は重症度を示しており、Aedes aegyptiの存在と継続的な媒介、統合的な制御対策（化学的・人為的な遮断、戸別訪問、幼虫源の排除、燻蒸処理）が進行中である。複数の媒介蚊感染症（チクングニア、デング、ジカ）が同地域で報告されているという点で注目に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Vacina contra chikungunya chega a MS e começa por Dourados e Itaporã - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya vaccine arrives in Mato Grosso do Sul and begins in Dourados and Itaporã - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccine IXCHIQ arrives in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, initiating a pilot vaccination in Dourados and Itaporã. The initial batch comprises 20,000 doses delivered by the Ministry of Health and moved into the cold chain, with distribution to municipalities expected to begin on 2026-04-17. Dourados and Itaporã were selected to test the strategy, with doses allocated proportionally to each city's population and administered by their municipal health secretariats. IXCHIQ is a single-dose vaccine for adults aged 18-59; it uses an attenuated virus and carries restrictions for pregnant women, puerperae, individuals immunocompromised or with decompensated chronic diseases, and those with a history of severe allergic reactions to vaccine components. Brazil's Mato Grosso do Sul is slated to receive 46,500 doses in this initial phase, though only part has arrived. Details on dates, sites, and schedules will be released by city halls.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアワクチンがマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州に到着し、ドゥアラドスとイタポラで開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はチクングニアワクチンの配布開始に関するニュースであり、新規感染症発生や異常な疾病状況を報告するシグナルではない。ワクチン接種は公衆衛生対策の実施段階であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがBrazilを発生地域として検出しているが、記事の主題はワクチン配布開始の公衆衛生施策であり、感染症イベント（新規発生、流行の拡大等）の報告ではない。対象国リストにはBrazil (3469034) が含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。本記事は疾病監視シグナルではなく、ルーチンの公衆衛生ニュースであるため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: TODOS CONTRA A RAIVA - Após aparecimento de morcegos infectados, Prefeitura promove vacinação contra a raiva no Bairro Funcionários
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: All Against Rabies: Following the Emergence of Infected Bats, the City Hall Promotes Rabies Vaccination in the Funcionários Neighborhood
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Montes Claros: an infected bat was found in the Funcionários neighborhood. To curb the near-100% fatal disease in humans, the City Hall will launch a mass dog and cat vaccination in that area. Beginning Wednesday the 22nd and continuing until the 24th, from 8:00 to 16:00, residents should bring dogs and cats over 3 months old that have not been vaccinated in the last six months to vaccination sites: Praça Champagnat in Jardim São Luís and Praça Nossa Senhora das Graças / Paróquia São Norberto in Sagrada Família. The rabies vaccine, available through SUS, is the key protective measure. Rabies remains a major cause of thousands of deaths globally each year.

triage.headline_ja: すべての人が狂犬病に対抗—感染したコウモリの出現後、市役所がフンシオナーリオス地区での狂犬病ワクチン接種を推進
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の発生が確認されているが、現在のところ人間への感染確認がなく、動物ワクチン接種による対応が進行中。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域がブラジルと示されていますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列となります。狂犬病は致死率が極めて高い疾患（約100%）で、動物から人間への伝播リスクが存在します。市役所による迅速なワクチン接種対応が実施されており、現在のところは制御可能と評価されるため WATCH 判定としました。

article.articleHeadline: Avicultura e Exportação: influenza aviária redefine comércio global de frango nos EUA sem colapso dos mercados | Agrimidia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poultry farming and exports: Avian influenza redefines the global chicken trade in the United States without market collapses | Agrimidia
article.articleSummary: High-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) is reshaping the United States’ international poultry trade without wholesale market collapses, thanks to sustained sanitary agreements and vigilant surveillance. Despite sanitary and production pressures, the U.S. preserves significant export markets, supported by roughly 150 sanitary-zone pacts spanning over 80 destinations, enabling restrictions limited to outbreak areas (often within 10 kilometers or by county) rather than broad bans. Some markets still apply state-level restrictions, increasing regional impact. The debate over vaccination is central: supporters urge vaccines for layers and turkeys as an added control tool, while the chicken-meat sector fears potential export barriers for vaccinated products. Consultations ongoing since 2025 aim to balance disease control with competitiveness. Reduced infection rates in laying hens have eased domestic egg prices, allowing a gradual USDA policy approach. Global demand for poultry protein remains a key driver for continued trade.

triage.headline_ja: 畜産と輸出：鳥インフルエンザが米国のグローバルな鶏肉貿易を再定義、市場崩壊なし
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザは米国の家畜部門に影響しており、国際貿易への直接的な影響も報告されている。しかし、記事のトーンは「市場崩壊なし」「警戒下での継続」であり、急性的な危機段階ではない。ブラジルは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではブラジルでの発生は明確に記述されておらず、主題は米国の貿易戦略である。継続的な監視が必要だが、現段階ではフル評価に進む緊急性は限定的。
triage.notes: IHR基準は3つ該当（serious_impact, international_spread, travel_trade_restriction）しており技術的にはPICKUP水準。しかし記事サマリーの主題は『市場崩壊がない』『統制下での継続』であり、進行中の危機というより既に管理されている状況である。ブラジルは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーでは米国の貿易とワクチンに関する議論が中心で、ブラジルでの新規発生について直接的な記述がない。地域検証上、確実な発生は米国だが、対象国リストに米国は含まれていない。ブラジルは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。情報の時系列（2025年からの協議継続、2026年4月時点）から考えると、新規のアウトブレイク報告というより、進行中の状況の分析報道と考えられる。引き続き監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus respiratório que avança no RS tem nove casos registrados em Caxias e Bento Gonçalves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory virus spreading in Rio Grande do Sul has nine cases registered in Caxias do Sul and Bento Gonçalves.
article.articleSummary: RSV (respiratory syncytial virus) is rising in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. By 17 April 2026, nine RSV hospitalizations were recorded in the Serra region—eight in Caxias do Sul and one in Bento Gonçalves. In 2025 the state had 3,621 RSV hospitalizations and 68 deaths; 2024 had 2,752 hospitalizations and 56 deaths, and 2023 had 2,222 hospitalizations and 43 deaths. No Serra RSV deaths so far in 2026; eight deaths were recorded in 2025 across Serra municipalities. With winter 2026 approaching, the most vulnerable are infants in their first year and adults over 60. Diagnosis requires laboratory confirmation; rapid tests can detect influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and RSV. Incubation 2–8 days; transmission via droplets or direct contact; surfaces may harbor the virus. Prevention for infants includes maternal Abrysvo vaccination from 28 weeks and Beyfortus (nirsevimabe), a single-dose monoclonal providing 3–6 months protection; Beyfortus has been available on SUS since Feb 2026 for preterm infants born after Aug 2025 (<6 months) and high-risk children up to 2 years. For adults, RSV vaccines Abrysvo and Arexvy are available privately; SBIm recommends vaccination for 70+ and 18–69 with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・リオグランデドスル州で拡大している呼吸器ウイルス感染症、カシアス・ド・スルとベント・ゴンサルベスで9症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: RSV感染症の季節的増加が報告されており、対象国（ブラジル）での発生が確認されるが、現時点での症例数（9件の入院）は限定的で、死亡報告は2026年では未報告。社会的関心は不明だが、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: RSVは季節的呼吸器感染症として既知であり、記事は冬期到来に伴う予測される増加を報告している。過去3年間の統計比較から増加傾向が見られるが、2026年現時点での死亡報告がないため重症度は比較的低い。ワクチン予防策が整備されており管理可能性は高い。WPROスクリーニング基準の2項目該当により要経過観察レベルだが、シグナルレベルには至らない。
