article.articleHeadline: Agência Minas Gerais | IMA vistoria 50 propriedades rurais em exercício simulado de gripe aviária - OPINIÃO E NOTÍCIA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais Agency | IMA inspects 50 rural properties during a simulated avian influenza exercise - OPINION AND NEWS
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-17, Minas Gerais’ Instituto Mineiro de Agropecuária (IMA) conducted a five-day simulated response to a Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) focus in Pará de Minas and surrounding areas, inspecting more than 50 properties housing about 2.5 million birds. The exercise replayed all steps from case notification to containment: sample collection, installation of sanitary barriers, vehicle disinfection, and use of digital tools, with samples sent to the Ministry of Agriculture’s MAPA reference lab in Campinas. It aimed to strengthen the state's ability to protect poultry production and maintain market confidence amid high density and extensive transport. Minas Gerais has the fifth-largest poultry flock in Brazil and exported over US$300 million in chicken meat in 2025. The drill highlights stricter sanitary controls demanded by international markets, including Mercosur-EU accords; the virus is not transmitted by eating well-cooked meat. Cogran exports chicken cuts to Japan since 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州機関 | 鳥インフルエンザシミュレーション演習で50の農村地域を検査
triage.triage_reason: シミュレーション演習であり実際の発生ではないが、HPAI対応能力の強化と国際市場規制への対応を示す活動。予想外性は低く、社会的関心も限定的だが、経過観察の価値あり。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の鳥インフルエンザ発生ではなく、ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州当局による計画的なシミュレーション演習である。記事タイトルに『exercício simulado』（シミュレーション演習）と明記されている。発生地域にJapanが含まれているが、記事サマリー内ではJapanは輸出先として言及されるのみであり、実際の発生国ではない。そのためverified_locationsにはBrazilのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Reply to PIL seeking financial assistance for treatment and care of patients of rare neurological disorder caused by mutated measles virus, Bombay high court tells Centre
article.articleSummary: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a rare neurodegenerative disease caused by a mutated measles virus, is at the center of a Bombay High Court petition. As of 17 April 2026, Maharashtra has about 62 known SSPE cases. The court directed the Union Health Ministry to respond to a PIL by Mahadu Belkar seeking financial assistance for his son Tanish (16), who died on 10 March after over three years of illness. SSPE causes progressive neurological decline, vision loss, loss of movement, seizures, and eventual coma. The petition notes SSPE is not included in the National Policy for Rare Diseases (NPRD), 2021, though the NPRD provides a Rs 50 lakh one-time fund. Centre argues SSPE is not curable; CTCRD recommendations cited from Jan 30, 2025 and July 19, 2025. Hearing set for 19 June. Families report immense financial hardship, with some selling property and taking loans; some children had received MMR vaccine yet contracted SSPE.

triage.headline_ja: 変異麻疹ウイルスによる稀有な神経変性疾患の患者治療費支援を求める請願に対する回答を、ムンバイ高等裁判所がセンター（中央政府）に要求
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の稀有合併症（SSPE）が62件の既知患者数で報告されており、神経変性疾患としての重症性、予期しない臨床転帰、および公衆衛生政策での関心が高い。IHR基準2つ以上該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: SSPE（亜急性硬化性全脳炎）はワクチン接種後の稀有な麻疹合併症。マハラシュトラ州で62例の既知患者があり、進行性神経変性、視力喪失、けいれん、昏睡など重篤な臨床経過を示す。法廷での社会的・政治的関心が高く、公式な健康政策（希少疾病国家政策）への適用除外が問題となっている。MMRワクチン接種後の発症事例も報告されており、ワクチン安全性に関する公衆の懸念が存在する可能性がある。国際的拡大のリスクや渡航制限リスクは現時点では低い。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher morreu por infecção intestinal grave após comer em pizzaria da PB | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman died from a severe intestinal infection after eating at a pizzeria in Paraíba | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: A 44-year-old engineer and public servant, Raissa Maritein Bezerra e Silva, died from a severe acute intestinal infection after eating at La Favoritta pizzaria in Pombal, Sertão da Paraíba, Brazil, linked to a broader outbreak with about 115 people affected. Investigations by Polícia Civil and the IPC-PB found Escherichia coli and coagulase-positive Staphylococcus aureus in the tomato sauce and pizzas; meat sampled at origin showed no contamination, indicating the outbreak occurred during food handling at the pizzeria. Exogenous toxins were ruled out, and no single causative agent was identified. The owner faces charges under crimes against consumer relations (Law 8.137/90, art. 7 IX) due to the number of victims, though criminal attribution to the owner was not established. The establishment remains closed by Sanitary Surveillance; the inquiry has been sent to the judiciary. Death occurred on March 17; report published on 2026-04-17.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州のピッツェリアでの食事後、女性が重篤な腸感染症で死亡 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 食品媒介性E.coli及びS.aureus感染による死亡例1件を含む約115人の集団発生。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当のためシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 食品媒介性アウトブレイク（約115人の患者、死亡1件）。E.coli及びコアグラーゼ陽性S.aureusが食事由来品から検出。食品取扱段階での汚染が確認されており、食品衛生上の重大な懸念。当局による捜査・施設閉鎖が実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: MS começa a distribuir 20 mil doses da vacina contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health begins distributing 20,000 doses of the chikungunya vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul begins distributing 20,000 IXCHIQ doses against chikungunya. Dourados receives 43,530 doses and Itaporã 3,000, part of a total 46,500 for the state; shipments were sent by the Ministry of Health and will be deployed via municipal health networks. The vaccine is single-dose and live-attenuated for adults 18–59; contraindications include pregnancy, puerperium, immunocompromised status, decompensated chronic disease, and severe allergy history. State data show 5,352 probable and 2,639 confirmed chikungunya cases; 1,160 confirmed in Dourados. Twelve deaths are confirmed, two under investigation, representing 63% of Brazil’s arboviroses fatalities; nationwide chikungunya deaths this year total 19, with 8 in Dourados. Hospital Regional de Dourados expands to 15 exclusive chikungunya beds; total capacity 100 beds, including 20 ICU and dedicated adult/pediatric wards. Daily monitoring continues; indigenous areas receive enhanced vector control. Residents should eliminate standing water and seek care for fever with joint pain, headache, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、チクングニアワクチン20,000用量の配布開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は感染症の流行対応（ワクチン配布と医療対応）であり、シグナル的な新規発生や異常な拡大ではない。既知の流行地域での公衆衛生対応の一環。
triage.notes: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でのチクングニア流行は既知の状況。記事は公式ワクチン配布開始と医療体制整備についての報告であり、新規シグナルではない。継続的な流行対応として適切に管理されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Capacitação qualifica equipes para resposta rápida à febre amarela - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Training equips teams for rapid response to yellow fever - Click Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Guarulhos health department conducted a training to strengthen yellow fever surveillance and rapid response using the SISS-Geo app. The session included teams from Epidemiological Surveillance, the Center for Zoonoses Control (CCZ), and the Center for Strategic Information in Health Surveillance (CIEVS). Promoted by the State Health Secretariat’s Division of Zoonoses, it emphasized integrated surveillance, continuous monitoring of epizootics, primate illnesses and deaths as sentinels for Yellow Fever virus circulation, and timely actions such as intensified surveillance, vector control, and expanded vaccination coverage. The Contingency Plan for Yellow Fever was reviewed, stressing intersectoral coordination among surveillance, environmental, and laboratory sectors. Recent yellow fever cases and one death in Vale do Paraíba underscore vaccination. Vaccination is available at UBSs for children from 9 months with a four-year booster, and for ages 5–59 not yet vaccinated, including those who received the 2018 fractional dose, especially for residents in forested or ecotourism areas.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病への迅速な対応のための研修がチームを訓練 - クリック・グアルーリョス
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける黄熱病の監視体制強化と対応能力向上に関する記事。パライバ州とサンパウロ州で最近の症例と1件の死亡が報告されているが、記事の主眼は予防的な訓練・監視強化であり、新規流行の拡大を示すものではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の焦点は黄熱病の監視体制強化と対応能力向上の訓練であり、パライバ州とサンパウロ州での最近の症例（1死亡）は言及されているが具体的な症例数や流行規模は明記されていない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれる。黄熱病は風土病であり、継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行可能性（epidemic_prone）の観点でWPRO基準に該当するが、記事から深刻な拡大傾向を示す情報は不十分。

article.articleHeadline: 709 vials of dangerous viruses vanished from a high-security Brazilian lab
article.articleSummary: 709 vials of dangerous viruses, including Eastern equine encephalitis and oropouche, vanished from the Evandro Chagas Institute in Belém, Brazil. The theft occurred from a Biosafety Level 3 facility; discovery during routine inventory. Vials stored in ultra-cold freezers and would degrade without specialized equipment, suggesting risk if accessed by someone with compromised security. Brazilian federal police are investigating; no suspects publicly identified. The incident raises biosecurity concerns about access controls in high-containment laboratories worldwide, where most facilities rely on keycards, biometrics, and inventory logs that only work when monitored. The stolen samples were flagged for their pandemic potential, highlighting the danger of loss of materials from arbovirus research. The breach was not detected until the freezer inventory count, underscoring gaps in continuous monitoring of high-security inventories.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの高度セキュリティラボから危険なウイルス709バイアルが消失
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティ侵害（ウイルス盗難）による公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の異常事象、国際的拡大リスクの可能性、および渡航・貿易制限リスクがあり、IHR基準2項目以上該当。高度セキュリティ施設からのウイルス盗難は深刻な管理可能性の問題を示唆する。
triage.notes: バイオセキュリティ侵害事件。EEE（東部馬脳炎）、オロポーシュウイルス、シャーガス病関連のバイアル709本がブラジル・ベレムのEvandro Chagas Institute（BSL3施設）から盗難。盗難物は超低温冷凍庫に保管されており、専門機器なしでは劣化する可能性があるが、セキュリティが侵害された場合のリスクが指摘されている。ブラジル連邦警察が調査中。バイオセーフティレベル3のウイルスの盗難は世界的なバイオセキュリティ懸念となる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya em Sorriso: o sintoma de uma crise que vai além da saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya in Sorriso: the symptom of a crisis that goes beyond healthcare
article.articleSummary: Data from 2025 in Sorriso show a sharp escalation of chikungunya, with thousands of confirmed cases and a March–May peak, indicating urban conditions favorable to Aedes aegypti proliferation. Chikungunya, transmitted by the same vector as dengue and Zika, can cause severe acute fever and, in many patients, chronic arthralgia lasting months to years, leading to functional impairment, absenteeism, increased health-system burden, and broader economic and social impact. The article frames this as more than a health issue, highlighting urban governance failures: improper waste disposal, cluttered yards, and neglected spaces that sustain mosquito breeding. Generic campaigns are insufficient; recommendations include tying entomological indicators from ovitraps/larviv traps to performance-based incentives, ensuring data integrity, and adopting a preventive, territorial strategy. Technology—drones for rapid mapping, georeferenced systems, and climate/history data—should translate data into coordinated neighborhood-level action.

triage.headline_ja: ソーリッソのチクングニア：医療を超えた危機の症状
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニア、デング、ジカの同時多発が報告され、2025年データで急激な症例増加、慢性関節痛による長期的な健康被害と経済社会的影響が指摘されており、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・重症度）、WPROスクリーニング複数項目該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのソーリッソ（Sorriso）地区でのチクングニア急増を報告。2025年データで数千件の確定症例、慢性関節痛による長期的機能障害と経済社会的負荷が強調されている。同一ベクター（ネッタイシマカ）によるデング・ジカとの同時流行の可能性も示唆。都市統治の失敗（廃棄物処理不備、蚊の繁殖地など）が根本原因として指摘されており、感染症を超えた社会的危機として報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: First HMPV case detected in Maharashtra this year recovers
article.articleSummary: First confirmed HMPV case in Maharashtra this year: a seven‑month‑old boy from Washim tested positive on 30 March 2026, was admitted to AIIMS Nagpur and has since been discharged after successful treatment. PCR confirmation occurred on 30 March 2026. Officials say this is the state's first confirmed case, with only a few sporadic suspected cases previously. HMPV is a respiratory virus in the Paramyxoviridae family (related to RSV and parainfluenza) and can cause illnesses ranging from mild cold‑like symptoms to pneumonia or bronchitis, with the greatest risk to young children, older adults, and the immunocompromised. Five close family contacts were tested; all were negative, indicating no immediate household spread. IDSP surveillance reports no unusual surge in ILI or SARI, and authorities continue monitoring the Washim area for further cases.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州で今年初のHMPV症例を検出、回復
triage.triage_reason: 新興呼吸器ウイルス（HMPV）の確認症例であり予想外の検出だが、単一症例で重症度は低く、家族接触者は全員陰性、ILI/SARIサーベイランスで異常増加なし。情報不足であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一症例で軽度の経過、家族内伝播なし、サーベイランスで異常なし。ただし新興ウイルス（HMPV）の検出という点で監視継続が必要。追加症例報告や集団発生の有無を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Grande do Sul registra 1ª morte por dengue em 2026 | Estação FM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul records first dengue death in 2026 | Estação FM
article.articleSummary: On 17 April 2026, Rio Grande do Sul confirmed its first dengue death of the year, a fatality in Jacutinga, in the state's Northern region. The victim was an 83-year-old woman with preexisting conditions; she died on 15 April, according to SES/CEVS (Secretaria Estadual da Saúde and Centro Estadual de Vigilância em Saúde). The case signals ongoing dengue virus circulation in the state and reinforces the call for preventive measures and prompt medical care at the first symptoms. Secretary Lisiane Fagundes lamented the death and highlighted the importance of early diagnosis and timely treatment, especially for the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, which breeds in standing water. Preventive actions include screens on doors/windows, repellents in high-transmission areas, removing water-collecting containers, sealing water tanks, and clearing gutters.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州、2026年初のデング熱による死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の死亡事例であり、重症度の基準は満たすが、単一事例であり国際的な拡大リスクや異常性の評価が不足している。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジルのリオグランデ・ド・スル州における単一のデング熱死亡事例。対象国リストにはブラジルが含まれていないため、対象国外のイベント。WPRO基準では重症度と流行しやすさで2基準該当するが、IHR基準では1基準のみの該当であり、また単一事例であることから WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de síndrome respiratória grave em crianças menores de 2 anos crescem em todo o Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Severe Respiratory Syndrome in Children Under 2 Years Old Are Increasing Across Brazil.
article.articleSummary: As of April 17, 2026, Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin reports rising cases of severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) among Brazilian children under 2 across all regions, with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) driving most hospitalizations and bronchiolitis risk. RSV is a major contributor to severe disease in this age group, prompting vaccination advice for pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation to protect newborns in early life. For influenza A, activity remains high in parts of the Central-South, with increases in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio Grande do Sul, and also in the Northeast and North (Paraíba, Amapá). Prevention focuses on vaccination for children from 6 months, pregnant women, and the elderly, plus hand hygiene, avoiding touching babies with unclean hands, mask use, and cough etiquette to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル全土で2歳未満の子どもの重度呼吸器症候群患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、全国的な異常な増加傾向）。WPRO基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ）。対象国ブラジルでの重要な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル全域におけるRSVおよびインフルエンザAによる2歳未満児の重度呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の急増を報告。Fiocruzの公式情報に基づき、全地域での増加傾向が確認されている。対象国リスト外のため、ブラジルのみを verified_locations に含める。予防接種推奨と感染対策情報が含まれており、公開衛生対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Justiça condena dois hospitais após paciente morrer por dengue confundida com pneumonia em MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The court convicts two hospitals after a patient died from dengue that was mistaken for pneumonia in Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: Two private hospitals in Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, Brazil were ordered by the 11th Civil Court to pay R$300,000 in moral damages to the family of a patient who died from dengue hemorrhagic fever in May 2012, after dengue was misdiagnosed as pneumonia. The court found systemic failures at Hospital São Mateus and Hospital Jardim Cuiabá. Timeline: May 21 at São Mateus – presumptive pneumonia diagnosis without a chest X-ray, though blood tests indicated dengue; May 22 at Jardim Cuiabá – dengue diagnosed, patient discharged after hydration despite Ministry of Health guidance for 48 hours of observation; third visit to São Mateus – grave condition, 18-hour delay for an infectious disease specialist, about 4 hours for an ICU bed, patient in shock and multi-organ failure. The judge applied the “loss of a chance” doctrine. Each of the three relatives (including spouse and two daughters) receives 100,000; Jardim Cuiabá doctor must reimburse 50% of the award. Liability under the Consumer Protection Code was upheld, rejecting arguments of preexisting conditions. The case notes management changes since 2021 for Jardim Cuiabá and acquisition of São Mateus in 2021.

triage.headline_ja: マト・グロッソ州のデング出血熱が肺炎と誤診され患者が死亡した事件で、裁判所が2つの病院に有罪判決
triage.triage_reason: 本件は2012年5月の医療過誤訴訟の判決記事であり、過去の個別事件に関する法的判断。現在の感染症流行・アウトブレイク警報ではなく、公衆衛生緊急事態を構成しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2012年の医療過誤判決に関するもので、現在のデング流行を報告していない。Bluedotが対象国（WPRO地域）外のBrazilを検出したが、本記事は感染症シグナルスクリーニングの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Goiás decreta situação de emergência em Saúde por causa de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave | Jornal O Grito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiás declares a health emergency due to Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome | Jornal O Grito
article.articleSummary: Goiás, Brazil, declared a state of health emergency over Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS)–related illness Srag amid rising ICU occupancy. The government established the Center of Health Emergency Operations for SARS (Coe-Srag), coordinated by the State Health Secretariat (SES). The decree, signed by Governor Daniel Vilela (MDB) and published on April 15, enables emergency procurement of health inputs, hiring of temporary staff, and contractor services targeted at the outbreak, with flexible bidding rules where public interest exists. It also allows redeployment of personnel to strengthen health facilities. SES reports 2,560 Srag/SARS cases in 2026 year-to-date, down from 2,909 in the same period in 2025. Influenza vaccination coverage remains low at 8.69%, with about 115,000 doses administered; vaccination continues in the public network for priority groups. Public health measures focus on diagnosis criteria and outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州、重症急性呼吸器症候群による健康緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ゴイアス州でSARS関連の重症急性呼吸器症候群（Srag）による健康緊急事態が宣言され、ICU占有率上昇と2,560件の症例報告がある。政府による緊急対応機構の設置は公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性を示す。
triage.notes: Srag（重症急性呼吸器症候群）はSARS関連の呼吸器疾患。2026年のインフルエンザワクチン接種率が8.69%と低いことも懸念要因。記事はポルトガル語だが、ブラジル・ゴイアス州での発生が明確。国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクについては記事に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Chó 'điên' cắn 4 người ở Quảng Ngãi dương tính vi rút dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid dog bites four people in Quảng Ngãi; rabies virus detected.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak confirmed in Quảng Ngãi Province after 17 April 2026 laboratory testing of a dog head sample from Diên Niên hamlet, Sơn Tịnh Commune, tested positive for the rabies virus. On 14 April, a yellow-coated dog displaying aggressive behavior roamed along inter-village routes in Sơn Tịnh and injured four people; the animal was captured around 11:30 that day and euthanized. The positive test was conducted by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic Center - Diagnostic and Testing Station II. Authorities have intensified outbreak response: rapid surveillance of bite cases, guidance on post-exposure vaccination for victims, vaccination campaigns for dogs and cats in the area, and measures to limit spread. Public-awareness campaigns stress stronger pet management, especially not releasing dogs in residential areas during hot weather. Officials will secure the area and seek commitments from residents to confine and vaccinate pets.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ県でい犬が4人を咬む；狂犬病ウイルスが検出される
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の確認例（犬から検査確認）と複数の人的被害（4名咬傷）があり、ベトナムでの発生として IHR 基準の「公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」に該当。また WPRO スクリーニング基準でも「重症度（狂犬病は高致死率）」「長期曝露リスク（地域内のペット感染）」「流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト以外の動物媒介）」に該当し、シグナルとして確実に識別される。
triage.notes: クアンガイ省（Tỉnh Quảng Ngãi）での確認事例であり、ベトナム対象国に該当。狂犬病は高い致死率を持つ疾患であり、犬頭部検体からウイルス確認、複数の咬傷被害者が存在。地方当局による対応（予防接種キャンペーン、監視強化）が既に開始されており、政府関心も高い。ただし現時点で国際的拡大リスクは報道では不明。

article.articleHeadline: Viroses sazonais elevam atendimentos pediátricos em Ji-Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal viral infections increase pediatric visits in Ji-Paraná.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal viral infections, especially influenza-like illnesses, are driving a sharp rise in pediatric visits in Ji-Paraná, Brazil, at the Hospital Municipal Dr. Claudionor Couto Roriz. Children present with fever, vomiting, flu-like symptoms, and respiratory difficulties described as a 'heavy lung'. The surge is straining pediatric and emergency services, prompting hospital flow adjustments ahead of the weekend and holidays. Health officials urge that mild cases be directed to Basic Health Units (UBS) to preserve hospital capacity for severe and urgent cases. Preventive measures are emphasized: avoid crowds when showing respiratory symptoms, maintain frequent hand hygiene, and monitor for signs of worsening in children. There is no mention of laboratory-confirmed cases or fatalities; the article underscores ongoing seasonal activity and advises vigilance as the season progresses.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性ウイルス感染症がジ・パラナの小児科受診者数を増加させている
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの予想される増加であり、IHR基準で2つ以上該当せず、スクリーニング基準において異常性・重症度・流行性に明確なYesが見当たらない。地域医療への既知の季節的ストレスであり、確認死亡やアウトブレイク宣言がない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ様疾患による小児科受診の増加を報告しているが、これは毎年予想される季節的パターンである。確認された死亡例、実験室確認例、または国を越えた拡大の兆候がない。地域の医療機関による対応能力の調整が行われており、対症療法と予防措置が推奨されている。社会・政府レベルでの関心は存在するが、PICKUP基準には達しない。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo detecta material genético do vírus da raiva em fêmea de morcego e no feto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study detects genetic material of the rabies virus in a female bat and in the fetus.
article.articleSummary: Rabies virus RNA was detected in tissues from 11 pregnant bats of four species captured in northeast Brazil between March 2023 and January 2024 under Brazil's National Rabies Prevention Program. In Desmodus rotundus, viral RNA was found in the central nervous system, plus the gastrointestinal tract, kidney, and fetus. In four Molossus molossus individuals, rabies RNA was detected in the CNS. Sequencing recovered complete and partial genomes with high similarity, and phylogenetic analyses linked maternal and fetal material, indicating possible maternal-fetal (vertical) transmission in natural conditions. However, findings are limited by a small sample size (only one pregnant D. rotundus) and lack of tests confirming active fetal infection. Led by Mariana Guilardi (USP) with EPM/Unifesp and Lacen-CE; published in EMI: Animal & Environment; funded by FAPESP's Young Investigator program.

triage.headline_ja: 研究により、ブラジル北東部でコウモリと胎児からの狂犬病ウイルス遺伝物質を検出
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病の垂直感染の可能性が示唆されており、生態学的関心は高いが、ヒト感染事例の報告がなく、検体サイズが限定的（妊娠しているコウモリは1頭のみ）であるため、現段階では社会的・公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは不明確。続報に注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は動物における狂犬病の垂直感染メカニズムを示唆する学術的発見であり、ブラジルの国家狂犬病予防プログラムの枠組みで実施されている。ヒト感染リスクについての記述がなく、現時点では公衆衛生危機のピックアップ基準には達していない。ただし、狂犬病の自然条件下での垂直感染メカニズム解明は疫学的に重要であり、ブラジル当局の関心が高いと推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết xuất hiện sớm, cảnh báo nguy cơ bùng phát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early dengue fever outbreak detected, warning of outbreak risk.
article.articleSummary: First dengue fever cluster in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, detected in Vung Ang ward, Hop Tien hamlet; by April 17, 2026, 19 cases. On April 3, a patient with fever above 38°C, severe headache, anorexia, myalgias, arthralgia, and retro-orbital pain tested positive on a dengue rapid test and was admitted to Ky Anh Town General Hospital's Infectious Diseases ward. Ha Tinh CDC, local health authorities, and Vung Ang ward rapidly responded with containment: two rounds of adult mosquito spraying within 200 meters of the patient's home, environmental sanitation, vector control, and intensified community surveillance to identify suspected cases and contain spread. This is Ha Tinh’s first dengue cluster of 2026; statewide in 2026, 32 dengue cases have been reported, with one outbreak and the rest import-related. A dengue vaccine has been licensed since May 2024; vaccination should follow physician consultation; unusual warm weather may accelerate transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が早期に検出、流行リスク警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで2026年初のデング熱集団感染（19例）が検出。地域内での継続的曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染媒介の可能性（蚊媒介）、温暖な気候による拡大リスクがあり、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: ハティン省ヴンアン地区での初のデング熱集団感染。19例が確認、4月3日に最初の確定患者が確認。同省の保健当局が迅速に対応（蚊の駆除、環境衛生、サーベイランス強化）。2024年5月以降デング予防接種が利用可能。異常な温暖気象が伝播を加速させる可能性あり。WPROスクリーニング基準1つ以上該当かつ政府・公衆の関心があり、シグナルとして識別。

article.articleHeadline: Профессор Шахмарданов: оспа обезьян начала активно приспосабливаться к человеку
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor Shakhmardanov: Monkeypox has begun to actively adapt to humans.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox is actively adapting to humans, with the virus mutating five-to-six times faster than earlier strains, according to Murad Shahmaradanov of Pirogov University (Moscow) via TASS, as of April 2026. Long regarded a zoonosis, the DNA-containing virus now shows accelerated evolution, with molecular dating indicating lineage IIb’s rate increased five- to sixfold after entering humans, implying sustained human circulation. Mutations reflect action of the human APOBEC3 enzyme, part of innate immunity that edits viral DNA; such changes are evidence that the virus has circulated in humans for years, with sustained transmission beginning around 2016. An April 2026 Indian study analyzing 40 samples from multiple countries found mutations in three key genes—OPG002, OPG176, and OPG210—coding proteins that suppress immunity, blunt interferon signaling, and evade T cells, indicating deliberate refinement of immune-evading tools.

triage.headline_ja: シャハマルダノフ教授：天然痘ウイルスが人間への適応を活発に開始
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Iの急速な進化と人間への適応を示唆する科学的証拠が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。インド発の研究により免疫回避機構の獲得が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアのBluedot APIソースだが、Mpoxの進化についての国際的科学報告である。インドの研究が免疫回避遺伝子の獲得を報告しており、India が verified_locations。Moscow/Russian Federation は発生地域に記載されているが、サマリーではロシアは実際の発生地ではなく専門家コメンテーターの所属地のみで、具体的なイベント発生地としては記載されていないため除外。ただし、Mpox Clade Iの急速な適応と免疫回避能力の獲得は世界的リスク。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: No fear of H5N1, caution is key: Karnataka health minister
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza confirmed at a poultry training centre in Mathkur village, Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, Karnataka, with no human cases reported to date. Confirmation came from NIHSAD, Bhopal, based on an April 14 report. On April 15–16, authorities declared a 3-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone around the site. Earlier, 7,444 chickens, over 14,000 eggs and 2,250 kg of poultry feed were culled and disposed; ten staff were quarantined and placed under medical observation with Oseltamivir. Health officials are monitoring 19 villages with over 25,000 people, conducting door-to-door fever surveillance. The public is advised to avoid contact with sick or dead birds; rapid response teams visited the site on April 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1への恐れはなし、注意が重要：カルナータカ州保健相
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるH5N1確認事例（動物での確認、人への感染なし）であり、IHR基準「異常/予想外」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準「異常/予想外」「長期曝露リスク（25,000人以上の人口監視中）」に複数該当。公衆衛生対応が実施中であり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 現在のところ人への感染は報告されていないが、畜産施設での確認により予想外のシグナル。25,000人以上を対象とした監視体制が敷かれており、長期曝露リスクが存在。H5N1は流行しやすい病原体であり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mystery Illness Outbreak Kills Five in Burundi - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Burundi's northern Mpanda district faces a mysterious illness with five deaths and 40 cases since March 30, 2026. Symptoms: fever, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, dark urine, fatigue, abdominal pain; severe cases include jaundice, anemia, and breathing difficulty. Ebola, Marburg, Rift Valley fever, yellow fever, and Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever have been ruled out; samples tested negative for more than 200 pathogens. Investigations are pursuing a possible zoonotic source, with testing on pigs and cattle underway. WHO is aiding Burundi’s Ministry of Health with surveillance, field investigations, clinical care, lab diagnosis, and infection prevention; samples shipped to INRB in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for further analysis. A joint Burundi-Africa CDC team is deployed for ongoing work. As of April 17, 2026, the case-fatality rate is about 14% (5 deaths/40 cases).

triage.headline_ja: 謎の病気の発生がブルンジで5人を殺害
triage.triage_reason: 未知の感染症で複数死亡、異常な症候群、ヒト・動物両面への影響、地域的拡大リスク（DRCとの国境地域）がある。複数の重篤疾患が除外されたが原因未解明のため、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の複数に該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的分析：イベントは『ブルンジの北部Mpanda地区』で発生していると明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当国である。ブルンジは対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、サンプルはDRCのINRBに送付され、DRCも調査に参加している点も考慮。複数の致死的な出血熱が除外されたにもかかわらず、原因が200以上の病原体検査後も未明であり、動物での検査進行中という点で、国際的なリスク評価が必要。WHOおよびアフリカCDCが既に関与しており、公式な国際対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 35岁孕妇吃冰箱剩菜后感染，抢救后坚持3个月仍不幸去世，"离开时刚过完生日两天"_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 35-year-old pregnant woman contracts listeriosis after eating leftovers from the fridge; after three months of treatment she died, two days after her birthday.
article.articleSummary: A 35-year-old pregnant woman in Zhengzhou, Henan, China contracted Listeria monocytogenes after eating fridge leftovers. After three months of intensive treatment, she died, just two days after her 35th birthday. Listeria can survive refrigerated temperatures (0–4°C) and even freezing (-1.5°C), making it a major foodborne pathogen often found in meat and milk. Pregnant women are at higher risk of miscarriage, premature birth, or neonatal death, since the bacteria can cross the placenta. Incubation is typically up to three weeks, sometimes over two months. Symptoms range from diarrhea to meningitis and septicemia in vulnerable groups; many healthy adults are asymptomatic. Common sources include unpasteurized dairy, deli meats, salads, unwashed produce, ready-to-eat foods, and pre-cut fruits; cantaloupe rind contamination is noted. Prevention: keep fridge at ≤4°C, store raw meats on the bottom shelf, avoid overcrowding, minimize door openings, and reheat leftovers for 10 minutes. Seek care if fever or diarrhea develops.

triage.headline_ja: 35歳の妊婦が冷蔵庫の残り物を食べてリステリア感染、3ヶ月の治療後に死亡、誕生日の2日後に逝去
triage.triage_reason: リステリア症による妊婦死亡という重篤な個別事例であり、重症度基準を満たす。ただし、散発性（単一事例）で国内からの拡大情報や国際的なアウトブレイク兆候がないため、フルRRA前の情報収集段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は食品媒介性リステリア症による妊婦個別死亡例の報告。IHR基準2つ（深刻な影響・異常性）とWPRO基準2つ（異常性・重症度）に該当するため、技術的にはPICKUP基準を満たす。ただし、単一散発事例で流行兆候や拡大情報がなく、食品衛生啓発記事の性質が強いため、確認情報不足の段階ではWATCH判定が妥当。追加情報（国内他事例の有無、食品トレーサビリティ、公衆衛生対応）を注視。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Adolescente de 17 anos morre após contrair vírus da gripe K
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17-Year-Old Dies After Contracting the K Flu Virus
article.articleSummary: Influenza type K (H3N2) detected in Brazil’s Federal District (DF) and Goiás in 2026. The DF Health Secretariat confirms six H3N2 cases during epidemiological week 14 (April 5–11), including a 17-year-old who died. In DF, 1,627 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases were recorded in the same period, with 67 attributed to influenza, six of which were H3N2. Goiás State reports three influenza K infections in Caldas Novas, Anápolis, and Itumbiara; all patients had mild symptoms and recovered. The pattern follows typical seasonality, with potential increases from March–April. Vaccination remains the primary prevention to avert complications, hospitalizations, and deaths, especially among children, pregnant individuals, the elderly, and healthcare workers. The influenza vaccination campaign began March 25; DF reports over 100,000 doses administered, with coverage around 23% in seniors, 19.5% in pregnant people, and 10% in children 6 months to under 6 years.

triage.headline_ja: 17歳の少年がK型インフルエンザウイルス感染後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では異常性と予想外性が確認され（H3N2ブタインフルエンザの死亡例）、WPRO基準では重症度（死亡例）と流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）が該当。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: H3N2ブタインフルエンザ（インフルエンザK型）による小児死亡が報告されている。ブラジルでは連邦地区（DF）とゴイアス州で複数の確定例が確認されており、疫学週14（4月5-11日）の期間に6例のH3N2症例が報告。死亡例が含まれているため重症度評価はYes。ただし、ゴイアス州の3例は軽症で回復しており、全体的な管理可能性は良好と判断される。ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Hospitalizações por influenza aumentam 160% em um ano no RS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-related hospitalizations rise 160% in one year in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul reports 143 hospitalizations for Influenza A this year, up from 55 in the same period last year, a 160% rise, based on the InfoGripe bulletin from Fiocruz as of April 4, 2026. The surge triggers vigilance as the influenza season begins, though the state remains at a safe alert level. The nationwide bulletin shows increases in 15 states, including Santa Catarina, Paraná, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, São Paulo and Alagoas. Authorities note concurrent circulation of influenza A, COVID-19 and rhinovirus, with older adults and children among the most affected. An influenza vaccination campaign runs through May 30, 2026 across Brazil. Target groups include adults 60+, children 6 months to under 6 years, pregnant women, puerperal women, indigenous and quilombola communities, healthcare and education workers, people with comorbidities, disabilities, homeless, security personnel, truck drivers and public transport workers.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南部リオグランデドスルでインフルエンザ入院患者が1年で160%増加
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA型の入院患者数が大幅に増加（160%）しており異常性を示すが、現在のところ公開情報では重症度（死亡例や医療逼迫）や国際的拡大の具体的な懸念が記載されていない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル全土でのインフルエンザ流行を報告しており、複数州での増加が記載されている。ただし死亡数や重症化率などの詳細な重症度指標が記載されていないため、PICKUP判定には至らず。ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中で管理体制が存在することも確認される。インフルエンザAの国際的な同時流行状況の文脈で注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 陸診所共用針頭抽血15人恐染病 負責人：員工亂操作已開除 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fifteen people may have contracted an illness from a Mainland clinic's shared needles during blood draws; person in charge says staff's reckless handling has led to their dismissal | United News Network
article.articleSummary: Hangzhou, China: In Binjiang District, a clinic conducted a free community check-up on April 14 using a single needle for blood draws on 15 residents, triggering concerns about HIV transmission and hepatitis B. Residents underwent medical checks and received HIV post-exposure prophylaxis and hepatitis B vaccines; none of the infections have been confirmed as of 2026-04-18. The clinic owner said staff acted recklessly and dismissed the implicated worker, questioning why nonprofessionals performed blood draws. Binjiang District Health Commission has opened an investigation; all involved have been tested and will be monitored regularly. The owner described the service as a charitable activity and pledged cooperation, though refused broad compensation claims. Video footage and disposal bag observations raised needle-handling concerns; authorities will determine further action based on ongoing monitoring and testing.

triage.headline_ja: 中国杭州の診療所が共用針で15人の採血を実施、HIV感染の懸念が生じる；責任者は不適切な職員操作を理由に解雇と説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性（予想外の医療過誤）と国際的拡大リスク（HIV・B型肝炎の共用針感染）が認められ、WPRO基準でも複数の基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）に該当。医療施設内での感染制御違反と複数感染症の同時懸念がシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 医療施設における基本的な感染制御違反（共用針の使用）による集団曝露事象。15名の確認された曝露者に対しHIV・B型肝炎の両方の懸念あり。現時点で確認感染なしだが、窓口期間内での発症監視が必須。地元保健委員会による調査実施中。社会的関心および当局の対応が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 入住成都凯悦嘉轩酒店屋里藏了只蝙蝠 旅客手臂现伤口连打11针疫苗 医生：属狂犬病三级暴露_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A bat hidden in a room at Hyatt Place Chengdu; traveler has a wound on his arm and receives 11 rabies vaccine injections; doctor: it's a Category III exposure to rabies.
article.articleSummary: On April 8–9, 2026, a guest at Hyatt Place Chengdu Xiangnanli in Chengdu, Sichuan, found a bat in his hotel room and sustained a left forearm wound. He sought care at Chengdu Wuhou District People’s Hospital, where clinicians classified bat contact as Category III rabies exposure and initiated post-exposure prophylaxis: rabies vaccine, rabies immunoglobulin, and tetanus vaccine (11 injections total), at a cost of 1,630.5 yuan. The hotel said the bat entry was likely incidental wildlife intrusion and engaged a third‑party team; investigations reportedly found no abnormal building conditions or bat habitats. The guest alleged initial hotel reluctance to cover medical costs, later reimbursing vaccines and offering room vouchers plus 3,000 hotel points; a private 10,000 yuan settlement offer was rejected. Chengdu CDC confirms Category III exposure and advises rapid treatment at a wound/ rabies vaccination clinic, noting bats may carry multiple pathogens and that testing is limited.

triage.headline_ja: 成都ハイアットプレイスのホテル客室で蝙蝠を発見 旅客の腕に傷口、狂犬病ワクチン11回接種 医師：狂犬病接触分類3級
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病暴露事例（Category III）であり、複数ワクチン投与が実施されているが、単一の接触事例で局所的インシデントとして報告されている。IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限要件は現時点で低いと判断される。情報が十分に確定しておらず、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一の野生動物接触事例（蝙蝠）であり、ホテル内の局所的インシデント。成都CDCが関与し、Category III暴露として適切に分類・対応されている。複数疾患（狂犬病、破傷風）が記載されているが、これは標準的なPEP（曝露後予防）プロトコルの一部。国家レベルでの対応は進行中だが、流行性や広域拡大の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bắt tạm giam hiệu trưởng mầm non cho "tuồn" thịt nhiễm bệnh vào trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preschool principal detained for smuggling contaminated meat into the school.
article.articleSummary: Thai Nguyen Province authorities charged three individuals linked to a scheme supplying school meals with contaminated meat. Nguyen Van Thanh, 46, a meat supplier; Nguyen Thi Tam, 45, former Nam Hoa Kindergarten principal; and Tran Thi Hang, 44, Nam Hoa Kindergarten accountant, were indicted on 17 April 2026 for bribery: Thanh for giving bribes; Tam and Hang for accepting bribes. Investigators tie Thanh's registered food business to contracts from 2022-2026 with several schools in Dong Hy district. For 2024-2025 at Nam Hoa Kindergarten, Thanh agreed to pay 6% of monthly goods value to Tam and Hang from Oct 2024 to Mar 2026. On 25 March 2026, meat supplied by Thanh from Nam Hoa tested positive for African swine fever virus and E. coli. The case is under expansion, with documents and assets seized; police directive to crack the ring. Ongoing investigation by the Economic Police.

triage.headline_ja: 幼稚園園長が病原体汚染肉の横流しで逮捕
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱およびE. coliの検出は重要だが、本件は食品供給スキャンダル・贈収賄事件が主題であり、感染症アウトブレイク（集団発症）の発生報告ではない。ただし汚染食品が複数校に供給された可能性があり、追加の健康影響情報が得られるまで経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主に贈収賄事件・食品供給スキャンダルとして報道されている。アフリカ豚熱（ASF）とE. coliの検出は確認されているが、学校関係者や児童の発症事例の報告がないため、実際の感染症アウトブレイク判定には追加情報が必要。複数校への納入歴があるため、潜在的な拡大リスクは存在。タイ・グエン省の経済警察による継続調査中。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim aponta casos de chikungunya e dengue em Bonito e alerta para prevenção - OPINIÃO E NOTÍCIA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bulletin reports chikungunya and dengue cases in Bonito and calls for prevention - Opinion and News
article.articleSummary: Bonito, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports ongoing Aedes aegypti-borne disease activity. The epidemiological bulletin released on April 16 shows 82 confirmed chikungunya cases, 297 notifications, and 1 death, and 4 confirmed dengue cases with 297 notifications and no deaths. Zika remains at zero confirmed/notified deaths. The data underscore active transmission risk in the city and trigger prevention alerts. Local authorities continue integrated vector-control efforts, including chemical and human 'block' operations with house-to-house visits to identify and eliminate breeding sites. A citywide cleanup campaign targets waste and potential larval habitats, while school-based health education expands awareness. Public information campaigns via radio and social media support messaging. Fumacê insecticide fogging is planned for a second cycle; residents should keep doors/windows open during application and maintain home precautions to remove standing water.

triage.headline_ja: ボレチンがボニートのチクングニアとデング熱の症例を報告し、予防を呼び掛け
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州ボニートでチクングニア、デング熱、ジカ熱の同時流行が報告されている。確認症例82例（チクングニア）、死亡1例を含む重症度あり、地元当局による統合的媒介蚊対策が進行中。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、重症度、国際拡大リスク）かつWPRO基準複数項目該当のためPICKUP判定。
triage.notes: 3種類の蚊媒介ウイルス感染症の同時流行（チクングニア82確認例・1死亡、デング熱4確認例・297通知、ジカ熱）。記事発行日2026年4月18日。地元当局による化学的・人的媒介蚊対策、清掃キャンペーン、教育啓発、Fumacêフォグ処理など複合的対策が進行中。Aedes aegypti媒介であり、環境中での活発な感染伝播リスクが継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ bùng phát bệnh dại mùa nắng nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of rabies outbreak during the hot season
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk in Vietnam rises with the hot season. In the first three months of 2026, the country reported 12 rabies deaths and more people seeking post-exposure prophylaxis, with dog-associated outbreaks seen in several provinces. In Hai Phong, a 72-year-old woman was attacked by a 30 kg dog described as a 'becgie' breed; she underwent emergency surgery, received rabies immunoglobulin, rabies vaccine, and tetanus. In Tay Ninh, 7 rabies deaths were recorded from Jan 1 to Apr 7, 2026, including a case that developed disease about a year after the initial bite. In Hanoi, three dog rabies outbreaks occurred in Hoa Lac and Ha Bang; seven people bitten by suspected rabid dogs were fully vaccinated and stable. Experts cite vaccination gaps in dogs/cats (national average ~50%, some local >90%) as enabling spread, especially May–August ‘rabies season’ when roaming increases. Prevention: vaccinate pets, confine them, muzzle in public, wash wounds for 15 minutes with soap, disinfect, and seek prompt medical care for PEP.

triage.headline_ja: 高温期のオオカミ病（狂犬病）流行のリスク
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による複数の死亡例（2026年1月～4月で12件以上）が報告されており、IHR基準「異常性」「重症度」に該当。複数州での犬関連アウトブレイク、予防接種ギャップによる継続的な感染リスクが認められ、スクリーニング基準5項目中3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は季節的リスクであり「予想外」ではないと判断（毎年発生する既知の課題）。ただし2026年上期の12死亡、複数地域での犬由来アウトブレイク、予防接種カバー率の不十分さ（平均50%）による継続的曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染ではなくヒト-動物間の制御可能性の課題が重要。tetanus（破傷風）も記事に言及されているが、主要な懸念は狂犬病アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: New COVID-19 Study Links RAAS to Respiratory Decline - Thailand Medical News
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 severity linked to RAAS disruption in Brazil. In Rio de Janeiro, hospitalized patients showed elevated angiotensin II and dysregulated soluble ACE2, correlating with increased oxygen requirements and dyspnea, suggesting direct lung injury from RAAS imbalance. Higher angiotensin II levels associated with reduced protective immune signals (IL-3) and greater inflammation; soluble ACE2 linked to IL-13 and fibroblast growth factor, tied to fibrosis risk. Lower oxygenation correlated with reduced LIF, indicating impaired tissue repair. Comorbidities amplified risk: diabetes with lower MCP-1 and LIF; hypertension with higher IP-10; obesity with higher IL-12p70. Age linked to higher TNF and HGF, aligning with severe outcomes. Therapeutic implication: targeting RAAS to rebalance angiotensin II and ACE2 may reduce inflammation and protect lung function; biomarker monitoring could enable early risk stratification. Findings from Fiocruz labs, published in International Journal of Molecular Sciences.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の新研究がRAAS（レニン・アンジオテンシン・アルドステロン系）と呼吸機能低下を関連付け - タイランド・メディカル・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのリオデジャネイロでCOVID-19重症度とRAAS破綻の関連を示す臨床研究報告。既知疾患の病態機序に関する学術的知見であり、新規の感染症流行シグナルではないが、治療的意義がある。情報不足により WATCH 判定。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19の病態に関する基礎・臨床研究報告であり、新規の流行シグナルではない。リオデジャネイロの入院患者を対象とした過去の研究成果の発表と考えられる。現在進行中の疾病流行の拡大や異常発生を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Carta de Porto Alegre articula resposta urgente ao avanço do HIV no Sul : Linkezine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Alegre Letter Articulates Urgent Response to the Spread of HIV in the South: Linkezine
article.articleSummary: HIV in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, is the focus of the Porto Alegre Letter, an alliance by SGI and AMRIGS to slow the infection’s spread in the South. The initiative notes mortality is elevated and cases cluster in the Porto Alegre Metropolitan Region, with up to 1 in 18 people aged 18–25 living with HIV in the city. The plan calls for an integrated, evidence-based response centered on people, linking information, access, care, and reducing inequalities. Priorities include expanded testing for early diagnosis, immediate treatment, and enhanced combination prevention, including PrEP access in oral and long-acting injectable forms. The proposal will be officially launched May 23 at InfectoTchê in Porto Alegre (Hotel Hilton). The Carta seeks open collaboration across public management, medical groups, and civil society to unify efforts beyond isolated policies.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・アレグレ声明：南部におけるHIV蔓延への緊急対応を明確化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部でのHIV感染の増加が報告されており、特定地域での感染率上昇（18-25歳で最大1/18）が注目される。しかし、既知の感染症の地域的対応キャンペーンであり、新規の公衆衛生上の重大な緊急事態を示す明確な証拠が不足しており、国際的拡大の直接的なリスクも記述されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のHIV流行に対する組織的対応イニシアティブ（ポルト・アレグレ声明）の発表であり、新規の急性感染症危機というより、既知の慢性感染症に対する地域的公衆衛生キャンペーンである。重症度と罹患地域の継続的な曝露リスクは高いが、IHR通知に相当する国際的な新規脅威の証拠は限定的。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、社会的関心と政府関心の存在により、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Tiết lộ 'hoa hồng' cho hiệu trưởng trong vụ thịt lợn bệnh vào trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Revealing kickbacks to the principal in the case of diseased pork entering schools.
article.articleSummary: Thai Nguyen Province police have exposed a scheme to secure school meals through kickbacks. Business owner Nguyen Van Thanh allegedly paid monthly bribes of 6% of the total value of goods to Nam Hoa Kindergarten's former principal Nguyen Thi Tam and the school accountant Tran Thi Hang, from October 2024 to March 2026, to sustain food and meals supply. Thanh is charged with giving bribes; Tam and Hang with receiving bribes; investigators have seized documents and are expanding the case to identify other individuals and organizations involved. Separately, a March 25, 2026 report linked Thanh's meat supply to diseased pork used at Hoa Binh Kindergarten in Van Lang, Thai Nguyen, where lab results found African swine fever virus and E. coli. On April 8, 2026, Thai Nguyen Health Department fined Thanh's food business 22.5 million VND for food-safety violations. The probe continues.

triage.headline_ja: 学校へ流入した病豚肉事件で校長への裏金が明かされる
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラとO157を含む食品汚染事件が学校給食施設に関与し、複数の人的健康リスク（E. coli）と動物衛生リスク（ASF）が確認されている。食品安全違反と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラウイルスとE. coliの両方が検出された食品安全事件。学校給食施設への汚染食品供給という公衆衛生リスクが確認されている。当局による調査と処罰が進行中。Tỉnh Nghệ AnおよびVan Lang（Thai Nguyen Province）での発生が記事サマリーで確認される。

article.articleHeadline: West Sulawesi Strengthens Measles Vaccination and Surveillance Efforts - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Measles surveillance in Pasangkayu Regency, West Sulawesi, is being intensified as officials respond to rising cases across Indonesia as of 18 April 2026. Dr. Nursyamsi Rahim, head of Dinkes P2KB, says enhanced epidemiological investigations aim to rapidly identify and contain outbreaks, strengthen early detection, and enable response to Extraordinary Events (KLB) of measles. The province prioritizes immunization and basic healthcare strengthening to shield future generations from diseases. Officials stress the effort extends beyond routine monitoring to align perspectives, tackle challenges on the ground, and anticipate cases from low immunization. WHO supports Indonesia's public health initiatives, assisting outbreak investigation, surveillance, and immunization. In East Java's Sumenep, a measles outbreak ended after suspected cases reached ~3,000 and 205 confirmed by Aug 2025, with vaccine coverage reaching 96.1% after coordinated response and immunization campaigns. Indonesia recently declared a KLB of measles across seven regions in South Sulawesi.

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシが麻疹の予防接種と監視活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の複数地域への拡大（南スラウェシ7地域でKLB宣言）、過去の大規模流行実績（東ジャワで約3,000疑い症例、205確定例）、ヒト-ヒト感染性、低ワクチン接種率への懸念があり、スクリーニング基準複数該当かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、インドネシア（西スラウェシおよび南スラウェシ）で複数地域にまたがる麻疹流行が確認されている。南スラウェシ7地域でKLB（Extraordinary Event）宣言、東ジャワで過去に約3,000疑い症例の大規模流行、低ワクチン接種率地域での対応が課題として述べられている。WHOの支援も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: 5個孩子就有1個重症！7年未見大流行　醫示警「這款」疾病魔王恐再起 | 健康 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One in five children develop severe illness! Seven years without a pandemic; doctors warn this 'disease demon king' could rise again
article.articleSummary: Taiwanese doctors warn that enterovirus EV71—the so-called 'demon king' of infections—could surge again. In a cluster of five children, two-year-old twins were infected; the younger twin died within two hours of hospital arrival, while the elder twin survived with timely care. Another case involved a three-year-old who developed central nervous system involvement and required extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. EV71 accounts for about 80% of severe enterovirus cases (2005–2024) and can cause encephalitis and cardiorespiratory failure, with fatality up to 20% in severe illness. About 53% of infected adults are asymptomatic carriers, enabling hidden transmission; fecal–oral spread can last over three months, and alcohol disinfectants are ineffective. Japan and Vietnam report rising EV activity; in Vietnam, EV71 drives over half of infections and most severe outcomes. A Taiwan-wide prevention consensus urges vaccination for children under six, supported by education materials like the EV71 Vaccine Superhero Team.

triage.headline_ja: 5人の子どものうち1人が重症化！7年ぶりの大流行　医師が警告「この感染症の王様」が再来する可能性
triage.triage_reason: EV71の大規模流行の可能性が指摘されており、IHR基準で異常性（7年ぶりの大流行）、重症度（死亡例・ICU必要症例あり）、国際的拡大リスク（台湾・日本・ベトナムで活動上昇）の3項目が該当。WPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク（3ヶ月以上の糞口感染）、流行易感性の4項目が該当し、医学専門家による警告で社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。日本も対象国リストに含まれていない。ベトナムのみが対象国リストに該当。記事は東南アジアでの EV71 の地域的脅威を強調しており、ベトナムではEV71が感染症の50%以上を占め重症化を主導している点が特に注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Chó 'điên' cắn 4 người ở Quảng Ngãi dương tính vi rút dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid dog that bit four people in Quang Ngai tests positive for the rabies virus.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a dog that bit four people in Son Tịnh commune, Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam. On 15 April, a dog head sample from Diên Niên village was sent to the Central Veterinary Diagnostics Center (Laboratory II); on 17 April the sample tested positive for rabies virus. The attack occurred on 14 April when a golden-colored dog roaming along inter-village routes in Sơn Tịnh injured four residents; the dog was captured and euthanized around 11:30 that day. Authorities cordoned off the outbreak area, monitored bite victims, and advised prompt post-exposure vaccination. Vaccination campaigns for dogs and cats were initiated locally, with intensified public messaging to curb roaming dogs, especially in hot weather conducive to spread. Local officials plan tighter pet management and are seeking residents’ pledges to confine and vaccinate animals.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省で4人を咬んだ犬が狂犬病ウイルス陽性
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで確認された狂犬病事例（咬傷4人、犬1頭）。重症度・管理可能性の情報は限定的だが、公衆衛生対応は実施されており、国際的拡大リスクは低い。続報を注視する必要あり。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は予防可能だが致死率が高い疾患。咬傷被害者4人に対して当局が迅速に対応（ワクチン接種・感染動物の安楽死・地域監視）を実施している点は評価できるが、現時点では限局的な事例（動物由来、地域内）であり、国際的なシグナル要件には未達。予防接種キャンペーンが展開されており、管理下にあると判断される。

article.articleHeadline: ดับแล้ว 23 ราย เตือนระวัง โรคเมลิออยด์โดสิส ติดเชื้อแบคทีเรียในดิน-น้ำ เช็กอาการ-สัญญาณโรค
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 23 Fatalities: Warning About Melioidosis, a Soil- and Water-Borne Bacterial Infection — Check the Symptoms and Signs
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, a soil- and water-borne bacterial infection, has caused 732 cases nationwide in Thailand from Jan 1 to Apr 16, 2026, with 23 deaths. In Region 7 (Khon Kaen), 68 cases and 2 deaths were reported. Most affected are people aged 50 and older. Transmission occurs via wounds, inhalation of dust, or drinking contaminated water from soil- and water-rich environments. Symptoms range from high fever, dyspnea and chest tightness to red, swollen wounds or abscesses; bloodstream infection can cause septicemia and death. High-risk groups include farmers and others in contact with soil and water, and individuals with diabetes, chronic kidney disease, liver disease, chronic lung disease, thalassemia, or immunocompromised status. Government urges avoidance of direct contact with soil and water; wear boots and gloves if exposure is necessary. Seek care promptly if fever lasts >2 days, breathing difficulties, or wound infection. Hotline 1422; early treatment is curative.

triage.headline_ja: 23人が死亡：土壌・水由来のメリオイドーシス（バクテリア感染症）に警戒を — 症状・徴候を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。732例・23死亡の中規模流行で、農業従事者など高リスク群への継続的な曝露が懸念される。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは東南アジアの風土病であるが、2026年の数字（732例、23死亡）は同地域での報告状況としては注視対象。高リスク職業層への継続曝露、季節性水環境との関連が予想され、降雨期の拡大リスクがある。政府は公開啓発とホットライン対応で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: 4 nhóm thực phẩm dễ nhiễm khuẩn trong mùa hè
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Groups of Foods Prone to Bacterial Contamination in the Summer
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, Vietnam, nutrition expert Do Thi Lan warns that four summer foods are highly prone to bacterial contamination: leftover cooled rice, cut fruits (watermelon, mango, dragon fruit), processed meats such as cold cuts and sausages, and hard-boiled eggs. In warm, humid conditions (roughly 20–28°C), bacteria multiply rapidly; Bacillus cereus spores in cooled rice may survive cooking and produce toxins if rice is left at room temperature too long. Cut fruits become unstable after slicing, with rapid bacterial growth; refrigerate and consume within the day. Processed meats can harbor Listeria, persisting even in prepared products; do not leave these out more than two hours. Boiled eggs are vulnerable to Salmonella after shell damage; use within 1–2 days and avoid room-temperature storage beyond two hours. Refrigerate promptly, keep fridge below 4°C, reheat leftovers thoroughly, and clean fridge regularly to minimize risk.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季に細菌汚染されやすい4つの食品グループ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は食品衛生に関する一般的な予防啓発情報であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・クラスターの報告ではない。特定の患者数、死亡、医療機関への患者集中、または急増の事例報告がなく、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は栄養専門家による食品安全の啓発記事。実際のアウトブレイク、患者報告、感染症危機の兆候は含まれていない。予防的なアドバイスのみであり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Tiết lộ khoản "hoa hồng" cho hiệu trưởng để tuồn thịt lợn bệnh vào trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Revealing the kickback to the principal to smuggle diseased pork into schools.
article.articleSummary: Thai Nguyen Province investigators reveal a kickback scheme to secure school food contracts, implicating Nguyen Van Thanh, owner of a meal business. Thanh paid 6% of the monthly procurement value to Nam Hoa Kindergarten’s former principal Nguyen Thi Tam and accountant Tran Thi Hang from Oct 2024 to Mar 2026 to maintain the supply of food and meals. Thanh is charged with giving bribes; Tam and Hang charged with receiving bribes. The probe recalls a March 25, 2026 report by parents of Hoa Binh Kindergarten, Văn Lăng, noting pork from Thanh exhibited disease signs; laboratory tests confirmed the meat was positive for African swine fever virus and Escherichia coli. On April 8, 2026, the Thái Nguyên Health Department fined Thanh’s food business 22.5 million VND for food safety violations. Authorities are expanding the investigation to identify other individuals and organizations involved.

triage.headline_ja: 学校に病気の豚肉を密輸するための校長への賄賂が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱とE.coliの両方が確認された食品安全上の公衆衛生事件であり、学校給食という広範な住民曝露のリスク、異常性、そして国家的な関心が認められる。IHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: タイグエン省で確認されたアフリカ豚熱とE.coliの同時検出、学校給食への混入、賄賂スキームの存在が公開されている。当局による調査拡大中。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bengaluru: ಹೆಸರಘಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿಜ್ವರ ದೃಢ: ಜನತೆಗೆ ಆತಂಕ ಬೇಡ ಎಂದ ಸಚಿವ ದಿನೇಶ್ ಗುಂಡೂರಾವ್
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengaluru: Bird flu confirmed in Hesaraghatta; Minister Dinesh Gundu Rao says there is no need for the public to panic.
article.articleSummary: Bengaluru’s outskirts near Hesaraghatta, in Makkur village, have confirmed H5N1 avian influenza. Health minister Dinesh Gundu Rao says there is no need for public panic. Rapid response includes a 3 km infected containment zone around the outbreak and a 10 km surveillance belt. Approximately 7,444 chickens and 14,788 eggs have been culled and disposed of; 10 staffers are in quarantine under medical monitoring. Over the next 10 days, health workers will conduct door-to-door fever surveillance in 19 surrounding villages, screening for fever and cough and providing treatment as needed. PPE kits, masks, and life-saving medicines are stocked at Hesaraghatta and Sonnenahalli PHCs. Public guidance urges avoidance of contact with sick or dead birds, and to report to local health or veterinary authorities; cooked poultry meat and eggs are safe to consume. No panic is warranted as of 18 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルール：ヘサラガッタで鳥インフルエンザH5N1が確認、パニック不要と保健相が発表
triage.triage_reason: ヒト感染を伴う鳥インフルエンザA H5N1の確認事例であり、IHR基準（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響）の複数該当、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数該当が認められ、迅速な対応と公式対応が実施されているため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認例であり、7,400羽以上の家禽の処分、10名の職員隔離、3km感染区域設定、19村での戸別訪問による発熱サーベイランスなど、公式対応が確認されている。インド政府（カルナタカ州保健相）による公式声明あり。H5N1はヒト感染の報告例があり、国際的対応の対象疾患。
